en.t: King Richard I of England gives Portsmouth its first royal charter
en.s: Richard I (8 September 1157 – 6 April 1199), known as Richard the Lionheart or Richard Cœur de Lion (Old Norman French: Quor de Lion) because of his reputation as a great military leader and warrior, was King of England from 1189 until his death in 1199. He also ruled as Duke of Normandy, Aquitaine, and Gascony; Lord of Cyprus; Count of Poitiers, Anjou, Maine, and Nantes; and was overlord of Brittany at various times during the same period.

zh.t: 理查一世授予朴次茅斯首份皇家特许状
zh.s: 理查一世（1157年9月8日—1199年4月6日）因出色的军事领导能力和战士声誉而被称为“狮心王理查”或“理查·科厄尔·德·莱昂”。他自1189年至去世一直是英格兰国王，同时曾统治诺曼底、阿基坦和加斯科涅，拥有塞浦路斯领主头衔，并为普瓦捷、安茹、曼恩和南特伯爵；在不同时期还曾是布列塔尼的宗主。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The Battle of Lundenæs (Danish: Slaget ved Lundenæs), also known as the Battle of Skjern River (Danish: Slaget ved Skjern Å) was a military engagement between Holsteinian and Jutish rebel forces on 2 May 1340 possibly at Lundenæs Castle near Skjern River in the then Holsteinian-held Jutland. The battle ended in a Jutish rebel victory and it is alleged that many Germans died in the Skirmish.

zh.s: 伦代奈斯之战（丹麦语：Slaget ved Lundenæs）又称斯凯恩河之战（丹麦语：Slaget ved Skjern Å），于1340年5月2日发生在霍尔斯坦人和日德兰叛军之间。战斗地点可能在伦代奈斯城堡附近、斯凯恩河边，当时该地位于霍尔斯坦人控制下的日德兰。据称，战斗以日德兰叛军获胜告终，许多德国人阵亡。

en.t: The surrender of the Acropolis of Athens to Nerio Acciaioli ends the Catalan presence in the Duchy of Athens
en.s: The Acropolis of Athens (Ancient Greek: Ἡ Ἀκρόπολις τῶν Ἀθηνῶν, romanized: Hē Akropolis tōn Athēnōn; Modern Greek: Η Ακρόπολη των Αθηνών, romanized: I Akrópoli ton Athinón) is an ancient citadel located on a rocky outcrop above the city of Athens, Greece, and contains the remains of several ancient buildings of great architectural and historical significance, the most famous being the Parthenon.

zh.t: 雅典卫城向内里奥·阿恰约利投降，结束加泰罗尼亚人在雅典公国的统治
zh.s: 雅典卫城是一座古代城堡，坐落在希腊雅典市区上方的岩丘上，保存着多座具有重要建筑与历史价值的古代建筑遗迹，其中最著名的是帕特农神庙。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: Uckermark War was a military conflict fought in Uckermark, Brandenburg, between 1425 and 2 May 1427. It was fought by Pomerania-Stettin, Pomerania-Wolgast, Pomerania-Stolp, Pomerania-Stargard, Mecklenburg-Stargard, Crown of the Kingdom of Poland, and Werle, attacking the Margraviate of Brandenburg.

zh.s: 乌克马克战争是1425年至1427年5月2日在勃兰登堡乌克马克地区进行的一场军事冲突。波美拉尼亚-什切青、波美拉尼亚-沃尔加斯特、波美拉尼亚-斯托尔普、波美拉尼亚-施塔加德、梅克伦堡-施塔加德、波兰王国和韦尔勒联合进攻勃兰登堡侯国。

en.s: The battle of Rapallo was a naval battle fought on 2 May 1495, during the First Italian War, between a fleet of the Republic of Genoa under the command of Francesco Spinola and a French fleet under the command of Louis de Miolans.

zh.s: 拉帕洛海战于1495年5月2日爆发，是第一次意大利战争期间的一场海战。热那亚共和国舰队由弗朗切斯科·斯皮诺拉指挥，法军舰队由路易·德·米奥朗指挥。

en.t: Anne Boleyn, Queen of England, is arrested and imprisoned on charges of adultery, incest, treason and witchcraft
en.s: Anne Boleyn (; c. 1501 or 1507 – 19 May 1536) was Queen of England from 1533 to 1536, as the second wife of King Henry VIII. The circumstances of her marriage and execution, by beheading for treason, made her a key figure in the political and religious upheaval that marked the start of the English Reformation.

zh.t: 英格兰女王安妮·博林被捕并被控通奸、乱伦、叛国和巫术
zh.s: 安妮·博林（约1501年或1507年—1536年5月19日）于1533年至1536年担任英格兰王后，是亨利八世的第二任妻子。她因婚姻及被以叛国罪处决的经过，成为英格兰宗教改革初期政治与宗教动荡中的重要人物。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

loc: 英国安特里姆郡巴利卡斯尔

en.s: The Battle of Glentaisie, was an Irish battle fought in the north of Ulster on 2 May 1565. The result was a victory for Shane O'Neill over the Clan MacDonald of Dunnyveg. The conflict was a part of the political and military struggle, involving the English and occasionally the Scots, for control of northern Ireland. Although the MacDonalds were a Scottish family, based principally on the island of Islay in the Hebrides, they had long been associated with the Gaelic polity rather than the kingdom of Scotland.

zh.s: 格伦泰西战役于1565年5月2日在阿尔斯特北部爆发，是一场爱尔兰战役。香恩·奥尼尔击败了邓尼韦格麦克唐纳氏族。战役是争夺爱尔兰北部控制权的政治和军事斗争的一部分，英国人也参与其中，苏格兰人有时也卷入其中。麦克唐纳家族虽然来自苏格兰，主要居住在赫布里底群岛的艾莱岛，但长期与盖尔政治势力关系密切，而非苏格兰王国。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: Mary, Queen of Scots, escapes from Lochleven Castle
en.s: Mary, Queen of Scots (8 December 1542 – 8 February 1587), also known as Mary Stuart or Mary I of Scotland, was Queen of Scotland from 14 December 1542 until her forced abdication on 24 July 1567. The only surviving legitimate child of King James V of Scotland, Mary was six days old when her father died, and she inherited the throne.

zh.t: 苏格兰女王玛丽逃离洛赫利文城堡
zh.s: 苏格兰女王玛丽（1542年12月8日—1587年2月8日），又称玛丽·斯图亚特或苏格兰的玛丽一世，自1542年12月14日起担任苏格兰女王，直到1567年7月24日被迫退位。她是詹姆斯五世唯一存活的婚生子女，父亲去世时她年仅六天，随后继承王位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The siege of Schenkenschans was a siege that took place from 28 April to 2 May 1599 as part of the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo–Spanish War. Schenkenschans was garrisoned largely by English troops and was besieged by a Spanish force led by Francisco de Mendoza. The siege failed with losses and the Spanish were forced to retreat when a relief force arrived.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 申肯斯汉斯围城战发生于1599年4月28日至5月2日，是八十年战争和英西战争的一部分。申肯斯汉斯主要由英军驻守，西班牙军队由弗朗西斯科·德·门多萨率领，发起围城。救援部队抵达后，西班牙军队伤亡并被迫撤退，围城以失败告终。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: The King James Version of the Bible is published for the first time in London, England, by printer Robert Barker
en.s: The King James Bible, widely known by the nickname King James Version (KJV) and the Authorized Version, is an Early Modern English translation of the Christian Bible for the Church of England and Church of Scotland, which was commissioned in 1604 and published in 1611, by sponsorship of King James VI and I.

zh.t: 《詹姆士王钦定版圣经》首次出版
zh.s: 《詹姆士王钦定版圣经》（KJV）又称“詹姆士王版”或“授权版”，是供英格兰和苏格兰教会使用的早期现代英语圣经译本。该译本于1604年奉命编译，在英王詹姆士六世兼一世的资助下，于1611年由伦敦印刷商罗伯特·巴克首次出版。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.t: Afonso Mendes, appointed by Pope Gregory XV as Latin Patriarch of Ethiopia, arrives at Beilul from Goa
en.s: Father Afonso Mendes (18 June 1579 – 21 June 1659) was a Portuguese Jesuit theologian, and Patriarch of Ethiopia from 1622 to 1634. While E. A. Wallis Budge has expressed the commonly accepted opinion of this man, as being "rigid, uncompromising, narrow-minded, and intolerant", there are some who disagree with it. The writings of Mendes include Expeditionis Aethiopicae, which describes the customs and conditions of Ethiopia.

zh.t: 阿方索·门德斯抵达贝卢尔
zh.s: 阿方索·门德斯神父（1579年6月18日—1659年6月21日）是葡萄牙耶稣会神学家，曾于1622年至1634年担任埃塞俄比亚宗主教。E. A. 沃利斯·巴奇曾称他“严厉、不妥协、心胸狭窄且不宽容”，但也有人持不同看法。门德斯著有《埃塞俄比亚远征记》，记述埃塞俄比亚的风俗与状况。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; dated Events calendar entry and linked subject introduction

en.s: The siege of Trarbach (10 April – 2 May 1734) was conducted during the War of the Polish Succession by French troops against a garrison of troops of the Holy Roman Empire in the fortress at Trarbach in the County of Sponheim, a small principality of the Holy Roman Empire (Trarbach is now in Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany). The French, led by Marshal Belle-Isle, were victorious, and destroyed the fortress.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 特拉巴赫围城战发生于1734年4月10日至5月2日，是波兰王位继承战争期间的一场战役。法军围攻位于斯蓬海姆伯国特拉巴赫要塞的神圣罗马帝国守军。法国由贝尔-伊尔元帅率领，最终获胜并摧毁了要塞。特拉巴赫现位于德国莱茵兰-普法尔茨州。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Skirmish of Loch nan Uamh was a conflict that took place on 2 May 1746 and was part of the Jacobite rising of 1745. It was fought by the British Royal Navy against French privateers who were supporting the Jacobite rebels.

zh.t: 洛赫南乌阿姆湖遭遇战
zh.s: 洛赫南乌阿姆湖遭遇战发生于1746年5月2日，是1745年詹姆斯党起义的一部分。交战双方是英国皇家海军和支持詹姆斯党叛军的法国私掠船。

en.s: The Atlantic campaign of May 1794 was a series of operations conducted by the Royal Navy's Channel Fleet against the French Navy's Atlantic Fleet, with the aim of preventing the passage of a strategically important French grain convoy travelling from the United States to France.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1794年5月大西洋战役由英国皇家海军海峡舰队对抗法国海军大西洋舰队，目的是阻止一支从美国驶往法国、具有重要战略意义的法国粮食船队通过。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The Battle of Gujrat (1797) was fought between the forces of the Durrani Empire led by Ahmad Khan Shahanchibashi and the Sikh forces led by various Sardars. After Zaman Shah's third failed invasion of Punjab, he left Shahanchibashi as governor of the Rohtas Fort and the region between the Jhelum and Indus rivers. Known for his oppressive rule and ambition to conquer Gujrat, Shahanchibashi faced a holy war organized by Ram Singh Bedi.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1797年的古吉拉特之战发生在杜兰尼帝国军队与锡克军队之间。杜兰尼军由艾哈迈德·汗·沙汉奇巴希统率，锡克军由多名萨达尔率领。扎曼·沙阿第三次入侵旁遮普失败后，任命沙汉奇巴希为罗塔斯堡及杰赫勒姆河与印度河之间地区的总督。沙汉奇巴希以统治严酷、意图征服古吉拉特而闻名，后来遭到拉姆·辛格·贝迪组织的圣战讨伐。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Battle of Pulkkila was fought between Swedish and Russian forces near Pulkkila in Northern Ostrobothnia on 2 May 1808 during the Finnish War. At the battle of Pulkkila on 2 May 1808, Johan August Sandels marched eastwards to liberate those parts of Finland that were under Russian control. During the march they encountered some Russian troops at Pulkkila. Theses Russian troops were led by Colonel Obuhov. The Russians were soon surrounded and tried desperately to break out, but they were forced back to a nearby village where the Russians were defeated after some vicious fighting.

zh.s: 1808年5月2日芬兰战争期间，瑞典和俄罗斯军队在北博滕区普尔基拉附近交战。约翰·奥古斯特·桑德尔斯率军向东进军，试图解放被俄军控制的芬兰地区，途中在普尔基拉遭遇奥布霍夫上校率领的俄军。俄军很快被包围，虽奋力突围，仍被迫退至附近村庄，并在激战后落败。

en.s: The Peninsular War (1807–1814) was a military conflict between Napoleon's empire and the allied powers of Spain, Britain and Portugal for control of the Iberian Peninsula during the Napoleonic Wars. The war started when French and Spanish armies invaded and occupied Portugal in 1807, and escalated in 1808 when France turned on Spain, its ally until then. The war on the peninsula lasted until the Sixth Coalition defeated Napoleon in 1814, and is regarded as one of the first wars of national liberation, significant for the emergence of large-scale guerrilla warfare.

zh.s: 半岛战争（1807—1814年）是拿破仑战争期间，拿破仑帝国与西班牙、英国和葡萄牙组成的同盟国为争夺伊比利亚半岛控制权而爆发的军事冲突。1807年，法西军队入侵并占领葡萄牙，战争由此开始；1808年，法国转而进攻此前的盟友西班牙，战事扩大。半岛战事持续到第六次反法同盟于1814年击败拿破仑。该战争被视为最早的一批民族解放战争之一，也因大规模游击战的兴起而受到关注。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Dos de Mayo or Second of May Uprising took place in Madrid, Spain, on 2–3 May 1808. The rebellion, mainly by civilians, with some isolated military action by junior officers, was against the occupation of the city by French troops, and was violently repressed by the French Imperial forces, with hundreds of public executions.

zh.s: 五二起义又称“五月二日起义”，于1808年5月2日至3日在西班牙马德里爆发。起义者主要是平民，也有少数军官参与零星军事行动，他们反抗法军对马德里的占领。法国帝国军队残酷镇压起义，并公开处决数百人。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: The Siege of Brăila was a significant event during the Russo-Turkish War (1806–1812). Between 20 April and 2 May 1809, the city of Brăila (present-day Brăila, Romania) was besieged by Russian forces under the command of Generals Alexander Prozorovsky and Mikhail Kutuzov. The siege ended in a decisive Ottoman victory, as the defending garrison successfully repelled the Russian attack.

zh.s: 布勒伊拉围城战是1806至1812年俄土战争中的一场重要事件。1809年4月20日至5月2日，俄罗斯军队在亚历山大·普罗佐罗夫斯基将军和米哈伊尔·库图佐夫将军指挥下围攻布勒伊拉城（今罗马尼亚布勒伊拉）。守军成功击退俄军进攻，围城以奥斯曼帝国决定性胜利告终。

en.s: The Battle of El Maguey was a battle of the War of Mexican Independence that occurred on 2 May 1811 at El Maguey, in the State of Aguascalientes. The battle was fought between the royalist forces loyal to the Spanish crown, commanded by General Miguel Emparan, and the Mexican rebels fighting for independence from the Spanish Empire, commanded by Ignacio López Rayón.

zh.s: 埃尔马圭战役于1811年5月2日在阿瓜斯卡连特斯州埃尔马圭爆发，是墨西哥独立战争中的一场战役。交战双方是效忠西班牙王室、由米格尔·恩帕兰将军指挥的保皇派，以及争取脱离西班牙帝国独立、由伊格纳西奥·洛佩斯·拉永指挥的墨西哥起义军。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

loc: 库奥特拉，莫雷洛斯州，墨西哥

en.s: The Siege of Cuautla was a battle of the War of Mexican Independence that occurred from 9 February through 2 May 1812 at Cuautla, Morelos. The Spanish royalist forces loyal to the Spanish, commanded by Félix María Calleja, besieged the town of Cuautla and its Mexican rebel defenders fighting for independence from the Spanish Empire. The rebels were commanded by José María Morelos y Pavón, Hermenegildo Galeana, and Mariano Matamoros. The battle results are disputed, but it is generally agreed that the battle resulted more favorably for the Spanish whose siege was ultimately successful with the Mexican withdrawal on 2 May 1812.

zh.s: 库奥特拉围城战是墨西哥独立战争中的一场战役，发生于1812年2月9日至5月2日，地点在莫雷洛斯州库奥特拉。效忠西班牙王室的军队由费利克斯·玛丽亚·卡列哈指挥，围攻库奥特拉镇及守城的墨西哥独立军。墨西哥起义军由何塞·玛丽亚·莫雷洛斯·帕冯、埃尔梅内希尔多·加莱亚纳和马里亚诺·马塔莫罗斯率领。战役结果存在争议，但普遍认为西班牙军队更占上风；围城最终奏效，墨西哥军队于1812年5月2日撤退。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: In the Battle of Lützen (German: Schlacht von Großgörschen, May 2, 1813), Napoleon I of France halted the advances of the Sixth Coalition after his devastating losses in Russia. The Russian commander, Prince Peter Wittgenstein, attempting to preempt Napoleon's capture of Leipzig, attacked Napoleon's isolated right wing near Lützen, Germany. After a day of heavy fighting, the combined Prussian and Russian force retreated, but due to French losses and the lack of strong French cavalry, Napoleon was unable to pursue his defeated enemy.

zh.s: 1813年5月2日，法国皇帝拿破仑一世在吕岑战役（德语：Schlacht von Großgörschen）中阻止了第六次反法同盟的推进。此前，拿破仑在俄国遭受惨重损失。俄军指挥官彼得·维特根施泰因亲王试图抢先阻止拿破仑攻占莱比锡，于是袭击了吕岑附近孤立的法军右翼。激战一天后，普鲁士和俄国联军撤退；但法军损失不小，且缺少强大的骑兵，拿破仑未能追击败退的敌军。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The siege of Besançon was an event during the War of the Sixth Coalition, which occurred in 1814 in Besançon (Franche-Comté), France. The First French Empire, commanded by Napoleon I, engaged in battles with a number of European powers in the early 1800s.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 贝桑松围城战是第六次反法同盟战争期间发生在法国弗朗什-孔泰贝桑松的一场战事。拿破仑一世统治下的法兰西第一帝国于19世纪初与多个欧洲强国交战。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 1837 Chicago mayoral election was held on May 2, 1837. It was the first Chicago mayoral election, taking place the same year as Chicago's incorporation as a city. Democratic candidate William B. Ogden defeated Whig incumbent Town President John H. Kinzie by a landslide 38.5 point margin. Shortly after the election Ogden was sworn in as Chicago's first mayor.

zh.s: 芝加哥首次市长选举于1837年5月2日举行，与芝加哥建市同年。民主党候选人威廉·B·奥格登以38.5个百分点的巨大优势击败辉格党现任镇主席约翰·H·金齐。选举后不久，奥格登宣誓就任芝加哥首任市长。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in Portugal on 2 May 1858.

zh.s: 葡萄牙于1858年5月2日举行议会选举。

en.s: The 1861 Newfoundland general election was held on May 2, 1861 to elect the members of the 8th General Assembly of Newfoundland in the Newfoundland Colony. It was triggered following the forced resignation of Premier John Kent by Governor Alexander Bannerman after Kent accused Bannerman of colluding with the Conservative Party.

zh.s: 1861年5月2日举行纽芬兰大选，选出纽芬兰殖民地第八届议会成员。此前，纽芬兰总督亚历山大·班纳曼迫使总理约翰·肯特辞职。肯特曾指控班纳曼与保守党勾结。

en.s: The Mito rebellion (水戸幕末争乱, Mito bakumatsu sōran), also called the Kantō Insurrection or the Tengutō Rebellion (天狗党の乱, tengutō no ran), was a civil war that occurred in the area of Mito Domain in Japan from May 2, 1864 to January 14, 1865. It involved an uprising and terrorist actions against the central power of the Shogunate in favour of the sonnō jōi ("Revere the emperor, expel the barbarians") movement.

zh.s: 水户叛乱（日语：水戸幕末争乱，罗马字：Mito bakumatsu sōran）又称关东起义或天狗党之乱（日语：天狗党の乱，罗马字：tengutō no ran），是1864年5月2日至1865年1月14日在日本水户藩地区发生的一场内战。事件包括起义以及针对幕府中央政权的恐怖袭击，参与者支持“尊王攘夷”运动。

en.s: The Battle of Callao (in Spanish, called Combate del Dos de Mayo mainly in South America ) occurred on May 2, 1866 between a Spanish fleet under the command of Admiral Casto Méndez Núñez and the fortified battery emplacements of the Peruvian port city of Callao during the Chincha Islands War. The Spanish fleet bombarded the port of Callao (or El Callao), and eventually withdrew without any notable damage to the city structures, according to the Peruvian and American sources; or after having silenced almost all the guns of the coastal defenses, according to the Spanish accounts and French observers.

zh.s: 卡亚俄海战（西班牙语称“五月二日战斗”，主要在南美使用这一名称）发生于1866年5月2日。交战双方是卡斯托·门德斯·努涅斯海军上将指挥的西班牙舰队，以及秘鲁港口城市卡亚俄的岸防炮台，战事属于钦查群岛战争的一部分。西班牙舰队炮击了卡亚俄港（又称埃尔卡亚俄），随后撤离。秘鲁和美国方面的说法称，城市建筑没有明显受损；西班牙方面和法国观察员则称，西班牙舰队几乎压制了所有海岸防御炮。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Battle of Estero Bellaco was one of the bloodiest battles of the Paraguayan War (1865–1870), with the Republic of Argentina, the Empire of Brazil and the Oriental Republic of Uruguay banded together against the Paraguayan government of Marshal Francisco Solano López. This battle took place on 2 May 1866, in which the Allied army repulsed a surprise Paraguayan attack.

zh.s: 埃斯特罗贝亚科战役是巴拉圭战争中伤亡最惨重的战役之一。阿根廷共和国、巴西帝国和乌拉圭东方共和国结盟，对抗弗朗西斯科·索拉诺·洛佩斯元帅领导的巴拉圭政府。战役于1866年5月2日爆发，联军击退了巴拉圭军队的突袭。

en.t: Albert Günther publishes the first study to recognise that the New Zealand tuatara is not a lizard
en.s: Albert Karl Ludwig Gotthilf Günther , also Albert Charles Lewis Gotthilf Günther (3 October 1830 – 1 February 1914), was a German-born British zoologist, ichthyologist, and herpetologist. Günther is ranked the second-most productive reptile taxonomist (after George Albert Boulenger) with more than 340 reptile species described and the third-most productive fish taxonomist with about 1600 fish species described.

zh.t: 阿尔伯特·金特发表首篇确认楔齿蜥并非蜥蜴的研究
zh.s: 阿尔伯特·卡尔·路德维希·戈特希尔夫·金特（又名阿尔伯特·查尔斯·刘易斯·戈特希尔夫·金特，1830年10月3日—1914年2月1日）是德国出生的英国动物学家、鱼类学家和爬虫学家。按描述的爬行动物物种数量（超过340种），他仅次于乔治·阿尔伯特·布伦格；按描述的鱼类物种数量（约1600种），则位列第三。

en.s: The Six Years' War (Spanish: Guerra de los seis años) was a civil war in the Dominican Republic which lasted from 2 May 1868 to 2 January 1874 that "constituted the third war of independence fought by the Dominican people", in this case against the administration of President Buenaventura Báez, which in 1869 negotiated the Dominican Republic's annexation to the United States.

zh.s: 六年战争（西班牙语：Guerra de los seis años）是多米尼加共和国的一场内战，持续时间为1868年5月2日至1874年1月2日。战争被称为“多米尼加人民进行的第三次独立战争”，交战一方反对布埃纳文图拉·巴埃斯总统政府。1869年，巴埃斯政府曾与美国谈判，计划将多米尼加共和国并入美国。

en.s: The Battle of Cut Knife, fought on May 2, 1885, occurred when a small force of Cree and Assiniboine warriors were attacked by a flying column of mounted police, militia, and Canadian army regulars near Battleford, Saskatchewan. The warriors defeated the Canadian forces, with losses on both sides.

zh.s: 卡特刀战役于1885年5月2日爆发。克里族和阿西尼博因族的一小支战士在萨斯喀彻温省巴特尔福德附近遭到一支由骑警、民兵和加拿大正规军组成的机动部队袭击。原住民战士击败了加拿大军队，双方均有伤亡。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Treaty of Wuchale (or, Treaty of Ucciale; in Italian, Trattato di Uccialli) was a treaty signed by King Menelik II of Shewa, later the Emperor of Ethiopia with Count Pietro Antonelli of Italy in the town of Wuchale, Ethiopia, on 2 May 1889. The treaty ceded territories that had previously been a part of Ethiopia, namely the provinces of Bogos, Hamasien, Akkele Guzay, and Serae and is the origin of the Italian colony and modern state of Eritrea. In return, Italy promised financial assistance and military supplies.

zh.s: 乌恰莱条约（又称Ucciale条约；意大利语：Trattato di Uccialli）于1889年5月2日在埃塞俄比亚乌恰莱镇签署，签署方为绍阿国王、后来的埃塞俄比亚皇帝孟尼利克二世，以及意大利伯爵彼得罗·安东内利。条约将此前属于埃塞俄比亚的博戈斯、哈马森、阿克凯莱·古扎伊和塞拉埃等省割让给意大利，成为意大利殖民地厄立特里亚及现代厄立特里亚国家的起源。作为交换，意大利承诺提供财政援助和军事物资。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Portugal on 2 May 1897. Boycotted by the Portuguese Republican Party, they resulted in a victory for the Progressive Party, which won 88 seats.

zh.s: 葡萄牙于1897年5月2日举行议会选举。葡萄牙共和党抵制选举，最终进步党获胜，赢得88席。

en.s: The 1899 Baltimore mayoral election saw Thomas Gordon Hayes defeat incumbent mayor William T. Malster by a 8,748 vote margin-of-victory. This was the first election under a new charter that extended mayoral terms from two years to four years and moved mayoral elections to May. By campaigning on a "good government" platform, Democrats managed to defeat Malster, who in his previous election had defeated Democrat Henry Williams by a 6,000 vote margin-of-victory.

zh.s: 1899年巴尔的摩市长选举中，托马斯·戈登·海斯以8,748票的优势击败了时任市长威廉·T·马尔斯特。这是新宪章实施后的首次选举；新宪章将市长任期从两年延长至四年，并把市长选举改到5月举行。民主党以“良政”为竞选纲领，击败了马尔斯特；在上一届选举中，马尔斯特曾以6,000票优势击败民主党人亨利·威廉姆斯。

en.s: The 1911 Baltimore mayoral election saw the election of James H. Preston.

zh.s: 1911年巴尔的摩市长选举中，詹姆斯·H·普雷斯顿当选。

en.s: The Khost rebellion was a rebellion in Khost that took place in 1912 in the Emirate of Afghanistan, and was the only serious crisis during the reign of Habibullah Khan. Its causes laid in the "rapacity and exactions" of Muhammad Akbar Khan, the local governor of the Khost district. The rebellion, which was led by Jehandad Khan, began on 2 May 1912, when Mangal and Jadran tribesmen in Khost, Afghanistan rose up, quickly overwhelmed various isolated garrisons, and besieged Muhammad Akbar at Matun.

zh.s: 霍斯特叛乱是1912年阿富汗酋长国霍斯特地区发生的一场叛乱，也是哈比布拉汗统治期间唯一一场严重危机。叛乱起因是当地总督穆罕默德·阿克巴尔汗的“贪婪和苛索”。叛乱由杰汉达德汗领导，始于1912年5月2日。当时，阿富汗霍斯特地区的曼加尔人和贾德兰人起事，迅速攻占多个孤立驻军据点，并围困马通的穆罕默德·阿克巴尔。

en.s: The 1915 Copa del Rey final was the 15th final of the Spanish cup competition, the Copa del Rey. The final was played at Estadio de Amute in Irun on 2 May 1915. The match was won by Athletic Bilbao, who beat RCD Español 5–0. The star of the match was Athletic's Pichichi, who scored a hat-trick to help his side clutch a 5–0 win.

zh.s: 1915年西班牙国王杯决赛是西班牙杯赛国王杯的第15届决赛。比赛于1915年5月2日在伊伦的阿穆特球场举行。毕尔巴鄂竞技以5比0击败西班牙人队夺冠。比赛明星是毕尔巴鄂竞技的皮奇奇，他上演帽子戏法，帮助球队锁定5比0的胜局。

en.s: The 1920 Copa del Rey final was the 20th final of the Spanish cup competition, the Copa del Rey. The final was played at El Molinón, in Gijón, on 2 May 1920, in front of an attendance of 10,000 spectators, who saw FC Barcelona beat Athletic Bilbao 2–0, thus winning their fourth cup title. The goals were scored in the second-half by Vicente Martínez and Paulino Alcántara.

zh.s: 1920年西班牙国王杯决赛是该项西班牙杯赛的第20届决赛。比赛于1920年5月2日在希洪的莫利农球场举行，现场观众有10,000人。巴塞罗那足球俱乐部以2比0击败毕尔巴鄂竞技，第四次夺得杯赛冠军。比森特·马丁内斯和保利诺·阿尔坎塔拉在下半场进球。

en.s: The Nicaraguan Civil War of 1926–1927, or the Constitutionalist War, broke out after a coup d'état by Emiliano Chamorro, a member of the Conservative Party, removed Nicaragua's democratically elected government, resulting in a rebellion by members of the Liberal Party. The conflict came to an end after a military and diplomatic intervention by the United States resulted in the Pact of Espino Negro, which began the Peace of Tipitapa.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1926至1927年的尼加拉瓜内战又称立宪战争。保守党成员埃米利亚诺·查莫罗发动政变，推翻尼加拉瓜民选政府后，自由党成员起兵反抗，内战由此爆发。美国通过军事和外交介入，促成《埃斯皮诺内格罗协定》，由此开启蒂皮塔帕和平进程，冲突最终结束。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The 1928 Welsh Cup final, the 47th in the competition, was contested by Bangor and Cardiff City at Farrar Road Stadium, Bangor. Cardiff won 2–0.

zh.s: 第47届威尔士杯决赛由班戈和卡迪夫城在班戈的法拉尔路球场进行。卡迪夫城以2比0获胜。

en.s: The 1931 Brisbane City Council election was held on 2 May 1931 to elect councillors for each of the 20 wards of the City of Brisbane. The election resulted in 8 seats for Labor, 7 seats for Civic Reform, 3 seats for non-party progressives and 2 seats for National Citizens. The new council elected John William Greene as Lord Mayor.

zh.s: 1931年5月2日举行布里斯班市议会选举，为布里斯班市20个选区各选出议员。选举结果为：工党8席、市民改革党7席、无党派进步派3席、国家公民党2席。新一届议会选出约翰·威廉·格林担任市长。

en.s: The 1933 Los Angeles mayoral election took place on May 2, 1933, with a run-off election on June 6, 1933. Incumbent John Clinton Porter was defeated by Frank L. Shaw, a Los Angeles County Supervisor, in the runoff election. During the election, Shaw's citizenship was questioned as his birth records could not be located. Municipal elections in California, including Mayor of Los Angeles, are officially nonpartisan; candidates' party affiliations do not appear on the ballot.

zh.s: 1933年5月2日举行洛杉矶市长选举，6月6日举行第二轮投票。现任市长约翰·克林顿·波特在第二轮投票中败给洛杉矶县督察弗兰克·L·肖。选举期间，由于找不到出生记录，肖的公民身份受到质疑。加利福尼亚州的市政选举（包括洛杉矶市长选举）在法律上不分党派，选票上不列出候选人的党派归属。

en.s: The 1939 Baltimore mayoral election saw the reelection of Howard W. Jackson for a third consecutive and fourth overall term.

zh.s: 1939年巴尔的摩市长选举中，霍华德·W·杰克逊再次当选，这是他连续第三次、总计第四次当选市长。

en.s: The 1941 Iraqi coup d'état (Arabic: ثورة رشيد علي الكيلاني, Thawrah Rašīd ʿAlī al-Kaylānī), also called the Rashid Ali Al-Gaylani coup or the Golden Square coup, was a nationalist coup d'état in Iraq on 1 April 1941 that overthrew the pro-British regime of Regent 'Abd al-Ilah and his Prime Minister Nuri al-Said and installed Sharaf bin Rajeh as Regent and Rashid Ali al-Gaylani as Prime Minister.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1941年伊拉克政变又称拉希德·阿里·盖拉尼政变或“黄金广场政变”，是一场发生于1941年4月1日的伊拉克民族主义政变。政变推翻了亲英的摄政王阿卜杜勒·伊拉赫及其首相努里·赛义德，并让谢里夫·本·拉杰赫出任摄政王、拉希德·阿里·盖拉尼出任首相。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Japanese invasion of Cagayan de Oro
en.s: Japanese Invasion in Cagayan de Oro, (Filipino: Paglusob ng mga Hapones sa Cagayan de Oro, Cebuano: Pagsulong sa mga Hapon sa Cagayan de Oro) a military conflict during early days of World War II in the Philippines. It took place from May 6 to 12, 1942. Their main objective was to capture vital Del Monte Fields and link with Sakaguchi Detachment from the south via Sayre Highway.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 日军入侵卡加延德奥罗
zh.s: 日军入侵卡加延德奥罗（菲律宾语：Paglusob ng mga Hapones sa Cagayan de Oro；宿务语：Pagsulong sa mga Hapon sa Cagayan de Oro）是第二次世界大战初期发生在菲律宾的一场军事冲突，时间为1942年5月6日至12日。日军的主要目标是夺取重要的德尔蒙特机场，并经萨伊尔公路与南面的坂口支队会合。

loc: 澳大利亚北领地达尔文

en.s: The Japanese raid on Darwin of 2 May 1943 was a significant battle in the North Western Area Campaign of World War II. During the raid a force of over 20 Japanese bombers and Zero fighters attacked the Australian town of Darwin, Northern Territory, inflicting little damage on the ground. This attack was the 54th Japanese airstrike over Australia. The Royal Australian Air Force (RAAF) unit responsible for protecting the town, No. 1 Wing RAAF, intercepted the Japanese force after it had completed its attack, and suffered heavy losses from the Japanese fighters, aggravated by fuel shortages.

zh.s: 1943年5月2日，日本空袭达尔文，是第二次世界大战西北战区战役中的一场重要战斗。20多架日本轰炸机和零式战斗机袭击了澳大利亚北领地的达尔文镇，地面损失不大。这是日本对澳大利亚发动的第54次空袭。负责保护达尔文的澳大利亚皇家空军第1联队在日军完成攻击后拦截了来袭机群，但因日军战斗机攻击和燃油短缺而损失惨重。

en.s: The Battle of Berlin, designated as the Berlin Strategic Offensive Operation by the Soviet Union, and also known as the Fall of Berlin, was one of the last major offensives of the European theatre of World War II. After the Vistula–Oder Offensive of January–February 1945, the Red Army had temporarily halted on a line 60 km (37 mi) east of Berlin.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 柏林战役又称“柏林战略进攻行动”或“柏林陷落”，是第二次世界大战欧洲战场最后几场重大攻势之一。1945年1月至2月维斯瓦河—奥得河攻势结束后，红军暂时停在柏林以东60公里处。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The battle in Berlin was an end phase of the Battle of Berlin. While the Battle of Berlin encompassed the attack by three Soviet fronts (army groups) to capture not only Berlin but the territory of Germany east of the River Elbe still under German control, the battle in Berlin details the fighting and German capitulation that took place within the city.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 柏林市区战役是柏林战役的最后阶段。柏林战役包括苏联三个方面军（集团军群）的进攻，目标不仅是攻占柏林，也包括夺取仍由德国控制的易北河以东地区；柏林市区战役一词则专指在柏林城内发生的战斗和德军投降。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Crossbow was the code name in World War II for Anglo-American operations against the German long range reprisal weapons (V-weapons) programme. The primary V-weapons were the V-1 flying bomb and V-2 rocket, which were launched against Britain from 1944 to 1945 and used against continental European targets as well. Initial intelligence investigations in 1943 into the progress of German long range weapons were carried out under the code name Bodyline.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: “十字弓”是第二次世界大战期间英美联合行动的代号，行动针对德国远程报复性武器（V武器）计划。主要V武器包括V-1飞弹和V-2火箭；1944年至1945年间，它们从德国发射，攻击英国及欧洲大陆目标。1943年对德国远程武器进展的初步情报调查代号为“人体模型”。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Surrender at Caserta (Italian: Resa di Caserta, pronounced [ˈreːza di kaˈzɛrta, ˈreːsa -, - kaˈsɛrta]) of 29 April 1945 was the written agreement that formalized the surrender of German and Italian Fascist forces in Italy, ending the Italian Campaign of World War II.
en.n: This entry records the entry into force, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1945年4月29日签署的卡塞塔投降协定（意大利语：Resa di Caserta）是一份书面协议，正式确认驻意大利的德国军队和意大利法西斯军队投降，结束了第二次世界大战中的意大利战役。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的生效日期。

en.s: An election to the Aberdeen Corporation was held on 2 May 1950, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. 12 of the corporation's 37 seats were up for election. The election saw the Progressives regain one seat from Labour in the Gilcomston Ward and hold a one-seat majority on the council. The overall turnout for the election was 39.4%.

zh.s: 阿伯丁市政选举于1950年5月2日举行，与苏格兰各地市政选举同期进行。阿伯丁市政机构37个席位中有12席改选。进步党从工党手中夺回吉尔科姆斯顿选区的一席，并以1席多数继续掌控议会。总体投票率为39.4%。

en.s: The Election Commission of India held the first presidential elections of India on May 2, 1952. Dr. Rajendra Prasad won his first election with 507,400 votes over his nearest rival K. T. Shah who got 92,827 votes.

zh.s: 印度选举委员会于1952年5月2日举行印度首次总统选举。拉金德拉·普拉萨德博士以507,400票当选，击败最接近的对手K·T·沙阿，后者获得92,827票。

en.s: The 1953 FA Cup final, also known as the Matthews Final, was the eighth to be held at Wembley Stadium after the Second World War. The football match was contested between Blackpool and Bolton Wanderers, with Blackpool winning 4–3, equalling the record for the highest scoring FA Cup Final which had been set in the final of 1890.

zh.s: 1953年英格兰足总杯决赛也称“马修斯决赛”，是第二次世界大战后在温布利球场举行的第八场决赛。比赛由布莱克浦对阵博尔顿流浪者，布莱克浦以4比3获胜，追平了1890年决赛创下的足总杯决赛最高进球数纪录。

en.s: Faisal II (Arabic: الملك فيصل الثاني, romanized: al-Malik Fayṣal al-thānī; 2 May 1935 – 14 July 1958) was the last King of Iraq. He reigned from 4 April 1939 until July 1958, when he was killed during the 14 July Revolution. This regicide marked the end of the thirty-seven-year-old Hashemite monarchy in Iraq, which then became a republic.

zh.s: 费萨尔二世（阿拉伯语：الملك فيصل الثاني，转写：al-Malik Fayṣal al-thānī；1935年5月2日—1958年7月14日）是伊拉克末代国王。他自1939年4月4日起在位，直至1958年7月遇害。此次弑君事件结束了延续37年的哈希姆王朝统治，伊拉克随后成为共和国。

en.s: General elections were held in Turkey on 2 May 1954. The electoral system used was the multiple non-transferable vote. The result was a landslide victory for the Democrat Party, which won 503 of the 541 seats. Voter turnout was 88.6%.

zh.s: 土耳其于1954年5月2日举行大选。选举采用多票不可转让制。民主党大胜，赢得541个席位中的503席。投票率为88.6%。

en.s: Local elections were held in Taiwan in 1954, the second nation-wide elections in the post-war era of Taiwan, electing all 21 mayors of cities and magistrates of counties. The election for the Provisional Taiwan Provincial Council was held alongside the local elections to elect 57 councillors.

en.s: The 11th Cannes Film Festival took place from 2 to 18 May 1958. French writer Marcel Achard served as Jury President for the main competition. The Palme d'Or was awarded to The Cranes Are Flying by Mikhail Kalatozov.

en.s: The Hamilton by-election 1959 was a by-election held in the Hamilton electorate in Hamilton in the Waikato during the term of the 32nd New Zealand Parliament, on 2 May 1959. The by-election was caused by the death of incumbent MP Hilda Ross of the National Party on 6 March 1959. The by-election was won by Lance Adams-Schneider, also of the National Party.

zh.s: 新西兰第32届国会任期内，怀卡托汉密尔顿选区于1959年5月2日举行补选。在任国会议员、国家党成员希尔达·罗斯于1959年3月6日去世，引发此次补选。国家党候选人兰斯·亚当斯-施奈德胜出。

en.s: The 1959 Tasmanian state election was held on 2 May 1959 in the Australian state of Tasmania to elect 35 members of the Tasmanian House of Assembly. The number of members were increased from this election from 30 to 35. The election used the Hare-Clark proportional representation system — seven members were elected from each of five electorates. This change was at least party due to evidence presented by Dr.

zh.s: 1959年塔斯马尼亚州选举于1959年5月2日举行，选出澳大利亚塔斯马尼亚州众议院35名议员。自本次选举起，议席由30席增至35席。选举采用黑尔—克拉克比例代表制，5个选区各选出7名议员。席位增加至少部分源于乔治·豪厄特博士关于设立七席选区的证据。

en.s: The 1959 Bulgarian Cup final was the 19th final of the Bulgarian Cup (in this period the tournament was named Cup of the Soviet Army), and was contested between Levski Sofia and Spartak Plovdiv on 2 May 1959 at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia. Levski won the final 1–0.

zh.s: 1959年保加利亚杯决赛是该赛事第19届决赛。当时，这项赛事名为苏联军队杯。索菲亚列夫斯基队与普罗夫迪夫斯巴达克队于1959年5月2日在索菲亚的瓦西尔·列夫斯基国家体育场争夺冠军。列夫斯基以1比0获胜。

en.s: The 1959 FA Cup final was contested by Nottingham Forest and Luton Town at Wembley. Forest were playing in their second FA Cup final, while Luton were making their first final appearance in their history. Forest won 2–1 to win their second title, with goals from Roy Dwight and Tommy Wilson just four minutes apart. Dave Pacey scored Luton's consolation goal.

zh.s: 1959年英格兰足总杯决赛由诺丁汉森林对阵卢顿镇，在温布利球场举行。诺丁汉森林第二次闯入足总杯决赛，卢顿镇则是队史首次进入决赛。诺丁汉森林以2比1获胜，第二次夺冠。罗伊·德怀特和汤米·威尔逊在短短四分钟内接连进球，戴夫·佩西为卢顿镇打入挽回颜面的一球。

en.s: Elections to Edinburgh Corporation were held on 2 May 1961, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. Of the councils 69 seats, 23 were up for election. However, only 16 seats were contested, as councillors were returned unopposed in seven wards. Only one seat changed hands; Corstorphine ward was gained by the Liberal Party from the Progressive Party.

zh.s: 爱丁堡市政选举于1961年5月2日举行，与苏格兰各地市政选举同期进行。议会69个席位中有23席改选，但其中7个选区的议员未经竞争便当选，因此只有16席进行了投票。仅有一席易手：自由党从进步党手中赢得科斯托芬选区。

en.s: The 1962 European Cup final was a football match played at the Olympisch Stadion in Amsterdam, Netherlands on 2 May 1962 as the conclusion to the 1961–62 European Cup. The match was contested by the only two teams to have previously won the trophy – defending champions Benfica of Portugal and five-time winners Real Madrid of Spain. Benfica won the match 5–3 as they successfully defended their title.

zh.s: 1962年欧洲冠军杯决赛于1962年5月2日在荷兰阿姆斯特丹奥林匹克体育场举行，是1961—62赛季欧洲冠军杯的收官战。参赛双方是仅有的两支此前夺得过冠军的球队：卫冕冠军、葡萄牙本菲卡和五次夺冠的西班牙皇家马德里。本菲卡以5比3获胜，成功卫冕。

en.s: The attack on USNS Card was a Viet Cong (VC) operation during the Vietnam War. It took place in Saigon Port in the early hours of 2 May 1964, and was mounted by commandos from the 65th Special Operations Group (Vietnamese: Đội Biệt động 65). Card was first commissioned into the United States Navy during World War II.

zh.s: 对USNS Card号的袭击是越南战争期间越南南方民族解放阵线（越共）的一次行动。1964年5月2日凌晨，突击队员在西贡港发动袭击。行动由第65特种行动组（越南语：Đội Biệt động 65）执行。Card号最初于第二次世界大战期间在美国海军服役。

en.s: The 1964 FA Cup final was the 83rd final of the FA Cup. It took place on 2 May 1964 at Wembley Stadium and was contested between West Ham United and Preston North End. West Ham, captained by Bobby Moore and managed by Ron Greenwood, won the match 3–2 to win the FA Cup for the first time.

zh.s: 1964年英格兰足总杯决赛是该赛事第83届决赛。比赛于1964年5月2日在温布利球场举行，由西汉姆联对阵普雷斯顿北区。由鲍比·摩尔担任队长、罗恩·格林伍德担任主教练的西汉姆联以3比2获胜，首次夺得足总杯冠军。

en.s: The 1964 Tasmanian state election was held on 2 May 1964 in the Australian state of Tasmania to elect 35 members of the Tasmanian House of Assembly. The election used the Hare-Clark proportional representation system — seven members were elected from each of five electorates. The Labor Party, in power since 1934, was seeking a tenth term in office, and Premier Eric Reece was contesting his second election in that role, this time against Leader of the Opposition Angus Bethune of the Liberal Party.

zh.s: 1964年5月2日，澳大利亚塔斯马尼亚州举行州选举，选出塔斯马尼亚州众议院35名议员。选举采用黑尔-克拉克比例代表制，5个选区各选出7名议员。自1934年以来一直执政的工党力争第十个执政任期。州长埃里克·里斯以州长身份参加第二次选举，对手是自由党反对党领袖安格斯·贝思恩。

en.s: General elections were held in Liberia on 2 May 1967. In the presidential election, incumbent William Tubman of the True Whig Party was the only candidate, and was re-elected unopposed.

zh.s: 利比里亚于1967年5月2日举行大选。在总统选举中，现任真正辉格党总统威廉·塔布曼是唯一候选人，未经竞争便成功连任。

en.s: An Election to the Edinburgh Corporation was held on 2 May 1967, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. Of the councils 69 seats, 24 were up for election; two in Liberton and St. Andrew's wards, and one in every other ward. After the election, Edinburgh Corporation was composed of 37 Progressives, 29 Labour councillors, 2 Conservatives, and 1 Liberal. The Progressives increased their majority to five seats.

zh.s: 爱丁堡市政选举于1967年5月2日举行，与苏格兰各地市政选举同期进行。议会69个席位中有24席改选，其中利伯顿和圣安德鲁斯选区各改选2席，其他选区各改选1席。选举后，议会有37名进步党议员、29名工党议员、2名保守党议员和1名自由党议员。进步党的多数席位扩大到5席。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Sudan between 12 April and 2 May 1968. The election followed the resignation of a third of the members of the Assembly elected in 1965. The result was a victory for the new Democratic Unionist Party, formed by a merger of the National Unionist Party and the People's Democratic Party in December 1967 and led by President Ismail al-Azhari, which won 101 of the 218 seats. Voter turnout was 61.0%. In contrast, since the last election the Umma Party had fractured, with competing wings being led by Sadiq al-Mahdi and Imam al-Hadi al-Mahdi.

zh.s: 苏丹于1968年4月12日至5月2日举行议会选举。此前，1965年当选的议会中有三分之一成员辞职。新成立的民主统一党赢得选举。该党于1967年12月由民族统一党和人民民主党合并而成，由总统伊斯梅尔·阿兹哈里领导，赢得218个席位中的101席。投票率为61.0%。相比之下，乌玛党自上次选举后已经分裂，两个派别分别由萨迪克·马赫迪和伊玛目哈迪·马赫迪领导。

en.s: ALM Flight 980 was a regularly scheduled international passenger flight that originated in John F. Kennedy International Airport in New York City, to Princess Juliana International Airport in St. Maarten, Netherlands Antilles, on May 2, 1970. After several unsuccessful landing attempts, the aircraft's fuel was exhausted, and it made a forced water landing in the Caribbean Sea 48 km (30 mi; 26 nmi) off St.

zh.s: ALM 980号航班是定期国际客运航班，1970年5月2日从纽约市约翰·F·肯尼迪国际机场飞往荷属安的列斯群岛圣马丁岛的朱莉安娜公主国际机场。飞机多次尝试降落未果后燃油耗尽，最终在加勒比海迫降入水，地点距圣克罗伊岛48公里（30英里；26海里）。

en.s: An Election to the Edinburgh Corporation was held on 2 May 1972, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. Of the councils 69 seats, 23 were up for election. Following the election, with two by-elections pending, Edinburgh Corporation was composed of 33 Labour councillors, 21 Progressives, 9 Conservatives, and 5 Liberals. Labour did particularly well in the 1972 municipal elections across Scotland, and this was also the case in Edinburgh, where the party came close to gaining control of the council for the first time, controlling 33 of the councils 68 seats. The Liberals, with 5 seats, held the balance of power in the new council.

zh.s: 1972年5月2日，爱丁堡市政公司举行选举，苏格兰各地也同期举行地方选举。市政议会69个席位中有23席改选。选举结束后，尚有两场补选待举行，爱丁堡市政议会由33名工党议员、21名进步党议员、9名保守党议员和5名自由党议员组成。工党在1972年苏格兰地方选举中表现出色，爱丁堡也不例外。该党差一点就首次控制市政议会，并掌握了68个实际席位中的33席。自由党赢得5席，在新一届议会中掌握关键票。

en.s: A presidential primary was held in the U.S. state of Alabama on May 2, 1972 to elect delegates representing Alabama to the 1972 Democratic National Convention. To elect thirty-five of its thirty-seven pledged delegates, the state was divided into twenty-nine delegate districts based on population and Hubert Humphrey's performance in the state in 1968, which would each nominate a delegate. These twenty-nine delegates would then elect six at-large delegates.

zh.t: 1972年阿拉巴马州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 阿拉巴马州于1972年5月2日举行总统初选，选出代表该州参加1972年民主党全国代表大会的党代表。该州37名承诺代表中有35名通过初选产生。阿拉巴马州按人口以及休伯特·汉弗莱在1968年的得票表现划分为29个代表选区，每区选出一名代表；这29名代表随后再选出6名不分区代表。

en.s: An election to the Aberdeen Corporation was held on 2 May 1972, alongside municipal elections across Scotland. 12 of the corporation's 36 seats were up for election. The election saw no change in the seat composition of the corporation, with all incumbents winning reelection, and Labour candidate George Whyte replacing Dr. Norman Hogg as a councilor from Torry.

zh.s: 阿伯丁市政选举于1972年5月2日举行，与苏格兰各地市政选举同期进行。市政机构36个席位中有12席改选。席位组成没有变化，所有现任议员均成功连任；托里选区的工党候选人乔治·怀特则取代诺曼·霍格医生成为市议员。

en.s: The First Battle of Quảng Trị (Vietnamese: Chiến dịch Trị Thiên) resulted in the first major victory for the People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) during the Easter Offensive of 1972. Quảng Trị Province was a major battleground for the opposing forces during the Vietnam War. As South Vietnamese soldiers were gradually replacing their American counterparts, North Vietnam's General Văn Tiến Dũng was preparing to engage three of his divisions in the province.

zh.s: 第一次广治战役（越南语：Chiến dịch Trị Thiên）使越南人民军在1972年复活节攻势期间取得了首场重大胜利。广治省是越南战争期间交战双方的主要战场。随着南越军逐渐接替美军，北越将领文进勇正准备调动三个师投入该省作战。

en.s: The 1974 Redbridge Council election took place on 2 May 1974 to elect members of Redbridge London Borough Council in London, England. The whole council was up for election and the Conservative party stayed in overall control of the council.

zh.t: 1974年雷德布里奇伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 雷德布里奇议会选举于1974年5月2日举行，选出英格兰伦敦雷德布里奇自治市议会议员。议会全部席位改选，保守党继续掌控议会。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: On 2 May 1974 the Provisional Irish Republican Army (IRA) attacked a British Army base manned by the Ulster Defence Regiment (UDR) near the Northern Ireland–Republic of Ireland border at Clogher, County Tyrone. The IRA unit engaged the small base with automatic weapons, rockets and improvised mortars. Ferret armoured cars were deployed to the scene and a fierce firefight erupted. The IRA withdrew behind the border with the Republic.

zh.t: 克洛赫尔乌尔斯特防卫团军营遇袭
zh.s: 1974年5月2日，临时爱尔兰共和军袭击了英国陆军在克洛赫尔的一处基地，基地由乌尔斯特防卫团驻守，位于北爱尔兰蒂龙郡、靠近爱尔兰共和国边境。共和军成员使用自动武器、火箭和自制迫击炮攻击这处小型基地。鼬鼠装甲车随后赶到现场，双方爆发激烈交火。共和军撤回爱尔兰共和国一侧。

en.s: Local government elections took place in London, and some other parts of the United Kingdom on Thursday 2 May 1974. Ward changes took place which increased the total number of councillors by 4 from 1,863 to 1,867. All London borough council seats were up for election. The previous Borough elections in London were in 1971.

zh.s: 1974年5月2日（星期四），伦敦及英国其他部分地区举行地方政府选举。选区调整使议员总数增加4人，从1863人增至1867人。伦敦所有自治市议会席位均进行改选。此前，伦敦上一次举行自治市议会选举是在1971年。

en.t: 1974 Tower Hamlets London Borough Council election
en.s: Elections to Tower Hamlets London Borough Council were held on 2 May 1974. The whole council was up for election. Turnout was 18.3%.

zh.t: 1974年塔村伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 塔村伦敦自治市议会选举于1974年5月2日举行。议会全部席位均进行改选。投票率为18.3%。

en.s: Elections to Southwark Council were held in May 1974. The whole council was up for election. Turnout was 24.2%. This was the last local election to feature aldermen as well as councillors. Labour got all ten aldermen as well as 56 elected councillors.

zh.t: 1974年南华克伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 南华克议会选举于1974年5月举行，议会全部席位改选，投票率为24.2%。这是最后一次同时选举市议员和市参事的地方选举。工党赢得全部10个市参事席位和56个民选议员席位。

en.s: The Battle of Svay Rieng was the last major offensive operation of the Vietnam War to be mounted by the South Vietnamese Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN) against the North Vietnamese People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) forces.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 斯韦里恩战役是越南战争期间，越南共和国军对越南人民军发动的最后一次大规模攻势行动。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Legislative elections were held in Indonesia on 2 May 1977. They were the third legislative elections since independence, and the second under the New Order regime. There were three participants; the two political parties and functional group Golkar.

zh.s: 印度尼西亚于1977年5月2日举行立法选举。这是该国独立后的第三次立法选举，也是新秩序政权下的第二次选举。共有3个参选方：两个政党和名为戈尔卡的功能团体。

en.s: Regional elections were held in Scotland on Tuesday 2 May 1978, as part of the Local Government (Scotland) Act 1973. They saw a resurgence of support for the Labour Party, retaining control of Strathclyde and Fife and winning Central and Lothian.

zh.s: 苏格兰大区议会选举于1978年5月2日星期二举行，依据1973年《苏格兰地方政府法》进行。工党支持率回升，保住斯特拉斯克莱德和法夫大区的控制权，并赢得中央和洛锡安大区。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Elections to the Shetland Islands Council were held on 2 May 1978 as part of Scottish regional elections, with 11 seats uncontested. The election saw 14 new councillors enter the Shetland Islands Council, an unusually large number, in part attributable to the charged political context surrounding the devolution debate of the late 1970s.

zh.s: 设得兰群岛议会选举于1978年5月2日举行，是苏格兰大区选举的一部分，其中11个席位未经竞争便产生当选者。议会迎来14名新议员，人数异常多，部分原因是20世纪70年代末围绕地方自治权移交的政治辩论氛围紧张。

en.s: An election to Highland Regional Council was held on 2 May 1978 as part of the wider 1978 Scottish regional elections. The election saw Independents win control of 37 of the councils 47 seats.

zh.s: 高地大区议会选举于1978年5月2日举行，是当年苏格兰大区选举的一部分。独立人士赢得议会47席中的37席，取得控制权。

en.s: The second election to Fife Regional Council was held on 2 May 1978 as part of the wider 1978 Scottish regional elections. The election saw Labour maintaining their control of the region's 42 seat council.

zh.s: 法夫大区议会第二次选举于1978年5月2日举行，是当年苏格兰大区选举的一部分。工党继续掌控拥有42个席位的大区议会。

en.s: The 1978 Orkney Islands Council election, the second election to Orkney Islands Council, was held on 2 May 1978 as part of the wider 1978 Scottish regional elections. Only independent candidates contested the election and ten seats were uncontested.

zh.s: 奥克尼群岛议会第二次选举于1978年5月2日举行，是当年苏格兰大区选举的一部分。参选者均为独立人士，另有10个席位未经竞争便产生当选者。

en.s: The second election to Central Regional Council was held on 2 May 1978 as part of the wider 1978 Scottish regional elections.

zh.t: 1978年苏格兰中部地区议会选举
zh.s: 苏格兰中部地区议会第二次选举于1978年5月2日举行，是1978年苏格兰地区选举的一部分。

en.s: The 1978 election to Borders Regional Council took place on 2 May 1978 as part of the wider 1978 Scottish regional elections. There were 23 wards, each electing a single member using the first-past-the-post voting system.

zh.t: 1978年苏格兰边境地区议会选举
zh.s: 苏格兰边境地区议会选举于1978年5月2日举行，是1978年苏格兰地区选举的一部分。共有23个选区，每个选区采用简单多数制选出1名议员。

en.t: 1978 Dumfries and Galloway Regional Council election
en.s: The second Dumfries and Galloway regional council election was held on 2 May 1978, a year after the second district council elections. Turnout was down. Only 15 of the 35 wards in the region were contested.

zh.t: 1978年邓弗里斯和加洛韦地区议会选举
zh.s: 邓弗里斯和加洛韦地区议会第二次选举于1978年5月2日举行，距第二次区议会选举一年。投票率有所下降。该地区35个选区中只有15个举行了竞争性选举。

en.s: Elections to Strathclyde Regional Council were held on Tuesday 2 May 1978, on the same day as the eight other Scottish regional elections. This was the second election to the regional council following the local government reforms in 1974. The election was the last to use the 103 electoral divisions created by the Formation Electoral Arrangements in 1974. Each electoral division elected one councillor using first-past-the-post voting.

zh.t: 1978年斯特拉斯克莱德地区议会选举
zh.s: 斯特拉斯克莱德地区议会选举于1978年5月2日（星期二）举行，与苏格兰另外8个地区议会选举在同一天进行。这是1974年地方政府改革后该议会举行的第二次选举，也是最后一次使用1974年选区划分安排所设103个选区的选举。每个选区采用简单多数制选出1名议员。

en.s: The 1978 election to Grampian Regional Council took place on 2 May 1978 as part of the wider 1978 Scottish regional elections. There were 53 wards, each electing a single member using the first-past-the-post voting system.

zh.s: 格兰扁地区议会选举于1978年5月2日举行，是1978年苏格兰地区选举的一部分。共有53个选区，每个选区采用简单多数制选出1名议员。

en.s: The second election to Tayside Regional Council was held on 2 May 1978 as part of the wider 1978 Scottish regional elections. The election saw the Conservatives maintain their control of the region, gaining an absolute majority. Following the election, the Conservative former Lord Provost of Dundee, William K. Fitzgerald, became convener of the council.

zh.s: 泰赛德地区议会第二次选举于1978年5月2日举行，是1978年苏格兰地区选举的一部分。保守党继续控制该地区议会，并取得绝对多数。选举后，前邓迪市长、保守党人威廉·K·菲茨杰拉德出任议会召集人。

en.s: The 1981 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 1980–81 DFB-Pokal, the 38th season of Germany's knockout football cup competition. It was played on 2 May 1981 at the Neckarstadion in Stuttgart. Eintracht Frankfurt won the match 3–1 against 1. FC Kaiserslautern, to claim their 3rd cup title.

zh.s: 1981年德国足协杯决赛决出了1980至1981赛季德国足协杯冠军，是这项德国淘汰赛制足球赛事的第38届比赛。决赛于1981年5月2日在斯图加特内卡体育场举行。法兰克福以3比1击败凯泽斯劳滕，第三次夺得杯赛冠军。

loc: 福克兰群岛（马尔维纳斯群岛）

en.s: The Argentine cruiser ARA General Belgrano was sunk on May 2, 1982, by the British nuclear submarine HMS Conqueror during the Falklands War. The sinking led to the death of 323 Argentine sailors, almost half of all Argentine casualties during the conflict, and sparked controversy, as the attack occurred outside the exclusion zone established by the British government around the islands.

zh.t: 阿根廷海军将军贝尔格拉诺号巡洋舰沉没
zh.s: 1982年5月2日，英国核潜艇征服者号在福克兰群岛战争期间击沉阿根廷海军将军贝尔格拉诺号巡洋舰。323名阿根廷水兵遇难，几乎占阿根廷在这场冲突中全部伤亡的一半。由于袭击发生在英国政府划定的群岛周边禁区之外，此事引发争议。

en.s: Delhi Metropolitan Council election, 1983 was held in Indian National Capital Territory of Delhi to elect 56 councillors to the Delhi Metropolitan Council. This council had no legislative powers, but only an advisory role in administration of the territory.

zh.s: 1983年德里大都会委员会选举在印度德里国家首都辖区举行，选出56名德里大都会委员会委员。该委员会没有立法权，只在辖区行政事务中发挥咨询作用。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 1984 Bulgarian Cup final was the 44th final of the Bulgarian Cup, and was contested between Levski Sofia and Botev Plovdiv on 2 May 1984 at Druzhba Stadium in Kardzhali. Levski won the final 1–0.

zh.s: 1984年保加利亚杯决赛是该赛事第44届决赛。1984年5月2日，索菲亚列夫斯基队与普罗夫迪夫博特夫队在卡尔贾利的友谊体育场争夺冠军。列夫斯基以1比0获胜。

en.s: The 1985 Lincolnshire County Council election was held on Thursday, 2 May 1985. The whole council of 76 members was up for election and the election resulted in the Conservative Party retaining control of the council with a majority of 1, winning 39 seats.

zh.s: 林肯郡议会选举于1985年5月2日星期四举行，议会全部76个席位改选。保守党继续掌控议会，以39席取得1席多数。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1985 Nottinghamshire County Council election was held on Thursday, 2 May 1985. The whole council of eighty-eight members was up for election and the result was that the Labour Party retained control of the Council, winning forty-eight seats. The Conservatives won thirty-seven councillors and the SDP–Liberal Alliance made gains in terms of percentage vote share, but won just two seats.

zh.s: 诺丁汉郡议会选举于1985年5月2日星期四举行，议会全部88个席位改选。工党赢得48席，继续掌控议会；保守党赢得37席，社会民主党—自由党联盟的得票率有所上升，但仅赢得2席。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1985 Norfolk County Council election took place on 2 May 1985 to elect members of Norfolk County Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 诺福克郡议会选举于1985年5月2日举行，选出英格兰诺福克郡议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1985 Suffolk County Council election took place on 2 May 1985 to elect members of Suffolk County Council in Suffolk, England. It was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 萨福克郡议会选举于1985年5月2日举行，选出英格兰萨福克郡议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1985 United Kingdom local elections were held on Thursday 2 May 1985 in England and Wales, and Wednesday 15 May 1985 in Northern Ireland. Labour had the largest share of the vote in local council elections for the first time since 1981. Both Conservatives and Labour lost some seats to the Liberal-SDP Alliance, who were rebuilding with the SDP under the leadership of David Owen and enjoying strong showings — including a brief lead — in the opinion polls.

zh.s: 1985年英国地方选举于5月2日星期四在英格兰和威尔士举行，并于5月15日星期三在北爱尔兰举行。自1981年以来，工党首次在地方议会选举中获得最高得票率。保守党和工党均有一些席位被自由党—社会民主党联盟夺走。该联盟在戴维·欧文领导下重整社会民主党，并在民调中表现强劲，一度短暂领先。

en.s: The 1985 Cornwall County Council election for the Cornwall County Council was held on 2 May 1985, as part of the wider 1985 local elections.

zh.s: 康沃尔郡议会选举于1985年5月2日举行，是当年英国地方选举的一部分。

en.s: Local elections to Northumberland County Council, a county council in the north east of England, were held on 2 May 1985. The Labour Party lost overall control of the council, which fell under no overall control.

zh.s: 诺森伯兰郡议会选举于1985年5月2日举行。工党失去议会控制权，选举后没有任何政党占多数。

en.s: Elections to Cumbria County Council were held on 2 May 1985. This was on the same day as other UK county council elections. The whole council of 83 members was up for election and the Labour Party lost control of the council, which fell under no overall control.

zh.s: 坎布里亚郡议会选举于1985年5月2日举行，与英国其他郡议会选举同日进行。议会全部83个席位改选。工党失去议会控制权，选举后没有任何政党占多数。

en.s: The 1985 Essex County Council election took place on 2 May 1985 as part of the 1985 United Kingdom local elections. 98 councillors were elected from various electoral divisions, which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office.

zh.s: 埃塞克斯郡议会选举于1985年5月2日举行，是1985年英国地方选举的一部分。98名议员从多个选区中选出，各选区选出一至两名郡议会议员，采用简单多数制，任期四年。

en.s: The 1985 Ontario general election was held on May 2, 1985, to elect members to the Legislative Assembly of Ontario in the province of Ontario, Canada. The Progressive Conservatives won the most seats, but came short of a majority, and lost the popular vote to the Liberals. This left the NDP with the balance of power in the 33rd Legislative Assembly of Ontario.

zh.s: 1985年安大略省大选于1985年5月2日举行，选出加拿大安大略省立法议会议员。进步保守党赢得最多席位，但未能取得多数，且得票数低于自由党。因此，在安大略省第33届立法议会中，新民主党掌握关键席位。

en.s: The 1985 East Sussex County Council election took place on 2 May 1985 to elect members to East Sussex County Council in East Sussex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 东萨塞克斯郡议会选举于1985年5月2日举行，选出英格兰东萨塞克斯郡议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1985 Hertfordshire County Council election took place on 2 May 1985 to elect members of Hertfordshire County Council in Hertfordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 赫特福德郡议会选举于1985年5月2日举行，选出英格兰赫特福德郡议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1986 Soviet Cup final was a football match that took place at the Lenin's Central Stadium, Moscow on May 2, 1986. The match was the 45th Soviet Cup Final and it was contested by FC Torpedo Moscow and FC Shakhtar Donetsk. The Soviet Cup winner Torpedo won the cup for the sixth time.

zh.s: 1986年5月2日，列宁中央体育场（莫斯科）举行苏联杯足球决赛。这是第45届苏联杯决赛，对阵双方是莫斯科鱼雷队和顿涅茨克矿工队。莫斯科鱼雷队获胜，第六次夺得苏联杯冠军。

en.s: The 1986 European Cup Winners' Cup Final was a football match contested between Atlético Madrid of Spain and FC Dynamo Kyiv of the Soviet Union. It was the final match of the 1985–86 European Cup Winners' Cup and the 26th competition final. The final game was held at Stade de Gerland in Lyon, France. Kyiv won the match 3–0 thanks to goals by Aleksandr Zavarov, Oleg Blokhin and Vadim Yevtushenko.

zh.s: 1986年欧洲优胜者杯决赛由西班牙马德里竞技对阵苏联基辅迪纳摩。这是1985—86赛季欧洲优胜者杯的最后一场比赛，也是该项赛事第26届决赛。决赛在法国里昂的热尔兰球场举行。基辅迪纳摩凭借亚历山大·扎瓦罗夫、奥列格·布洛欣和瓦迪姆·叶夫图申科的进球，以3比0获胜。

en.s: Operation Law and Order was a 1988 Israeli military operation against a Hezbollah base in the village of Maydoun.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 法律与秩序行动是以色列于1988年在黎巴嫩迈敦村针对真主党基地展开的军事行动。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The 1990 Soviet Cup final was a football match that took place at Lenin's Central Stadium, Moscow on 2 May 1990. The match was the 49th Soviet Cup Final and it was contested by FC Dynamo Kyiv (I tier) and FC Lokomotiv Moscow (II tier). The Soviet Cup winner Dynamo qualified for the Cup Winners' Cup first round for the Soviet Union.

zh.s: 1990年苏联杯决赛于1990年5月2日在莫斯科列宁中央体育场举行。这是一场足球比赛，也是第49届苏联杯决赛，对阵双方是基辅迪纳摩（顶级联赛）和莫斯科火车头（二级联赛）。苏联杯冠军基辅迪纳摩因此获得代表苏联参加优胜者杯首轮的资格。

en.s: The 1990 Cupa României final was the 52nd final of Romania's most prestigious football cup competition. It was disputed between Dinamo București and Steaua București, and was won by Dinamo București after a game with ten goals. It was the seventh cup for Dinamo București.

zh.s: 1990年罗马尼亚杯决赛是罗马尼亚最重要的足球杯赛第52届决赛，由布加勒斯特迪纳摩对阵布加勒斯特星队。双方在一场打入10球的比赛后，布加勒斯特迪纳摩获胜，这是该队第七次夺得杯赛冠军。

en.s: The Battle of Borovo Selo on 2 May 1991 (known in Croatia as the Borovo Selo massacre, Croatian: Pokolj u Borovom Selu and in Serbia as the Borovo Selo incident, Serbian: Инцидент у Боровом Селу) was one of the first armed clashes in the conflict which became known as the Croatian War of Independence. The clash was precipitated by months of rising ethnic tensions, violence, and armed combat in Pakrac and at the Plitvice Lakes in March. The immediate cause for the confrontation in the heavily ethnic Serb village of Borovo Selo, just north of Vukovar, was a failed attempt to replace a Yugoslav flag in the village with a Croatian one by four Croatian policemen.

zh.s: 1991年5月2日发生的博罗沃村战役，是后来被称为克罗地亚独立战争的冲突中的最早几次武装交火之一。在克罗地亚，这场冲突被称为“博罗沃村大屠杀”（克罗地亚语：Pokolj u Borovom Selu）；在塞尔维亚，则称为“博罗沃村事件”（塞尔维亚语：Инцидент у Боровом Селу）。此前数月，帕克拉茨和十六湖地区在3月发生冲突，族群紧张、暴力和武装交火不断升级。直接导火索是：四名克罗地亚警察试图把村里的南斯拉夫国旗换成克罗地亚国旗，但没有成功。事发的博罗沃村是一个塞族居民占多数的村庄，位于武科瓦尔以北。

en.s: The 1991 Bristol City Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of Bristol City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of seats were up for election. Two seats were contested in Windmill Hill due to an extra vacancy occurring. There was a general swing against the Conservatives.

zh.s: 布里斯托市议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰布里斯托市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位改选。风车山选区因多出一个空缺，需选出两名议员。保守党整体支持率下滑。

en.s: Elections to Trafford Council were held on 2 May 1991. One-third of the council was up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a four-year term of office, expiring in 1995. The Conservative party retained overall control of the council.

zh.t: 1991年特拉福德都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 特拉福德议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，议会三分之一席位改选。当选议员任期四年，于1995年届满。保守党继续掌控议会。

en.s: Elections to Manchester Council were held on Thursday, 2 May 1991. One third of the council was up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a four-year term of office, expiring in 1995. The Labour Party retained overall control of the Council.

zh.s: 曼彻斯特议会选举于1991年5月2日星期四举行，议会三分之一席位改选。当选议员任期四年，于1995年届满。工党继续掌控议会。

en.s: Elections to Sheffield City Council were held on 2 May 1991. One third of the council was up for election. Since the previous election, Richard Old had defected from the Conservatives, sitting as an Independent Conservative. His failure to win re-election for the Ecclesall ward returned them to 11 seats.

zh.s: 谢菲尔德市议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，议会三分之一席位改选。上次选举后，理查德·奥尔脱离保守党，以独立保守党人身份任职。他未能在埃克尔斯尔选区连任，使保守党席位数恢复到11席。

en.s: The 1991 Basildon District Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of Basildon District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of the council was up for election; the seats which were last contested in 1987. An addition seat was up for election in Fryerns Central ward.

zh.s: 巴西尔登区议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡巴西尔登区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位改选，这些席位上次改选是在1987年。弗赖恩斯中央选区另有一席进行改选。

en.s: The 1991 Peterborough City Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of Peterborough City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 彼得伯勒市议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰彼得伯勒市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1991 East Northamptonshire District Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of East Northamptonshire District Council in Northamptonshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. This was the first election to be held under new ward boundaries. The Conservative Party retained overall control of the council which it had held since the council's creation in 1973.

zh.t: 1991年东北安普敦郡区议会选举
zh.s: 东北安普敦郡区议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰北安普敦郡东北安普敦郡区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。这是首次按新的选区边界举行选举。保守党继续掌控议会，该党自1973年议会成立以来一直执政。

en.s: The 1991 Epping Forest District Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of Epping Forest District Council in Essex, England. 20 members of Epping Forest District Council in Essex were elected. The council remained under Conservative majority control.

zh.s: 埃平森林区议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡埃平森林区议会议员，共选出20名议员。保守党继续以多数席位掌控议会。

en.s: The 1991 Cardiff City Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 1991 to the district council of Cardiff in South Glamorgan, Wales. It took place on the same day as other district council elections in Wales and England. The Labour Party regained a majority on Cardiff City Council, after sharing government for the previous four years. The previous Cardiff City Council election took place in 1987.

zh.s: 加的夫市议会选举于1991年5月2日星期四举行，选举威尔士南格拉摩根郡加的夫区议会议员，与英格兰和威尔士其他区议会选举同期进行。工党重新取得加的夫市议会多数席位，此前四年一直与其他党派共同执政。上一次加的夫市议会选举于1987年举行。

en.s: The 1991 Mid Suffolk District Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of Mid Suffolk District Council in Suffolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 中萨福克区议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰萨福克郡中萨福克区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1991 Breckland District Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of Breckland District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 布雷克兰区议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰布雷克兰区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1991 York City Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of York City Council in North Yorkshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 约克市议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰北约克郡约克市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: Local elections in Wales were held on 2 May 1991 to elect members to the 37 district councils. They were held alongside other local elections in the United Kingdom. The previous elections to the upper-tier counties were held in 1989, while the previous election to the second-level districts were held in 1987.

zh.s: 威尔士于1991年5月2日举行地方选举，选出37个区议会议员，与英国其他地方选举同期进行。此前，上一级郡议会选举于1989年举行，第二级区议会选举于1987年举行。

en.t: 1991 King's Lynn and West Norfolk Borough Council election
en.s: The 1991 King's Lynn & West Norfolk Borough Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of King's Lynn & West Norfolk Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 1991年金斯林和西诺福克自治市议会选举
zh.s: 金斯林和西诺福克自治市议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰金斯林和西诺福克自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1991 Harlow District Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of Harlow District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party retained control of the council, which it had held continuously since the council's creation in 1973.

zh.s: 哈洛区议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡哈洛区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。工党继续掌控议会，该党自1973年议会成立以来一直执政。

en.s: Elections to Erewash Borough Council were held on 2 May 1991 as part of nationwide local elections. The election saw the Labour Party gain control of the Council for the first time since 1976.

zh.t: 1991年埃里沃什自治市议会选举
zh.s: 埃里沃什自治市议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，是英国全国地方选举的一部分。工党在本次选举中首次自1976年以来取得议会控制权。

en.s: The 1991 Uttlesford District Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of Uttlesford District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 1991年厄特尔斯福德区议会选举
zh.s: 厄特尔斯福德区议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰厄特尔斯福德区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1991 Thurrock Borough Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of Thurrock Borough Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England.

zh.s: 瑟罗克自治市议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡瑟罗克自治市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1991 Stevenage Borough Council election took place on 2 May 1991. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of the council was up for election; the seats which were last contested in 1987. The Labour Party retained control of the council, which it had held continuously since its creation in 1973.

zh.t: 1991年斯蒂夫尼奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 斯蒂夫尼奇自治市议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位改选，这些席位上次改选是在1987年。工党继续掌控议会，该党自1973年议会成立以来一直执政。

en.s: The 1991 Worthing Borough Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of Worthing Borough Council in West Sussex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 沃辛自治市议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰西萨塞克斯郡沃辛自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1991 Chester City Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of Chester City Council in Cheshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 切斯特市议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰柴郡切斯特市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1991 Cambridge City Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of Cambridge City Council in Cambridge, Cambridgeshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England.

zh.s: 剑桥市议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰剑桥郡剑桥市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1991 Exeter City Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of Exeter City Council in Devon, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 埃克塞特市议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰德文郡埃克塞特市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1991 North Norfolk District Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of North Norfolk District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 北诺福克区议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰北诺福克区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1991 Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This election was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 1991年威勒尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 威勒尔都市自治市议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰威勒尔都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1991 Wansdyke Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 1991 to elect councillors to Wansdyke District Council in England. It took place on the same day as other district council elections in the United Kingdom. These were the final elections of the district council, before its abolition on 1 April 1996 when it was merged with Bath City Council to form Bath and North East Somerset Council.

zh.s: 旺斯代克区议会选举于1991年5月2日星期四举行，选出英格兰旺斯代克区议会议员，与英国其他区议会选举同日进行。这是该区议会最后一次选举；1996年4月1日，旺斯代克区议会撤销并与巴斯市议会合并，成立巴斯和东北萨默塞特议会。

en.s: The 1991 Chelmsford Borough Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of Chelmsford Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 1991年切姆斯福德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 切姆斯福德自治市议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰切姆斯福德自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1991 Bath City Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 1991 to elect councillors to Bath City Council in England. It took place on the same day as other district council elections in the United Kingdom. One third of seats were up for election. Two seats were contested in Bathwick due to an extra vacancy occurring.

zh.s: 巴斯市议会选举于1991年5月2日星期四举行，选出英格兰巴斯市议会议员，与英国其他区议会选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位改选。巴斯威克选区因多出一个空缺，需选出两名议员。

en.s: The 1991 Bournemouth Borough Council election was held on 2 May 1991 to elect members to Bournemouth Borough Council in Dorset, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Conservatives lost control of the council to No overall control, with the Liberal Democrats (the successor to the Alliance) emerging as the largest party and one seat away from a majority.

zh.t: 1991年伯恩茅斯自治市议会选举
zh.s: 伯恩茅斯自治市议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰多塞特郡伯恩茅斯自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。保守党失去议会控制权，选举后没有任何政党占多数。自由民主党（自由党与社会民主党联盟的继承者）成为议会最大党，距取得多数还差一席。

en.s: The 1991 United Kingdom local elections were held on Thursday 2 May 1991. The results were a setback for the governing Conservative Party, who were left with their lowest number of councillors since 1973, though their popular vote was an improvement from the 1990 local elections. This was the first electoral test for Prime Minister and Conservative leader John Major, who had taken the helm from Margaret Thatcher in November 1990.

zh.s: 1991年英国地方选举于1991年5月2日星期四举行。保守党政府在选举中受挫，议员人数降至1973年以来最低水平，但得票率较1990年地方选举有所提高。这是保守党首相兼党领袖约翰·梅杰首次接受选举考验；他于1990年11月接替玛格丽特·撒切尔。

en.s: The 1991 Tendring District Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of Tendring District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. At the election, the Liberal Democrats emerged as the largest party on the council for the first time since its creation in 1973. The Conservatives fell to second placed and Labour recovered their position to become the third largest party.

zh.s: 滕德灵区议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰滕德灵区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。自由民主党首次成为议会最大党，该党自1973年议会成立以来还从未做到这一点。保守党退居第二，工党则恢复实力，成为第三大党。

en.s: The 1991 Braintree District Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of Braintree District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 布伦特里区议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰布伦特里区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1991 Corby District Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of Corby District Council in Northamptonshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party retained overall control of the council, which it had held since 1979.

zh.s: 科比区议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰北安普敦郡科比区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。工党继续掌控议会，该党自1979年以来一直执政。

en.s: The 1991 Southend-on-Sea Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of Southend-on-Sea Borough Council in Essex, England. One third of the council was up for election.

zh.t: 1991年滨海绍森德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 滨海绍森德议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡滨海绍森德自治市议会议员。议会三分之一席位改选。

en.s: The 1991 Reading Borough Council election was held on 2 May 1991, at the same time as other local elections across England and Wales. One third of Reading Borough Council's 45 seats were up for election. Since the previous election in 1990, the Conservative group on the council had split, with councillors Hamza Fuad and Pam Fuad forming their own independent group, the "Thames Conservatives", reducing the official Conservative numbers from 13 to 11.

zh.s: 雷丁自治市议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，与英格兰和威尔士其他地方选举同期进行。雷丁自治市议会45个席位中有三分之一改选。自1990年上次选举以来，议会中的保守党党团分裂，议员哈姆扎·福阿德和帕姆·福阿德另组独立党团“泰晤士保守党”，使官方保守党议员人数从13人降至11人。

en.s: The 1991 Horsham District Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of Horsham District Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. The Conservatives retained control of the council with a reduced majority. The Liberal Democrats gained a net total of 7 and Independent candidates had 2 councillors elected.

zh.s: 霍舍姆区议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰霍舍姆区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。保守党继续掌控议会，但多数席位减少。自由民主党净增7席，另有2名独立候选人当选。

en.s: The 1991 West Dorset District Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 1991 to elect councillors to West Dorset District Council in England. It took place on the same day as other district council elections in the United Kingdom. The entire council was up for election. District boundary changes took place before the election but the number of seats remained the same.

zh.s: 西多塞特区议会选举于1991年5月2日星期四举行，选出英格兰西多塞特区议会议员，与英国其他区议会选举同期进行。议会全部席位改选。选前调整了区界，但席位总数不变。

en.s: The 1991 Plymouth City Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of Plymouth City Council in Devon, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party gained control of the council from the Conservative Party, who had held it since its creation in 1973.

zh.s: 普利茅斯市议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰德文郡普利茅斯市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。工党从保守党手中夺得议会控制权；保守党自1973年议会成立以来一直执政。

en.s: Elections to Barnsley Metropolitan Borough Council were held on 2 May 1991, with one third of the council up for election. Prior to the election, the defending councillor in Penistone West had changed their affiliation from Residents to Independent, ending the Residents presence on the council that had endured since its creation in 1973. The election resulted in Labour retaining control of the council.

zh.t: 1991年巴恩斯利都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 巴恩斯利都市自治市议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，议会三分之一席位改选。选前，佩尼斯通西选区现任议员从居民党转为独立人士，结束了居民党自1973年议会成立以来一直有议员的局面。工党继续掌控议会。

en.s: The 1991 Bracknell Forest Borough Council election took place on 2 May 1991, to elect all 40 members in 19 wards for Bracknell Forest Borough Council in England. The election was held on the same day as other local elections as part of the 1991 United Kingdom local elections. For the first time since 1979, opposition parties re-entered the council at an all-out council election, but the Conservative Party still managed to secure a landslide victory.

zh.t: 1991年布拉克内尔森林自治市议会选举
zh.s: 布拉克内尔森林自治市议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰布拉克内尔森林自治市议会19个选区的全部40名议员，是英国1991年地方选举的一部分。自1979年以来，反对党首次在全体改选中重返议会，但保守党仍取得压倒性胜利。

en.s: The 1991 Derby City Council election took place on 2 May 1991 to elect members of Derby City Council in England. Local elections were held in the United Kingdom in 1991. This was on the same day as other local elections. 15 of the council's 44 seats were up for election. The council, which had previously been under Conservative control, fell under no overall control with the Conservatives and Labour holding exactly half the seats each.

zh.s: 德比市议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，选出英格兰德比市议会议员，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。议会44个席位中有15席改选。议会此前由保守党掌控，选举后没有任何政党占多数，保守党和工党各占一半席位。

en.s: Elections to Liverpool City Council were held on 2 May 1991. One third of the council was up for election and the Labour Party kept overall control of the council.

zh.s: 利物浦市议会选举于1991年5月2日举行。议会三分之一席位进行改选，工党保住了议会的总体控制权。

en.s: Elections to Mid Bedfordshire District Council were held on 2 May 1991. All 53 seats were up for election.

zh.t: 1991年中贝德福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 中贝德福德郡区议会选举于1991年5月2日举行。全部53个席位均进行改选。

en.s: The 1991 City of Lincoln Council election took place on 2 May 1991. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of the council was up for election: the seats of which were last contested in 1987. The Labour Party retained control of the council.

zh.s: 林肯市议会选举于1991年5月2日举行，与其他地方选举在同一天进行。议会三分之一席位改选，这些席位上次于1987年改选。工党继续控制议会。

en.s: The 1991 North Hertfordshire District Council election was held on 2 May 1991, at the same time as other local elections across England and Wales. There were 17 out of 50 seats on North Hertfordshire District Council up for election, being the usual third of the council. The Conservatives made a net loss of three seats, and only narrowly retained their majority on the council.

zh.t: 1991年北赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 1991年5月2日举行北赫特福德郡区议会选举，与英格兰和威尔士其他地方选举同期进行。议会50席中有17席改选，通常为议会三分之一席位。保守党净失3席，仅以微弱优势保住议会多数。

en.s: The 1991 Ipswich Borough Council election was an election to the Ipswich Borough Council under the arrangement, whereby a third of the councillors were to stand for election, each time. It took place as part of the 1991 United Kingdom local elections. There were 16 wards each returning one councillor plus one bye-election for Town Ward. The Labour Party retained control of the Council.

zh.t: 1991年伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1991年伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举按照每次改选约三分之一议员的安排举行，也是1991年英国地方选举的一部分。16个选区各选出一名议员，此外，汤镇选区还举行了一场补选。工党继续控制议会。

en.s: The 1995 East Northamptonshire District Council election took place on 2 May 1995 to elect members of East Northamptonshire District Council in Northamptonshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. This was the first election to be held under new ward boundaries. The Labour Party gained overall control of the council for the first and only time in the council's history.

zh.t: 1995年东北安普敦郡区议会选举
zh.s: 东北安普敦郡区议会选举于1995年5月2日举行，选出英格兰北安普敦郡东北安普敦郡区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。这是首次按新的选区边界举行选举。工党在议会历史上首次、也是唯一一次取得多数席位并掌控议会。

en.s: The 1995 Las Vegas mayoral election took place on May 2, 1995, to elect the mayor of Las Vegas, Nevada. The election was held concurrently with various other local elections, and was officially nonpartisan. Incumbent Mayor Jan Laverty Jones was reelected. With Jones winning a majority in the initial round of the election, no runoff was needed.

zh.s: 拉斯维加斯市长选举于1995年5月2日举行。选举与其他地方选举同期进行，依法不设党派标签。现任市长简·拉弗蒂·琼斯成功连任。她在首轮投票中赢得多数，因此没有举行决选。

en.s: The Zagreb rocket attacks were two rocket attacks conducted by the Army of the Republic of Serbian Krajina that used multiple rocket launchers to strike the Croatian capital of Zagreb during the Croatian War of Independence. The attack killed seven and wounded over 200 Croatian and foreign civilians. The missile attack was carried out on 2 May and 3 May 1995 as retaliation for the Croatian army's offensive in Operation Flash.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 塞尔维亚克拉伊纳共和国军在克罗地亚独立战争期间两次使用多管火箭炮袭击克罗地亚首都萨格勒布，造成7人死亡、200多名克罗地亚和外国平民受伤。袭击发生于1995年5月2日和3日，是对克罗地亚军队“闪电行动”的报复。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: The 1995 Denver mayoral election took place on took place on June 6, 1995, following a primary election on May 2, 1995. Incumbent Mayor Wellington Webb ran for re-election to a second term. He was challenged by City Councilwoman Mary DeGroot, City Auditor Bob Crider, and attorney John Frew. Webb's administration supervised the construction of the Denver International Airport, but repeated delays in the airport's opening attracted criticism in the lead-up to the 1995 election.
en.n: This entry records the primary, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1995年丹佛市长选举于1995年6月6日举行，初选则在同年5月2日举行。时任市长韦灵顿·韦布竞选连任，争取第二个任期。挑战者包括市议员玛丽·德格鲁特、市审计长鲍勃·克赖德和律师约翰·弗鲁。韦布政府负责丹佛国际机场的建设，但机场多次延期开航，在1995年选举前引发批评。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的初选日期。

en.s: The eleventh legislative assembly election of Tamil Nadu was held on 2 May 1996. The Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) led front won the election and its leader M. Karunanidhi, became the chief minister.This was his fourth term in office. S.Balakrishnan, also known as So.Balakrishnan, of Tamil Maanila Congress (TMC) became the Leader of the Opposition. The incumbent Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (ADMK) government was defeated in a landslide with its leader and outgoing chief minister J. Jayalalitha losing the election from the Bargur constituency.

zh.t: 1996年泰米尔纳德邦立法议会选举
zh.s: 泰米尔纳德邦第11届立法议会选举于1996年5月2日举行。德拉维达进步联盟（DMK）领导的阵营赢得选举，该党领袖M.卡鲁纳尼迪出任首席部长，这是他第四次担任这一职务。泰米尔马尼拉国大党（TMC）的S.巴拉克里希南（又称So.巴拉克里希南）成为反对党领袖。执政的安娜德拉维达进步联盟（ADMK）政府以压倒性劣势落败；该党领袖、即将卸任的首席部长J.贾亚拉利塔也在巴尔古尔选区败选。

en.s: Elections to Stevenage Council were held on 2 May 1996. One third of the council was up for election and the Labour party stayed in overall control of the council. The council was one of a number where the Conservatives lost their last seats.

zh.t: 1996年斯蒂夫尼奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 斯蒂夫尼奇议会选举于1996年5月2日举行，议会三分之一席位改选。工党继续掌控议会。斯蒂夫尼奇是保守党失去最后几个席位之一的地方。

en.s: Elections to Manchester Council were held on Thursday, 2 May 1996. One third of the council was up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a four-year term of office, expiring in 2000. There were also two vacancies being contested; one in Blackley and the other in Woodhouse Park. The Labour Party retained overall control of the Council.

zh.s: 曼彻斯特议会选举于1996年5月2日星期四举行，议会三分之一席位改选。当选议员任期四年，于2000年届满。此外，布莱克利和伍德豪斯公园两个空缺席位也进行补选。工党继续掌控议会。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Elections to Trafford Council were held on 2 May 1996. One-third of the council was up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a four-year term of office, expiring in 2000. The Labour Party gained overall control of the council, from no overall control.

zh.t: 1996年特拉福德都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 特拉福德议会选举于1996年5月2日举行，议会三分之一席位改选。当选议员任期四年，于2000年届满。工党从没有多数党掌控的议会中取得多数席位，获得议会控制权。
