en.s: The 1996 Exeter City Council election took place on 2 May 1996 to elect members of Exeter City Council in Devon, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 埃克塞特市议会选举于1996年5月2日举行，选出英格兰德文郡埃克塞特市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1996 Derby City Council election took place on 2 May 1996 to elect members of Derby City Council in England. Local elections were held in the United Kingdom in 1996. This was on the same day as other local elections. This election was held ahead of Derby City Council becoming a unitary authority on 1 April 1997.

zh.s: 德比市议会选举于1996年5月2日举行，选出英格兰德比市议会议员，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。这次选举在1997年4月1日德比市议会成为单一制地方政府之前举行。

en.s: The 1996 Basildon District Council election took place on 2 May 1996 to elect members of Basildon District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of the council was up for election; the seats which were last contested in 1992. The Labour Party gained control of the council, which had previously been under no overall control, for the first time since 1991.

zh.s: 巴西尔登区议会选举于1996年5月2日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡巴西尔登区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位改选，这些席位上次改选是在1992年。工党从没有多数党掌控的议会中取得控制权，这是该党自1991年以来首次掌控议会。

en.s: The 1996 Epping Forest District Council election took place on 2 May 1996 to elect members of Epping Forest District Council in Essex, England. 20 members of Epping Forest District Council in Essex were elected, alongside one by-election in Loughton Roding. The council remained in no overall control allowing Labour, as the largest party, to join into a coalition with the Liberal Democrats who had experiences significant gains and beat the Conservatives into third place across the district in terms of seats.

zh.s: 埃平森林区议会选举于1996年5月2日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡埃平森林区议会议员，共选出20名议员。此外，卢顿罗丁选区还举行了一场补选。选举后，议会仍没有任何政党占多数。工党是议会最大党，与自由民主党组成联合政府。自由民主党大幅增加席位，在席位数上超过保守党，成为第二大党。

en.s: The 1996 Reading Borough Council election was held on 2 May 1996, at the same time as other local elections across England. Sixteen of the 45 seats on Reading Borough Council were up for election, being the usual third of the council (15 seats) plus a by-election in Redlands ward, where Labour councillor Tony Jones had resigned.

zh.s: 雷丁自治市议会选举于1996年5月2日举行，与英格兰其他地方选举同期进行。雷丁自治市议会45个席位中有16席改选，其中包括通常应改选的三分之一席位（15席），以及雷德兰兹选区的一场补选。工党议员托尼·琼斯此前辞职，因此举行补选。

en.s: The 1996 Colchester Borough Council election took place on 2 May 1996 to elect members to Colchester Borough Council in Essex, England. They were held on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom. The Liberal Democrats maintained their majority on the council. The Labour Party made a net gain of 4 seats to displace the Conservatives as the official opposition.

zh.t: 1996年科尔切斯特自治市议会选举
zh.s: 科尔切斯特自治市议会选举于1996年5月2日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡科尔切斯特自治市议会议员，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。自由民主党保住议会多数。工党净增4席，取代保守党成为官方反对党。

en.s: The 1996 Harlow District Council election took place on 2 May 1996 to elect members of Harlow District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party retained control of the council, which it had held continuously since the council's creation in 1973.

zh.s: 哈洛区议会选举于1996年5月2日举行，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡哈洛区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。工党继续掌控议会，该党自1973年议会成立以来一直执政。

en.s: The 1996 Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 2 May 1996 to elect members of Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This election was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 1996年威勒尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 威勒尔都市自治市议会选举于1996年5月2日举行，选出英格兰威勒尔都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1996 Peterborough City Council election took place on 2 May 1996 to elect members of Peterborough City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 彼得伯勒市议会选举于1996年5月2日举行，选出英格兰彼得伯勒市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1996 Cambridge City Council election took place on 2 May 1996 to elect members of Cambridge City Council in Cambridge, Cambridgeshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England.

zh.s: 剑桥市议会选举于1996年5月2日举行，选出英格兰剑桥郡剑桥市议会议员，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: Elections to Rochford Council were held on 2 May 1996. One third of the council was up for election.

zh.s: 罗奇福德议会选举于1996年5月2日举行，议会三分之一席位改选。

en.s: The 1996 Chester City Council election took place on 2 May 1996 to elect members of Chester City Council in Cheshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 切斯特市议会选举于1996年5月2日举行，选出英格兰柴郡切斯特市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1996 Worthing Borough Council election took place on 2 May 1996 to elect members of Worthing Borough Council in West Sussex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 沃辛自治市议会选举于1996年5月2日举行，选出英格兰西萨塞克斯郡沃辛自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 1996 United Kingdom local elections were held on 2 May 1996. They were the last local elections until 2010 to show a decline in the number of Conservative councillors and an increase in the number of Labour councillors. The main opposition Labour Party gained 468 seats, bringing their number of councillors to 10,929. Their share of the vote was projected to be 43%, 4% down on the 1995 local elections.

zh.s: 1996年英国地方选举于5月2日举行。直到2010年，保守党议员人数减少、工党议员人数增加的地方选举只有这一次。主要反对党工党增加468席，议员人数达到10,929人。工党估算得票率为43%，比1995年地方选举低4个百分点。

en.s: The 1996 North Hertfordshire District Council election was held on 2 May 1996 at the same time as other local elections across England. There were 18 out of 50 seats on North Hertfordshire District Council up for election, being the usual third of the council plus a by-election in Hitchin Oughton ward. The council had previously been under no overall control, being led by a Labour minority administration with some support from the Liberal Democrats.

zh.t: 1996年北赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 北赫特福德郡区议会选举于1996年5月2日举行，与英格兰其他地方选举同期进行。议会50席中有18席改选，包括通常改选的三分之一席位，以及希钦奥顿选区的一场补选。此前，议会没有任何政党单独控制，由工党少数派政府管理，并得到自由民主党的部分支持。

en.s: The 1996 City of Lincoln Council election took place on 2 May 1996. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of the council was up for election: the seats of which were last contested in 1992. The Labour Party retained control of the council.

zh.s: 林肯市议会选举于1996年5月2日举行，与其他地方选举在同一天进行。议会三分之一席位改选，这些席位上次于1992年改选。工党保住了议会控制权。

en.s: Elections to Liverpool City Council were held on 2 May 1996. One third of the council was up for election and the Labour Party achieved overall control of the council.

zh.s: 利物浦市议会选举于1996年5月2日举行。议会三分之一席位进行改选，工党取得议会的总体控制权。

en.s: The 1996 Ipswich Borough Council election was an election to the Ipswich Borough Council under the arrangement, whereby a third of the councillors were to stand for election, each time. It took place as part of the 1996 United Kingdom local elections. There were 16 wards each returning one councillor plus three bye-elections, one each for Chantry, Stoke Park and Town Wards.

zh.t: 1996年伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 1996年伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举按照每次改选约三分之一议员的安排举行，也是1996年英国地方选举的一部分。16个选区各选出一名议员，此外，钱特里、斯托克公园和汤镇三个选区各举行了一场补选。

en.s: Sir Anthony Charles Lynton Blair (born 6 May 1953) is a British politician who served as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from 1997 to 2007 and Leader of the Labour Party from 1994 to 2007. He was Leader of the Opposition from 1994 to 1997, held shadow cabinet posts from 1987 to 1994, and was Member of Parliament (MP) for Sedgefield from 1983 to 2007.

zh.t: 托尼·布莱尔就任英国首相
zh.s: 安东尼·查尔斯·林顿·布莱尔（生于1953年5月6日）是英国政治人物，1997年至2007年任英国首相，1994年至2007年任工党领袖。他曾于1994年至1997年任反对党领袖，1987年至1994年担任影子内阁职务，并于1983年至2007年任塞奇菲尔德选区议员。

en.s: The Taranaki-King Country by-election was a by-election in the New Zealand electorate of Taranaki-King Country, a large and predominantly rural district in the west of New Zealand's North Island. It took place on 2 May 1998, and was precipitated by the resignation from parliament of sitting MP Jim Bolger. Bolger was retiring from politics, having recently been replaced as Prime Minister by Jenny Shipley. The by-election was contested by all major parties. It was won by Shane Ardern, a member of Bolger's National Party, although Ardern gained a majority of only 988 votes.

zh.s: 新西兰塔拉纳基—金国选区于1998年5月2日举行补选。该选区位于新西兰北岛西部，面积广大，以乡村地区为主。时任议员吉姆·博尔格辞去议席，引发此次补选。他此前刚被珍妮·希普利取代，不再担任总理，并准备退出政坛。各大党派均派出候选人参选。博尔格所在的国家党候选人谢恩·阿登胜出，但多数票仅为988票。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1998 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Stade de France, Saint-Denis on 2 May 1998, that saw Paris SG defeat RC Lens 2-1 thanks to goals by Raí and Marco Simone. Vladimír Šmicer scored for the Division 1 champion which could not enjoy two successes in a single season. This final was also the first ever played in the newly-built Stade de France.

zh.s: 1998年法国杯决赛于1998年5月2日在圣但尼法兰西体育场举行。巴黎圣日耳曼以2比1击败朗斯，拉伊和马尔科·西蒙尼为巴黎圣日耳曼进球。法甲冠军朗斯由弗拉基米尔·什米采尔打入一球，但未能在同一赛季实现双冠。决赛也是新建成的法兰西体育场首次承办法国杯决赛。

en.s: The Republic of Panama held a general election on 2 May 1999, electing both a new President of the Republic and a new Legislative Assembly.

zh.s: 巴拿马共和国于1999年5月2日举行大选，选出新任总统和新一届立法议会。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 1999 Dallas mayoral election took place on May 2, 1999, to elect the mayor of Dallas, Texas. The race was officially nonpartisan. It saw the reelection of Ron Kirk, who won the election by taking a majority in the initial round of voting, thereby negating the need for a runoff to be held.

zh.s: 1999年5月2日举行达拉斯市长选举，选出得克萨斯州达拉斯市长。选举正式不分党派。罗恩·柯克再次当选，他在首轮投票中赢得过半数选票，因此无需举行第二轮投票。

en.s: The 2000 North Carolina Democratic presidential primary took place on May 2, 2000, as one of 3 contests scheduled in the Democratic Party primaries for the 2000 presidential election, following the Alaska caucus the weekend before. The North Carolina primary was a semi-closed primary, with the state awarding 103 delegates towards the 2000 Democratic National Convention, of which 86 were pledged delegates allocated on the basis of the results of the primary.

zh.t: 2000年北卡罗来纳州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 北卡罗来纳州民主党总统初选于2000年5月2日举行，是2000年总统大选民主党初选预定的三场初选之一，前一周末阿拉斯加刚举行党团会议。北卡罗来纳州采用半开放式初选，共产生103名参加2000年民主党全国代表大会的代表，其中86名为承诺代表，按初选结果分配。

en.s: The 2000 Indiana Democratic presidential primary took place on May 2, 2000, as one of 3 contests scheduled in the Democratic Party primaries for the 2000 presidential election, following the Alaska caucus the weekend before.

zh.t: 2000年印第安纳州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 印第安纳州民主党总统初选于2000年5月2日举行，是2000年总统大选民主党初选预定的三场初选之一，前一周末阿拉斯加刚举行党团会议。

en.t: 2000 District of Columbia Democratic presidential primary
en.s: The 2000 District of Columbia Democratic presidential primary took place on May 2, 2000, as one of 3 contests scheduled in the Democratic Party primaries for the 2000 presidential election, following the Alaska caucus the weekend before.

zh.t: 2000年哥伦比亚特区民主党总统初选
zh.s: 哥伦比亚特区民主党总统初选于2000年5月2日举行，是2000年总统大选民主党初选预定的三场初选之一，前一周末阿拉斯加刚举行党团会议。

en.s: The 2000 Anchorage mayoral election was held on April 4 and May 2, 2000, to elect the mayor of Anchorage, Alaska. It saw election of George Wuerch. Incumbent mayor Rick Mystrom was term-limited. Proposition 10, passed in 1999, required mayoral candidates to receive 50% of the votes cast in a race to avoid a runoff.

zh.s: 安克雷奇市长选举于2000年4月4日和5月2日举行，选出阿拉斯加州安克雷奇市长。乔治·沃尔奇当选。现任市长里克·米斯特罗姆因任期限制不能参选。1999年通过的第10号提案规定，市长候选人必须在一轮投票中获得50%的选票，才可避免第二轮投票。

en.s: The 2002 Winchester Council election took place on 2 May 2002 to elect members of Winchester District Council in Hampshire, England. The whole council was up for election with boundary changes since the last election in 2000. The boundary changes were the first since the 1970s and they saw the number of seats increased by 2. The results saw the Liberal Democrats stay in overall control of the council after retaining 35 seats on the council. However the Liberal Democrat leader of the council, Rodney Sabine, lost his seat in New Alresfords ward.

zh.s: 2002年温彻斯特市议会选举于5月2日举行，选出英格兰汉普郡温彻斯特区议会成员。由于上次选举（2000年）后选区边界有所调整，整个议会全部改选。这是自20世纪70年代以来首次调整边界，议席因此增加了2席。自由民主党保住35席，继续控制议会。不过，该党议会领袖罗德尼·萨宾在新阿尔斯福德选区失去席位。

en.s: The 2002 Worthing Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2002 to elect members of Worthing Borough Council in West Sussex, England. One third of the council was up for election and the Liberal Democrats gained overall control of the council from the Conservative party. Overall turnout was 30.67%. After the previous election in 2000 the Conservatives had controlled the council with 20 seats compared to the Liberal Democrats 16. 12 seats were up for election in 2002 with the Liberal Democrats needing to gain 2 seats to make Worthing a hung council.

en.s: Elections to Manchester Council were held on Thursday, 2 May 2002. One third of the council - alongside a vacancy in Moss Side - was up for election, with each successful candidate to serve a two-year term of office, expiring in 2004, due to the boundary changes and 'all-out' elections due to take place in that year. The Independent Labour candidates stood as "Independent Progressive Labour". Overall turnout rose to 24.4% and the Labour Party retained overall control of the Council.

en.s: The 2002 elections to Southwark Council were held in the London Borough of Southwark, England, on 2 May 2002. The whole council was up for election, with boundary changes since the last election in 1998, reducing the number of seats by one. There were 63 seats in 21 wards. The Council moved from Labour controlled to no overall control, with a minority Liberal Democrat executive. Turnout was 26.2%. Southwark local elections are held every four years, with the next held in 2006.

zh.s: 斯劳自治市议会选举于2002年5月2日举行，与英格兰其他地方选举同期进行。斯劳自治市议会41个席位中有14席改选，包括通常应改选的三分之一席位（13席），以及斯托克选区的一场补选。自由党议员詹姆斯·摩尔去世后，该席位举行补选。

en.s: The 2002 Chester City Council election took place on 2 May 2002 to elect members of Chester City Council in Cheshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 切斯特市议会选举于2002年5月2日举行，选出英格兰柴郡切斯特市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2002 Bexley Council election took place on 2 May 2002 to elect members of Bexley London Borough Council in London, England. The whole council was up for election and the Labour Party gained control of the council from the Conservative Party.

zh.t: 2002年贝克斯利伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 贝克斯利议会选举于2002年5月2日举行，选出英格兰伦敦贝克斯利自治市议会议员。议会全部席位改选，工党从保守党手中夺得议会控制权。

en.s: The 2002 Cambridge City Council election took place on 2 May 2002 to elect members of Cambridge City Council in England. This was on the same day as other nationwide local elections.

zh.s: 剑桥市议会选举于2002年5月2日举行，选出英格兰剑桥市议会议员，与全国其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2002 Hillingdon London Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2002 to elect members of the Hillingdon London Borough Council. In this election, the number of seats was reduced by four because of boundary changes. The election resulted in no overall control by any single party.

zh.t: 2002年希灵登伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 希灵登伦敦自治市议会选举于2002年5月2日举行，选出希灵登自治市议会议员。由于边界调整，议会席位减少4个。选举后，没有任何政党取得多数。

en.s: The 2002 Westminster City Council election took place on May 2, 2002, to elect 60 members of Westminster City Council. It resulted in a Conservative majority.

zh.s: 威斯敏斯特市议会选举于2002年5月2日举行，选出该市议会全部60名议员。选举后，保守党取得多数席位。

en.s: lElections for Redbridge Council in London were held on 2 May 2002. It was a part of the wider 2002 London local elections. The Conservatives won 43% of the vote in the borough. The turnout was 34.26%, a decrease from the 36% seen in the 1998 London local elections.

zh.t: 2002年雷德布里奇伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 伦敦雷德布里奇议会选举于2002年5月2日举行，是2002年伦敦地方选举的一部分。保守党在该自治市赢得43%的选票。投票率为34.26%，低于1998年伦敦地方选举的36%。

en.s: Local government elections took place in London, and some other parts of the United Kingdom on Thursday 2 May 2002. Ward changes took place in every borough, following a series of reviews and 32 statutory instruments which reduced the total number of councillors by 56 from 1,917 to 1,861. All London borough council seats were up for election.

zh.s: 2002年5月2日（星期四），伦敦及英国其他部分地区举行地方政府选举。经过一系列审查和32项法定文书，各自治市均调整了选区边界，议员总数因此减少56人，从1917人降至1861人。伦敦所有自治市议会席位均进行改选。

en.s: Elections for Harrow London Borough Council in London were held on 2 May 2002. It was a part of the wider 2002 London local elections. The Conservatives won 50.4% of the vote in the borough. The turnout was 31.5%.

zh.t: 2002年哈罗伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 哈罗伦敦自治市议会选举于2002年5月2日举行，是2002年伦敦地方选举的一部分。保守党在该自治市赢得50.4%的选票。投票率为31.5%。

en.s: Elections for Ealing Council in London were held on 2 May 2002. The 2002 United Kingdom local elections took place on the same day. All 69 seats in the council was up for election, with three seats in each of the electoral wards. Labour Party retained their control of the majority with 48 seats.

zh.t: 2002年伊灵伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 伦敦伊灵议会选举于2002年5月2日举行，与2002年英国地方选举在同一天进行。议会全部69个席位均进行改选，每个选区选出3名议员。工党赢得48席，保住了议会多数席位和控制权。

en.t: 2002 Barking and Dagenham London Borough Council election
en.s: Elections for Barking and Dagenham London Borough Council were held on 2 May 2002 to elect members to the council. All seats were up for election following boundary changes since the last election in 1998. The Labour Party kept overall control of the council, but lost 5 seats. Overall turnout was 22.76%.

zh.t: 2002年巴金和达根汉姆伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 巴金和达根汉姆伦敦自治市议会选举于2002年5月2日举行，选出自治市议会议员。自1998年上次选举后边界有所调整，所有席位均进行改选。工党保住了议会的总体控制权，但失去5席。总体投票率为22.76%。

en.s: Elections to Newham London Borough Council were held on 2 May 2002. The whole council was up for election. Turnout was 25.49%. Labour won all but one seat. The sole opposition councillor was Alan Craig of the Christian Peoples Alliance.

zh.t: 2002年纽汉伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 纽汉伦敦自治市议会选举于2002年5月2日举行。议会全部席位均进行改选。投票率为25.49%。工党赢得了除1席以外的所有席位。唯一的反对党议员是基督教人民联盟的艾伦·克雷格。

en.s: Elections to Hyndburn Borough Council were held on 2 May 2002. The whole council was up for election with boundary changes since the last election in 2000 reducing the number of seats by 12. The Labour party gained overall control of the council from the Conservative party.

zh.s: 欣德本自治市议会选举于2002年5月2日举行。上次选举后的边界调整使席位减少12席，本次议会全部席位均进行改选。工党从保守党手中赢得议会的总体控制权。

en.s: Elections to Liverpool City Council were held on 2 May 2002. One third of the council was up for election and the Liberal Democrat party kept overall control of the council.

zh.s: 利物浦市议会选举于2002年5月2日举行。议会三分之一席位进行改选，自由民主党保住了议会的总体控制权。

en.s: Elections to Daventry District Council were held on 2 May 2002. One third of the council was up for election and the Conservative Party stayed in overall control of the council. Overall turnout was 35%.

zh.s: 达文特里区议会选举于2002年5月2日举行。议会三分之一席位进行改选，保守党继续控制议会。总体投票率为35%。

en.s: Elections for the London Borough of Merton were held on 2 May 2002. This was on the same day as other local elections in England. These elections were held under new ward boundaries, which increased the number of councillors to sixty from fifty-seven. Labour remained in overall control of the council with a reduced majority.

zh.t: 2002年默顿伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 默顿伦敦自治市议会选举于2002年5月2日举行，与英格兰其他地方选举在同一天进行。本次选举采用了新的选区边界，议员人数从57人增至60人。工党继续总体控制议会，但多数优势有所缩小。

en.s: Elections to Portsmouth City Council were held on 2 May 2002. The whole council was up for election with boundary changes since the last election in 2000 increasing the number of seats by 3. The council stayed under no overall control, with the Conservatives as the largest party with 15 seats.

zh.s: 朴茨茅斯市议会选举于2002年5月2日举行。自2000年上次选举后，边界调整使议席增加3席，本次议会全部席位均进行改选。选举后，议会没有任何政党单独控制。保守党以15席成为最大党。

en.s: Elections to Lambeth London Borough Council were held on 2 May 2002. The whole council was up for election with boundary changes reducing the number of councillors by one since the last election in 1998. Labour despite having the largest number of votes with 36.6% of the vote, it still lost 13 seats, while the Liberal Democrats and the Conservative Party gained seats, resulting in Labour losing control of the council and no party having a majority.

zh.t: 2002年兰贝斯伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 兰贝斯伦敦自治市议会选举于2002年5月2日举行。选区边界调整后，议会人数比1998年上次选举时少1人，本次议会全部席位均进行改选。工党以36.6%的得票率成为得票最多的政党，但仍失去13席。自由民主党和保守党均增加席位，工党因此失去议会控制权，且没有任何政党取得多数。

en.s: The 2002 North Hertfordshire District Council election was held on 2 May 2002, at the same time as other local elections across England. 18 of the 49 seats on North Hertfordshire District Council were up for election, being the usual third of the council plus a by-election in Royston Heath ward.

zh.t: 2002年北赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 北赫特福德郡区议会选举于2002年5月2日举行，与英格兰其他地方选举同期进行。49个席位中有18席改选，包括通常改选的三分之一席位，以及罗伊斯顿希思选区的一场补选。

en.t: 2002 Waltham Forest London Borough Council election
en.s: Elections to Waltham Forest Council were held in May 2002. The whole council was up for election for the first time since the 1998 election. These elections were the first held on new ward boundaries which increased the total number of Councillors by 3, from 57 to 60. Waltham Forest local elections are held every four years, with the next due in 2006.

zh.t: 2002年沃尔瑟姆森林伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 沃尔瑟姆森林议会选举于2002年5月举行。这是自1998年以来首次改选议会全部席位。此次选举首次采用新的选区划分，议员总数增加了3人，从57人增至60人。沃尔瑟姆森林每四年举行一次地方选举，下一次原定于2006年举行。

en.s: The 2002 Sutton London Borough Council election was a local election for the representation of the Sutton district in London. It was a part of the 2002 London local elections. The Liberal Democrats won 49.1% of the vote in the district which was their most successful district of that election, and the only district which they retained control of since the previous 1998 London local elections.

zh.t: 2002年萨顿伦敦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2002年萨顿伦敦自治市议会选举是萨顿区的一次地方选举，也是2002年伦敦地方选举的一部分。自由民主党获得该区49.1%的选票，这是他们在当届选举中成绩最好的地区，也是他们自1998年伦敦地方选举以来唯一继续控制的地区。

en.s: The Stu Hart's 88th Birthday Celebration (also called Stampede Wrestling 50th Anniversary Show) was a professional wrestling supercard produced by the Stampede Wrestling promotion that took place on May 2, 2003, at the Ogden Legion Hall in Calgary, Alberta. It was initially to be held at the Victoria Pavilion, however, the event was later moved to another venue.

zh.s: 斯图·哈特88岁生日庆典又称“摔角暴风雪50周年纪念赛”，是摔角暴风雪推广组织举办的一场职业摔角大型赛事，于2003年5月2日在加拿大阿尔伯塔省卡尔加里的奥格登军团大厅举行。赛事原定在维多利亚馆举办，后来改换场地。

en.t: Both these newspapers and the Liberty Times, the "big three" in Taiwanese journalism, initially blocked Apple Daily first published on 2 May 2003
en.s: Apple Daily (Chinese: 蘋果日報; pinyin: Píngguǒ Rìbào; Pe̍h-ōe-jī: Pîn-kó Ji̍t-pò) was a Chinese-language tabloid published in Taiwan, known for its sensational headlines, paparazzi photographs, and animated news videos. The paper was owned by Next Digital (fka Next Media), which published an eponymous newspaper in Hong Kong. Next Digital filed for liquidation in September 2021, and a Hong Kong court ordered the winding-up of the company in December 2021.

zh.s: 《苹果日报》（中文：蘋果日報；拼音：Píngguǒ Rìbào；白话字：Pîn-kó Ji̍t-pò）是台湾的一份中文小报，以耸动标题、狗仔队照片和动画新闻视频闻名。该报由壹传媒（原名壹传媒集团）拥有；该集团还在香港发行同名报纸。壹传媒于2021年9月申请清盘，香港法院于同年12月下令清盘。

en.s: The Republic of Panama held a general election on Sunday, 2 May 2004, electing both a new President of the Republic and a new Legislative Assembly.

zh.s: 巴拿马共和国于2004年5月2日星期日举行大选，选出新总统和新一届立法议会。

en.s: The Yelwa massacre was a series of related incidents of religious violence between Muslims and Christians which took place in Yelwa, Nigeria between February and May 2004. These incidents killed over 700 people. The first wave occurred on 4 February 2004 when armed men attacked Christians in Yelwa, killing more than 78, including at least 48 who were worshipping inside a church compound.
en.n: The Yelwa massacre concludes. It began on 4 February 2004 when armed Muslims killed 78 Christians at Yelwa, Nigeria. In response, about 630 Muslims were killed by Christians on May 2.

zh.s: 耶尔瓦大屠杀是2004年2月至5月在尼日利亚耶尔瓦发生的一系列宗教暴力事件，冲突双方为穆斯林和基督徒，造成700多人死亡。第一波冲突发生于2004年2月4日，武装人员袭击耶尔瓦的基督徒，造成78人以上死亡，其中至少48人当时在教堂院内做礼拜。
zh.n: 耶尔瓦大屠杀于5月2日结束。事件始于2004年2月4日，当天耶尔瓦的武装穆斯林杀害78名基督徒。作为回应，5月2日基督徒杀害约630名穆斯林。

en.s: The 2005 FA Women's Cup Final was the 35th final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. It was the 12th final to be held under the direct control of the Football Association (FA) and was known as the FA Women's Cup Final in partnership with Nationwide for sponsorship reasons. The final was contested between Charlton Athletic and Everton on 2 May 2005.

zh.s: 2005年英格兰足总女子杯决赛是该项英格兰女子足球主要杯赛的第35届决赛。这是英格兰足球总会（FA）直接管理下举行的第12届决赛。因赞助原因，本届赛事称为“与Nationwide合作举办的足总女子杯决赛”。2005年5月2日，查尔顿竞技对阵埃弗顿，争夺冠军。

en.s: The 2006 Ukrainian Cup final was a football match that took place at the Olympic NSC on 2 May 2006. The match was the 15th Ukrainian Cup final, and it was contested by Metalurh Zaporizhzhia and Dynamo Kyiv. The Olympic stadium is the traditional arena for the Cup final.

zh.s: 2006年乌克兰杯决赛于2006年5月2日在奥林匹克国家体育场举行。这是第15届乌克兰杯决赛，对阵双方是扎波罗热冶金队和基辅迪纳摩队。奥林匹克体育场是杯赛决赛的传统举办场地。

en.s: Mayoral elections in Norfolk, Virginia are held every four years to elect the mayor of Norfolk, Virginia. The Norfolk mayor has been elected by popular vote since 2006. All Norfolk municipal elections are required to be non-partisan, but most candidates can be affiliated with political parties. The elections occur in line with presidential election years after shifting from midterm years in 2016.

zh.t: 弗吉尼亚州诺福克市长选举
zh.s: 诺福克市每四年举行一次市长选举。自2006年起，市长由选民直接选出。诺福克市政选举依法不设党派，但多数候选人仍可有政党归属。2016年改为与总统选举同年举行后，市长选举也与总统选举周期同步。

en.s: General elections were held in the Bahamas on 2 May 2007. The result was an opposition victory, with the Free National Movement, led by former Prime Minister Hubert Ingraham, claiming 23 of the 41 seats. Incumbent Prime Minister Perry Christie conceded defeat in a phone call to his rival. Ingraham was sworn into the office of Prime Minister on 4 May. The Progressive Liberal Party was expected to win re-election until the Anna Nicole Smith scandal, when Minister of Immigration Shane Gibson, a PLP Member or Parliament was accused of cozying up to the former playmate by fast-tracking residency for her and Howard K.

zh.s: 巴哈马于2007年5月2日举行大选。反对党自由民族运动获胜，在前总理休伯特·英格拉哈姆的带领下赢得41个席位中的23席。现任总理佩里·克里斯蒂在电话中向对手承认败选。英格拉哈姆于5月4日宣誓就任总理。此前，进步自由党原本被看好连任；安娜·妮可·史密斯丑闻爆发后，移民部长沙恩·吉布森被指为这位前花花公子女郎加速办理居留手续，惠特尼·霍华德·斯特恩也卷入其中。

en.s: Extremely Severe Cyclonic Storm Nargis (Burmese: နာဂစ်) was an extremely deadly and catastrophic tropical cyclone that caused the worst natural disaster in the recorded history of Myanmar during early May 2008. The cyclone made landfall in Myanmar on 2 May 2008, sending a storm surge 40 kilometres up the densely populated Irrawaddy delta, causing catastrophic destruction and at least 138,373 fatalities.

zh.s: 特强气旋风暴纳尔吉斯（缅甸语：နာဂစ်）是极具破坏性的致命热带气旋，于2008年5月上旬袭击缅甸，造成缅甸有记录以来最严重的自然灾害。气旋于2008年5月2日在缅甸登陆，风暴潮深入人口稠密的伊洛瓦底江三角洲40公里，造成灾难性破坏，至少138373人死亡。

en.s: World Victory Road Presents: Sengoku 8 was a mixed martial arts event promoted by World Victory Road. It took place on May 2, 2009 and featured the second round of WVR's 2009 Featherweight Grand-Prix.

zh.s: World Victory Road主办的Sengoku 8是一场综合格斗赛事，于2009年5月2日举行，包括World Victory Road 2009年羽量级大奖赛第二轮比赛。

en.s: The 2009 Greek Cup final was the 65th final of the Greek Cup. The match took place on 2 May 2009 at the Olympic Stadium. The contesting teams were AEK Athens and Olympiacos. It was AEK Athens' nineteenth Greek Cup final in their 85-year history and Olympiacos' thirty fourth Greek Cup final and second consecutive in their 84 years of existence.

zh.s: 2009年希腊杯决赛是该项赛事第65届决赛。比赛于2009年5月2日在奥林匹克体育场举行，由雅典AEK队对阵奥林匹亚科斯队。这是雅典AEK在其85年历史上第19次参加希腊杯决赛；奥林匹亚科斯在其84年历史上第34次闯入决赛，并连续第二年进入决赛。

en.s: Periodic elections for the Tasmanian Legislative Council were held on 2 May 2009. The three seats up for election were Derwent, held by Labor MLC Michael Aird; Mersey, held by retiring independent MLC Norma Jamieson; and Windermere, held by independent MLC Ivan Dean. These seats were last contested in 2003.

zh.t: 2009年塔斯马尼亚立法会定期选举
zh.s: 塔斯马尼亚立法会定期选举于2009年5月2日举行。参加选举的3个席位分别是：德文特选区，由工党立法会议员迈克尔·艾尔德担任；默西选区，由即将退休的无党派立法会议员诺玛·贾米森担任；温德米尔选区，由无党派立法会议员伊万·迪恩担任。这些席位上次于2003年改选。

en.t: 2009 Liberal Party of Canada leadership election
en.s: In 2009, the Liberal Party of Canada held a leadership election to choose a successor to Stéphane Dion. The election was prompted by Dion's announcement that he would not lead the party into another election, following his party's defeat in the 2008 federal election in Canada. The Liberals had won 77 seats, maintaining its role as Official Opposition, but only captured just slightly over 26% of the total votes, their lowest percentage in the party's history to that date.

zh.s: 2009年，加拿大自由党举行党魁选举，选出斯特凡·迪翁的继任者。迪翁此前表示，不会带领自由党参加下一次联邦大选；此前该党在2008年联邦大选中失利。自由党赢得77个席位，继续担任官方反对党，但得票率略高于26%，是该党截至当时的历史最低水平。

en.s: The 2011 Canadian federal election (formally the 41st Canadian general election) was held Monday, May 2, 2011, to elect members to the House of Commons of Canada of the 41st Canadian Parliament. The writs of election for the 2011 election were issued by Governor General David Johnston on March 26. Prime Minister Stephen Harper advised the Governor General to dissolve parliament after the House of Commons passed a motion of non-confidence against the government, finding it to be in contempt of parliament. A few days before, the three opposition parties had rejected the government's proposed budget.

zh.s: 2011年加拿大联邦大选（正式名称为第41届加拿大大选）于2011年5月2日星期一举行，选出加拿大第41届国会下议院议员。总督戴维·约翰斯顿于3月26日发布选举令。众议院通过不信任动议，认定政府藐视议会后，斯蒂芬·哈珀总理建议总督解散议会。在此之前几天，三个反对党已否决政府提出的预算案。

en.s: In the 2011 Canadian federal election, there were 75 members of Parliament elected to the House of Commons from the province of Quebec, making up 24.4% of all members of the House.

zh.t: 2011年加拿大联邦选举魁北克省选区
zh.s: 在2011年加拿大联邦选举中，魁北克省选出了75名众议院议员，占众议院全部议员的24.4%。

en.s: An early indirect presidential election was held in Hungary on 2 May 2012, following the resignation of Pál Schmitt as President of Hungary on 2 April 2012. János Áder was elected President with an absolute majority.

en.s: An election to Lancashire County Council took place on 2 May 2013 as part of the United Kingdom local elections, 2013. 84 councillors were elected from single-member electoral divisions by first-past-the-post for a four-year term of office. Electoral divisions were the same as those at the previous election in 2009. Elections were held in all electoral divisions across the present ceremonial county, excepting Blackpool and Blackburn with Darwen which are unitary authorities in a similar way to Greater Manchester and most of Merseyside. The election saw the Conservative Party lose overall control of the council, instead overtaken in number of seats by the Labour Party, without any absolute majority.

zh.s: 兰开夏郡议会选举于2013年5月2日举行，是英国2013年地方选举的一部分。84名议员从单一议员选区中选出，采用简单多数制，任期四年。选区与2009年上次选举时相同。除布莱克浦和布莱克本与达尔文外，礼仪郡内所有选区都举行了选举；这两地与大曼彻斯特和默西塞德大部分地区一样，属于单一制地方政府。选举后，工党席位数超过保守党，但没有任何政党取得绝对多数，保守党失去议会控制权。

en.s: An election to Northamptonshire County Council took place on 2 May 2013 as part of the United Kingdom local elections, 2013. Following a boundary review, the number of county councillors was reduced from 73 to 57 from this election. All members were elected by first-past-the-post voting from single-member electoral divisions for a four-year term of office. The Conservative Party held on to their overall majority, having held overall control of the council since 2005. All locally registered electors (British, Irish, Commonwealth and European Union citizens) who were aged 18 or over on Thursday 2 May 2013 were entitled to vote in the local elections.

zh.s: 北安普敦郡议会选举于2013年5月2日举行，是英国2013年地方选举的一部分。经选区边界审查，郡议会议员人数从73人减至57人。所有议员均从单一议员选区选出，采用简单多数制，任期四年。保守党保住多数席位，自2005年以来一直掌控议会。凡在2013年5月2日星期四年满18岁、在当地登记的选民（英国、爱尔兰、英联邦及欧盟公民）均有权参加地方选举。

en.s: An election to Leicestershire County Council took place on 2 May 2013 as part of the United Kingdom local elections, 2013. 55 councillors were elected from 52 electoral divisions, which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The Conservatives held control of the council with a reduced majority of 5 seats. Despite a strong challenge from UKIP, the party only gained 2 seats (including one where the sitting Conservative councillor had previously defected to UKIP) whilst the Liberal Democrats lost one seat and Labour recouped some of their 2009 losses, gaining 6 seats.

zh.s: 莱斯特郡议会选举于2013年5月2日举行，是英国2013年地方选举的一部分。55名议员从52个选区选出，各选区选出一至两名郡议会议员，采用简单多数制，任期四年。保守党以5席的优势减少后继续掌控议会。英国独立党虽有力挑战，但只赢得2席，其中一席原本由一名已转投该党的保守党现任议员占据。自由民主党失去一席，工党则收复部分2009年失去的席位，赢得6席。

en.s: An election to Hampshire County Council took place on 2 May 2013 as part of the United Kingdom local elections, 2013. 78 councillors were elected from 75 electoral divisions, which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. en.s: Elections to Gloucestershire County Council took place on 2 May 2013 as part of the United Kingdom local elections, 2013. 53 electoral divisions elected one county councillor each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. No elections were held in South Gloucestershire, which is a unitary authority outside the area covered by the County Council. Control of the council went from the Conservative Party to no party having overall control. Turnout across the county was 32% with 151,250 votes cast. The Conservatives gained most votes in four of the six parliamentary seats, the Liberal Democrats coming first in Cheltenham and UKIP in the Forest of Dean.

zh.s: 格洛斯特郡议会选举于2013年5月2日举行，是英国2013年地方选举的一部分。53个选区各选出一名郡议会议员，采用简单多数制，任期四年。南格洛斯特郡属于单一制地方政府，不在郡议会管辖范围内，因此没有举行选举。选举后，保守党失去议会控制权，议会变为无多数党掌控。全郡投票率为32%，共投出151,250票。保守党在6个国会选区中的4个获得最多选票；自由民主党在切尔滕纳姆领先，英国独立党则在迪恩森林领先。

en.s: The 2013 United Kingdom local elections took place on Thursday 2 May 2013. Elections were held in 35 English councils: all 27 non-metropolitan county councils and eight unitary authorities, and in one Welsh unitary authority. Direct mayoral elections took place in Doncaster and North Tyneside. These elections last took place on the 4 June 2009 at the same time as the 2009 European Parliament Elections, except for County Durham, Northumberland and the Anglesey where elections last took place in 2008. On the same day a parliamentary by-election took place in the North East constituency of South Shields following the departure of David Miliband, with the Labour Party retaining the seat.

zh.s: 2013年英国地方选举于2013年5月2日星期四举行。英格兰35个地方议会举行选举，包括全部27个非都市郡议会和8个单一制地方政府；威尔士也有一个单一制地方政府举行选举。唐卡斯特和北泰恩赛德举行市长直选。这些地方上次选举是在2009年6月4日，与2009年欧洲议会选举同日举行；达勒姆郡、诺森伯兰和安格尔西岛除外，这些地区上次选举是在2008年。同日，南希尔兹选区举行议会补选，以接替离任的戴维·米利班德，工党保住该席位。

en.s: The 2013 Isle of Wight Council election was held on 2 May 2013 to elect all 40 members for a four-year term to the Isle of Wight Council, a unitary authority which governs the Isle of Wight. Going into the election, the Conservative Party was looking to gain a third term in power after first being elected to overall control in 2005, but in one of the shock results of the wider local elections being held in the country, the Conservatives lost overall control of the council, having been reduced to 15 seats, 6 short of a majority of 21.

zh.s: 怀特岛议会选举于2013年5月2日举行，选出该岛单一制地方政府怀特岛议会的全部40名议员，任期四年。选举前，保守党希望在2005年首次取得议会多数控制后赢得第三个任期。但在全国地方选举的一场意外结果中，保守党失去议会控制权，席位减至15席，距取得多数所需的21席还差6席。

en.s: An election to Derbyshire County Council took place on 2 May 2013 as part of the United Kingdom local elections, 2013. No elections were held in the City of Derby, which is a unitary authority outside the area covered by the County Council. The Labour Party won back control of the council by a landslide victory, taking forty-two of the authority's sixty-four seats.

en.s: The South Shields by-election was a by-election held for the United Kingdom House of Commons constituency of South Shields. It was triggered by the resignation of David Miliband, the previous Member of Parliament (MP) and former Shadow Foreign Secretary, who had held the seat for Labour since 2001. The by-election took place on 2 May 2013, coinciding with local elections across England. The by-election was won by Emma Lewell-Buck of the Labour Party with 50.4% of the vote. The UK Independence Party (UKIP) came second with 24.2%, with the Conservatives dropping to third with 11.5%.

zh.s: 南希尔兹选区于2013年5月2日举行英国下议院补选。此前，该选区在任议员、前影子外交大臣戴维·米利班德辞职；他自2001年起代表工党担任该选区议员。补选与英格兰地方选举同期举行。工党候选人艾玛·卢埃尔-巴克以50.4%的得票率胜出。英国独立党得票率为24.2%，排名第二；保守党以11.5%排名第三。

en.s: Elections to Suffolk County Council took place on 2 May 2013 as part of the United Kingdom local elections, 2013. 75 councillors were elected from 63 electoral divisions, which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. Labour and the Conservatives were the only parties with candidates standing in all sixty-three electoral divisions. All locally registered electors (British, Irish, Commonwealth and European Union citizens) who were aged 18 or over on Thursday 2 May 2013 were entitled to vote in the local elections.

zh.s: 萨福克郡议会选举于2013年5月2日举行，是英国2013年地方选举的一部分。75名议员从63个选区选出，各选区选出一至两名郡议会议员，采用简单多数制，任期四年。选区与2009年上次选举时相同。工党和保守党是唯二在全部63个选区派出候选人的政党。凡在2013年5月2日星期四年满18岁、在当地登记的选民（英国、爱尔兰、英联邦及欧盟公民）均有权参加地方选举。

en.s: An election to Worcestershire County Council took place on 2 May 2013 as part of the United Kingdom local elections, 2013. 57 councillors were elected from 53 electoral divisions, which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The divisions were the same as those used at the previous election in 2009. The election saw the Conservative Party retain overall control of the council with a significantly reduced majority of just 2 seats. All locally registered electors (British, Commonwealth and European Union citizens) who were aged 18 or over on Thursday 2 May 2013 were entitled to vote in the local elections.

zh.s: 伍斯特郡议会选举于2013年5月2日举行，是英国2013年地方选举的一部分。57名议员从53个选区选出，各选区选出一至两名郡议会议员，采用简单多数制，任期四年。选区与2009年上次选举时相同。保守党继续掌控议会，但多数优势大幅缩小，仅领先2席。凡在当地登记且于2013年5月2日星期四年满18岁的选民（英国、英联邦及欧盟公民）均有权参加地方选举。

en.s: An election to Essex County Council took place on 2 May 2013 as part of the United Kingdom local elections, 2013. 75 councillors were elected from 70 electoral divisions, which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The electoral divisions were the same as those used at the previous election in 2009. No elections were held in Thurrock or Southend-on-Sea, which are unitary authorities outside the area covered by the County Council. All locally registered electors (British, Irish, Commonwealth and European Union citizens) who were aged 18 or over on Thursday 2 May 2013 were entitled to vote in the local elections.

zh.s: 埃塞克斯郡议会选举于2013年5月2日举行，是英国2013年地方选举的一部分。75名议员从70个选区选出，各选区选出一至两名郡议会议员，采用简单多数制，任期四年。选区与2009年上次选举时相同。瑟罗克和滨海绍森德属于郡议会管辖范围之外的单一制地方政府，因此没有举行选举。凡在2013年5月2日星期四年满18岁、在当地登记的选民（英国、爱尔兰、英联邦及欧盟公民）均有权参加地方选举。

en.s: An election to Somerset County Council took place on 2 May 2013 as part of the United Kingdom local elections, 2013. 55 councillors were elected from 54 electoral divisions, which returned one county councillor each with the exception of the two-member Glastonbury & Street division. Members were elected by the first-past-the-post voting system for a four-year term of office. The electoral divisions were changed from those used at the previous election in 2009, reducing the number of county councillors from 58 to 55 from this election. No elections were held in North Somerset or Bath and North East Somerset, which are unitary authorities outside the area covered by the County Council.

zh.s: 萨默塞特郡议会选举于2013年5月2日举行，是英国2013年地方选举的一部分。55名议员从54个选区选出，除格拉斯顿伯里与斯特里特选区选出两人外，其他选区各选出一名议员。议员采用简单多数制选出，任期四年。选区较2009年上次选举时有所调整，郡议会议员人数从58人减至55人。北萨默塞特和巴斯及东北萨默塞特属于郡议会管辖范围之外的单一制地方政府，因此没有举行选举。

en.s: The Nottinghamshire County Council Election took place on 2 May 2013 as part of the United Kingdom local elections, 2013. 67 councillors were elected from 54 electoral divisions, which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The electoral divisions were the same as those used at the previous election in 2009. No elections were held in the City of Nottingham, which is a unitary authority outside the area covered by the County Council. The Labour Party won a narrow majority of one seat, gaining overall control from the Conservative Party who had controlled the council since the 2009 election.

zh.s: 诺丁汉郡议会选举于2013年5月2日举行，是英国2013年地方选举的一部分。67名议员从54个选区选出，各选区选出一至两名郡议会议员，采用简单多数制，任期四年。选区与2009年上次选举时相同。诺丁汉市属于郡议会管辖范围之外的单一制地方政府，因此没有举行选举。工党赢得一席多数，从自2009年以来掌控议会的保守党手中夺得控制权。

en.s: An election to Warwickshire County Council took place on 2 May 2013 as part of the United Kingdom local elections, 2013. 62 councillors were elected from 56 electoral divisions, which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The electoral divisions were the same as those used at the previous election in 2009. The election saw the Conservative Party lose overall control of the council. All locally registered electors (British, Irish, Commonwealth and European Union citizens) who were aged 18 or over on Thursday 2 May 2013 were entitled to vote in the local elections.

zh.s: 沃里克郡议会选举于2013年5月2日举行，是英国2013年地方选举的一部分。62名议员从56个选区选出，各选区选出一至两名郡议会议员，采用简单多数制，任期四年。选区与2009年上次选举时相同。保守党在本次选举中失去议会控制权。凡在2013年5月2日星期四年满18岁、在当地登记的选民（英国、爱尔兰、英联邦及欧盟公民）均有权参加地方选举。

en.s: The Kent County Council election, 2013 was an election to all 84 seats on Kent County Council held on Thursday 2 May as part of the United Kingdom local elections, 2013. 84 councillors were elected from 72 electoral divisions, which returned either one or two county councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The electoral divisions were the same as those used at the previous election in 2009. No elections were held in Medway, which is a unitary authority outside the area covered by the County Council. The election saw the Conservative Party narrowly retain overall control of the council.

zh.s: 肯特郡议会全部84个席位于2013年5月2日星期四进行改选，是英国2013年地方选举的一部分。84名议员从72个选区选出，各选区选出一至两名郡议会议员，采用简单多数制，任期四年。选区与2009年上次选举时相同。梅德韦属于郡议会管辖范围之外的单一制地方政府，因此没有举行选举。保守党以微弱优势继续掌控议会。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: An election to Devon County Council took place on 2 May 2013 as part of the United Kingdom local elections, 2013. 62 councillors were elected from electoral divisions which returned one county councillor each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The electoral divisions were the same as those used at the previous election in 2009. No elections were held in Plymouth and Torbay, which are unitary authorities outside the area covered by the County Council. All locally registered electors (British, Irish, Commonwealth and European Union citizens) who were aged 18 or over on Thursday 2 May 2013 were entitled to vote in the local elections.

zh.s: 德文郡议会选举于2013年5月2日举行，是英国2013年地方选举的一部分。62名议员从各选区选出，每个选区选出一名郡议会议员，采用简单多数制，任期四年。选区与2009年上次选举时相同。普利茅斯和托贝属于郡议会管辖范围之外的单一制地方政府，因此没有举行选举。凡在2013年5月2日星期四年满18岁、在当地登记的选民（英国、爱尔兰、英联邦及欧盟公民）均有权参加地方选举。

en.s: Elections to the Wiltshire Council unitary authority took place on 2 May 2013. All ninety-eight seats were up for election, with each councillor being elected in a single-member electoral division, although in six of the divisions only one candidate was nominated and was thus declared the winner without elections taking place. The previous elections were held in June 2009 and resulted in the Conservatives taking overall control of the newly formed council, the successor to Wiltshire County Council and four recently abolished district councils, with the Liberal Democrats forming the largest of four opposition political groups.

zh.s: 威尔特郡单一制议会选举于2013年5月2日举行，全部98个席位均进行改选。每个选区选出一名议员；其中6个选区只有一名候选人获提名，因此候选人未经投票便当选。上次选举于2009年6月举行，保守党当时取得新设议会的控制权。新议会取代了威尔特郡郡议会和四个已撤销的区议会，自由民主党则是四个反对党团中最大的一个。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The Norfolk County Council election took place across Norfolk on 2 May 2013, coinciding with local elections for all county councils in England. The results were announced the following day, Friday 3 May 2013. The result brought to an end 12 years of Conservative Party rule, who finished three seats short of a majority after losing 20 seats. UKIP and the Labour Party both made gains of 14 and 11 seats respectively. The Liberal Democrats and the Green Party both lost three seats each, while an independent won a single seat in North Coast.

zh.s: 诺福克郡议会选举于2013年5月2日在诺福克全郡举行，与英格兰各郡议会地方选举同期进行。选举结果于次日，即2013年5月3日星期五公布。保守党失去20席，距多数席位还差3席，结束了该党长达12年的执政。英国独立党和工党分别增加14席和11席；自由民主党和绿党各失去3席；一名独立候选人在北海岸选区赢得一席。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Local elections to Northumberland County Council, a unitary authority in the north east of England, were held on 2 May 2013, resulting in a council with no overall control and with Labour members forming the largest political group on the new Council.

zh.s: 诺森伯兰郡议会是英格兰东北部的单一制地方政府，议会选举于2013年5月2日举行。选举后，议会没有任何政党占多数，工党议员组成了新议会中最大的党团。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Elections for one third (23 seats) of Bristol City Council were held on 2 May 2013 as part of the United Kingdom local elections, 2013. No party gained overall control. The Liberal Democrats, who had been the largest party on the council, lost 10 seats and conceded largest party status to Labour. The Green Party also gained 2 new seats, whilst Independents for Bristol gained their first seat on the Council.

zh.s: 布里斯托市议会三分之一席位（23席）于2013年5月2日改选，是英国2013年地方选举的一部分。没有政党取得多数席位。自由民主党此前是议会最大党，但失去10席，最大党地位被工党取代。绿党增加2席，布里斯托独立人士首次赢得议会席位。

en.t: 2013 Council of the Isles of Scilly election
en.s: The 2013 Council of the Isles of Scilly election took place on 2 May 2013 as part of the 2013 local elections in the United Kingdom The council is a sui generis unitary authority within the ceremonial county of Cornwall. The whole council of 21 members was up for election, with thirteen members elected in the St Mary's electoral division and another eight from the 'Off Islands': being two each from Bryher, St Martin's, St Agnes and Tresco.

zh.s: 锡利群岛议会选举于2013年5月2日举行，是英国2013年地方选举的一部分。该议会是位于康沃尔礼仪郡内的特殊单一制地方政府。议会全部21个席位改选，其中圣玛丽选区选出13名议员，另外8名来自外岛：布赖尔岛、圣马丁岛、圣艾格尼丝岛和特雷斯科岛各选出两名。

en.t: 2013 Isle of Anglesey County Council election
en.s: An election to the Isle of Anglesey County Council was held as part of the 2013 United Kingdom local elections and took place on 2 May 2013. Anglesey was the only Welsh authority voting in 2013, the election having been postponed from 2012 by the Welsh Government, in order to allow an electoral review to take place. The next full council election took place on 4 May 2017.

zh.s: 安格尔西岛郡议会选举是英国2013年地方选举的一部分，于2013年5月2日举行。安格尔西岛是2013年威尔士唯一举行选举的地方政府；此前，威尔士政府为进行选区审查，将该地选举从2012年推迟。下一次议会全体选举于2017年5月4日举行。

en.s: The 2013 elections to Shropshire Council were held on 2 May 2013 as part of the 2013 United Kingdom local elections. These were the second elections to the unitary authority created as part of local government restructuring in Shropshire, following on from the previous elections in 2009. All 74 seats in the 63 electoral divisions (consisting of 53 single member divisions, nine 2-member divisions and one 3-member electoral division) were up for election across Shropshire.

zh.s: 什罗普郡议会选举于2013年5月2日举行，是2013年英国地方选举的一部分。这是什罗普郡地方政府重组后成立的单一管理区举行的第二次选举；上一次选举于2009年举行。什罗普郡63个选区的全部74个席位均进行改选，其中53个选区选出1名议员、9个选区选出2名议员、1个选区选出3名议员。

en.s: The East Sussex County Council election, 2013 took place on 2 May 2013 as part of the 2013 United Kingdom local elections. All 49 councillors of East Sussex County Council were elected from 44 electoral divisions, which return either one or two councillors each by first-past-the-post voting for a four-year term of office. The electoral divisions were the same as those used at the previous election in 2009.

zh.s: 东萨塞克斯郡议会选举于2013年5月2日举行，是2013年英国地方选举的一部分。东萨塞克斯郡议会全部49名议员均从44个选区选出，每个选区选出1至2名议员，采用简单多数制，任期4年。各选区与2009年上次选举时相同。

en.s: The Cornwall Council election, 2013, was an election for all 123 seats on the council. Cornwall Council is a unitary authority that covers the majority of the ceremonial county of Cornwall, with the exception of the Isles of Scilly which have an independent local authority. The elections took place concurrently with other local elections across England and Wales.

zh.s: 2013年康沃尔郡议会选举改选该议会全部123个席位。康沃尔郡议会是单一制地方政府，管辖礼仪郡康沃尔的大部分地区；锡利群岛由独立的地方政府管理。这次选举与英格兰和威尔士其他地方选举同期举行。

en.s: The 2015 European Rugby Champions Cup Final was the final match in the first European Rugby Champions Cup, and the twentieth European club rugby final in general, as the competition replaces the Heineken Cup. The final was played between the French clubs Clermont and Toulon at Twickenham Stadium on 2 May 2015. Toulon won the final, beating Clermont by 24 points to 18.

zh.s: 2015年欧洲橄榄球冠军杯决赛是首届欧洲橄榄球冠军杯的决赛，也是欧洲俱乐部橄榄球赛事的第20场总决赛。这项赛事取代了喜力杯。2015年5月2日，法国俱乐部克莱蒙和土伦在特威克纳姆球场争夺冠军。土伦以24比18击败克莱蒙，赢得决赛。

en.s: Periodic elections for the Tasmanian Legislative Council were held on 2 May 2015. The three seats up for election were the electoral division of Derwent, the electoral division of Mersey and the electoral division of Windermere. Mersey and Windermere were previously contested in 2009, with Derwent contested in a by-election in 2011. All three seats were retained by the incumbent members.

zh.t: 2015年塔斯马尼亚立法会定期选举
zh.s: 塔斯马尼亚立法会定期选举于2015年5月2日举行。参加选举的3个席位分别属于德文特、默西和温德米尔选区。默西和温德米尔选区上次于2009年改选，德文特选区则于2011年举行补选。3席均由原任议员保住。

en.s: North Somerset unitary council is elected every four years, with fifty councillors to be elected. Since the first election to the unitary authority in 1995, the council has either been under Conservative party control, or no party has held a majority. The Conservatives gained a majority at the 2007 election and have retained control since then.

zh.s: 北萨默塞特单一制议会每四年举行一次选举，选出50名议员。自1995年首次选举以来，议会一直由保守党掌控，或没有任何政党获得多数。保守党在2007年选举中赢得多数席位，此后一直执政。
