en.s: The 2016 Russian Cup final decided the winner of the 2015–16 Russian Cup, the 24th season of Russia's main football cup. It was played on 2 May 2016 at the Kazan Arena in Kazan, between CSKA Moscow and Zenit Saint Petersburg. After being level 1—1 at halftime, Zenit scored three second half goals to emerge victorious with a 4-1 win.

zh.s: 2016年俄罗斯杯决赛决出了2015至2016赛季俄罗斯杯冠军，该赛事是俄罗斯主要足球杯赛的第24个赛季。决赛于2016年5月2日在喀山的喀山竞技场举行，对阵双方是莫斯科中央陆军和圣彼得堡泽尼特。上半场双方战成1比1，泽尼特在下半场打入3球，最终以4比1获胜。

en.s: On May 2, 2017, Malian forces were ambushed by Jama'at Nasr al-Islam wal Muslimin fighters near Dogofry, Mali.

zh.s: 2017年5月2日，马里军队在多戈弗里附近遭到伊斯兰与穆斯林支持组织武装人员伏击。

en.s: The 2017 Russian Cup final decided the winner of the 2016–17 Russian Cup, the 25th season of Russia's main football cup. It was played on 2 May 2017 at the Fisht Olympic Stadium in Sochi, between Ural Yekaterinburg and Lokomotiv Moscow. Lokomotiv won the game courtesy of goals from Igor Denisov and Aleksei Miranchuk.

zh.s: 2017年俄罗斯杯决赛决出了2016至2017赛季俄罗斯杯冠军，该赛事是俄罗斯主要足球杯赛的第25个赛季。决赛于2017年5月2日在索契菲什特奥林匹克体育场举行，对阵双方是叶卡捷琳堡乌拉尔和莫斯科火车头。莫斯科火车头凭借伊戈尔·杰尼索夫和阿列克谢·米兰丘克的进球获胜。

en.s: The 2019 Brentwood Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Brentwood Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2019年布伦特伍德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 布伦特伍德自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出英格兰布伦特伍德自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2019 Rutland County Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Rutland County Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. New boundaries were used in this election and the number of councillors increased from 26 to 27.

zh.s: 拉特兰郡议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出英格兰拉特兰郡议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。本次选举采用新的选区边界，议员人数从26人增加到27人。

en.s: The 2019 East Devon District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of East Devon District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The whole council was elected on new ward boundaries that increased the number of seats from 59 to 60.

zh.s: 东德文区议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出英格兰东德文区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会全部席位按新的选区边界改选，席位从59个增加到60个。

en.t: 2019 Blackburn with Darwen Borough Council election
en.s: The 2019 Blackburn with Darwen Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Blackburn with Darwen Borough Council in England. This was the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2019年布莱克本与达尔文自治市议会选举
zh.s: 布莱克本与达尔文自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出英格兰布莱克本与达尔文自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2019 Plymouth City Council election was held on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Plymouth City Council in England. The Labour Party took control of the council after the 2018 election, with thirty-one members and a working majority. Labour defended nine seats, and the Conservatives defended ten. Labour won the election, winning ten of the nineteen seats up for election, with the Conservatives winning the other nine.

zh.s: 普利茅斯市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出英格兰普利茅斯市议会议员。工党在2018年选举后掌控议会，拥有31名议员和可运作的多数席位。本次选举中，工党有9席需要守住，保守党有10席需要守住。最终工党赢得19个改选席位中的10席，保守党赢得另外9席。

en.s: The 2019 Thurrock Council election was held on 2 May 2019 to elect members of the Thurrock Council in England.

zh.s: 瑟罗克议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出英格兰瑟罗克议会议员。

en.s: Elections for Runnymede Borough Council took place on 2 May 2019 alongside nationwide local elections. Due to changes to the ward boundaries, all 41 seats on the Council were up for election. The Conservative Party lost seats, but retained its majority on the council.

zh.t: 2019年朗尼米德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 朗尼米德自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，与全国地方选举同期进行。由于选区边界调整，议会全部41个席位均进行改选。保守党失去席位，但仍保住议会多数。

en.s: The 2019 East Staffordshire Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of the East Staffordshire Borough Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2019年东斯塔福德郡自治市议会选举
zh.s: 东斯塔福德郡自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出英格兰东斯塔福德郡自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2019 Tendring District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Tendring District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The overall turnout was 31.8%. Following the 2015 election the size of the council was reduced from 60 seats to 48 seats with ward boundaries being redrawn accordingly. These changes took effect from this election.

zh.s: 滕德灵区议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出英格兰滕德灵区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。总体投票率为31.8%。2015年选举后，议会席位从60个减至48个，并相应调整了选区边界。本次选举首次采用新安排。

en.s: The 2019 Blaby District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of the Blaby District Council in England. They were held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 布莱比区议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出英格兰布莱比区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2019 Leicester City Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect all fifty-four members of the Leicester City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections, and the election for the directly elected Mayor of Leicester.

zh.s: 莱斯特市议会全部54个席位于2019年5月2日改选，与其他地方选举以及莱斯特市长直选同期举行。

en.s: Elections to Gedling Borough Council in Nottinghamshire were held on 2 May 2019, the same day as the other local government elections in England and Northern Ireland. The election used the nineteen wards created as a result of boundary commission recommendations formulated for the 2015 contest, with each division electing between one and three Councillors using the first-past-the-post electoral system. A total of 41 representatives were elected.

zh.s: 诺丁汉郡格德灵自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，与英格兰和北爱尔兰其他地方政府选举同日进行。选举采用按边界委员会建议为2015年选举划定的19个选区，每个选区采用简单多数制选出一至三名议员，共选出41名议员。

en.s: The 2019 High Peak Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect all 43 members of High Peak Borough Council in Derbyshire, England. The election resulted in the Labour Party taking control of the council from the Conservative Party after winning 22 of the 43 seats up for election. The Conservatives lost 7 of the seats they were defending and lost their majority on the council.

zh.s: 海皮克自治市议会全部43个席位于2019年5月2日改选，选出英格兰德比郡议会议员。工党赢得43席中的22席，从保守党手中夺得议会控制权。保守党失去其守住的席位中的7席，并失去多数。

en.t: 2019 Brighton and Hove City Council election
en.s: Elections to Brighton and Hove City Council took place on 2 May 2019, electing all 54 members of the council, alongside other local elections in England and Northern Ireland. The Labour Party lost 3 seats compared to the last election in 2015 but recovered its place as the largest party on the council, having seen its numbers reduced from 23 to 19 over the four years following 2015, while the strength of the Conservative group had been increased by one member in 2019, as a Labour councillor had changed allegiance shortly before the election.

zh.t: 2019年布莱顿和霍夫市议会选举
zh.s: 布莱顿和霍夫市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，全部54席改选，与英格兰和北爱尔兰其他地方选举同期进行。工党比2015年少3席，但重新成为议会最大党。2015年选举后，工党议员人数在四年内从23人降至19人；2019年选举前不久，一名工党议员转投保守党，使保守党党团增加一人。

en.s: The 2019 Middlesbrough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Middlesbrough Council in England.

zh.s: 米德尔斯堡议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出英格兰米德尔斯堡议会议员。

en.s: The 2019 Babergh District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Babergh District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 巴伯格区议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出英格兰巴伯格区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2019 Torridge Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Torridge District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The whole council was up for election on new boundaries.

zh.s: 托里奇区议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出英格兰托里奇区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会全部席位按新的选区边界改选。

en.s: The 2019 Darlington Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of the Darlington Borough Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 达灵顿自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出英格兰达灵顿自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2019 Bolton Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Bolton Council in Greater Manchester, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2019年博尔顿都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 博尔顿都市自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出英格兰大曼彻斯特郡博尔顿议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2019 South Holland District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of the South Holland District Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 南荷兰区议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出英格兰南荷兰区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。

en.s: The 2019 Selby District Council election was held on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Selby District Council in England. It was the final election to the authority before its dissolution in 2023, and subsequent subsumption into the unitary North Yorkshire Council. The election saw the Conservative Party maintain overall control of the District Council with a reduced majority.

zh.s: 塞尔比区议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出英格兰塞尔比区议会议员。这是该区议会撤销前的最后一次选举。议会于2023年撤销，随后并入单一制的北约克郡议会。保守党继续掌控议会，但多数席位减少。

en.t: 2019 East Riding of Yorkshire Council election
en.s: The 2019 East Riding of Yorkshire Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect all 67 members of East Riding of Yorkshire Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The whole of the council was up for election and the Conservative Party retained control of the council.

zh.s: 东约克郡议会全部67个席位于2019年5月2日改选，选出英格兰东约克郡议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。保守党继续掌控议会。

en.s: The 2019 Guildford Borough Council election was held on 2 May 2019, to elect all 48 seats to the Guildford Borough Council in Surrey, England as part of the 2019 local elections. The Liberal Democrats won the most seats (17), the Residents for Guildford and Villages, a new political party formed in early 2019, came second with 15 seats, while the ruling Conservatives lost their majority, coming third with 9 seats.

zh.t: 2019年吉尔福德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 吉尔福德自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，改选英格兰萨里郡吉尔福德自治市议会全部48个席位，是2019年地方选举的一部分。自由民主党赢得最多席位，取得17席。2019年初成立的新党“吉尔福德及村庄居民党”以15席排名第二。执政的保守党失去多数，以9席排名第三。

en.s: The 2019 Wokingham Borough Council election took place on Thursday 2 May 2019. That was the same day as other United Kingdom local elections in order to elect members of Wokingham Unitary Council in Berkshire, England. One third of the council was up for election.

zh.t: 2019年沃金厄姆自治市议会选举
zh.s: 沃金厄姆自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日星期四举行，与英国其他地方选举同日进行，选出英格兰伯克郡沃金厄姆单一制议会议员。议会三分之一席位改选。

en.s: The 2019 Worthing Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Worthing Borough Council. This was on the same day as other local elections. A third of the council was up for election, meaning a total of 11 councillors were elected from council's wards, there being no election in Durrington and Northbrook in this cycle.

zh.s: 沃辛自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出沃辛自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位改选，共选出11名议员。本轮选举中，达灵顿和诺斯布鲁克选区没有举行选举。

en.s: The 2019 Blackpool Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Blackpool Council in England. Blackpool Council had been controlled by the Labour Party since 2011, which held a majority of ten with 26 councillors. The Conservatives were defending twelve seats, and independent councillors were defending four.

zh.s: 布莱克浦议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出英格兰布莱克浦议会议员。工党自2011年以来一直掌控议会，拥有26名议员和10席多数。保守党有12席需要守住，独立议员有4席需要守住。

en.s: Elections to Southampton City Council took place on Thursday 2 May 2019, alongside other local elections across the country. The Labour Party held a narrow majority of two at the last election and the seats contested in this election were last contested in 2015. Labour were defending 6 seats, the Conservatives were defending 8, whilst independent councillors, who held two seats, were not standing re-elections.

zh.s: 南安普敦市议会选举于2019年5月2日星期四举行，与全国其他地方选举同期进行。上次选举后，工党以2席多数掌控议会。本次改选的席位上次是在2015年改选。工党有6席需要守住，保守党有8席需要守住；拥有两席的独立议员没有寻求连任。

en.s: The 2019 United Kingdom local elections took place on Thursday 2 May 2019, with 248 English local councils, six directly elected mayors in England, and all 11 local councils in Northern Ireland being contested. A total of 8,886 councillors were elected: terms were up for 8,861 seats, but eight elections for a total of 14 seats were postponed due to the death of a candidate; there were also casual vacancies to be filled: 38 in England (including on nine councils with no other elections) and one on Dundee City Council in Scotland.

zh.s: 2019年英国地方选举于2019年5月2日星期四举行，英格兰248个地方议会、6个市长直选职位以及北爱尔兰全部11个地方议会均进行选举。共选出8,886名议员：任期届满的席位有8,861个，另有8场选举涉及14个席位，因候选人去世而推迟；此外还要填补临时空缺，包括英格兰的38席（其中9个议会没有其他选举）和苏格兰邓迪市议会的1席。

en.t: 2019 Cheshire West and Chester Council election
en.s: The 2019 Cheshire West and Chester Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Cheshire West and Chester Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Five fewer seats were contested because of boundary changes. No party gained overall control.

zh.t: 2019年柴郡西和切斯特议会选举
zh.s: 柴郡西和切斯特议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出英格兰柴郡西和切斯特议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。由于选区边界调整，改选席位比此前少5个。没有任何政党取得多数。

en.s: The 2019 Herefordshire Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect 52 of 53 members of Herefordshire Council in England. The election in Ross North ward was deferred until 6 June 2019 following the death of the UKIP candidate.

zh.s: 赫里福德郡议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，改选英格兰赫里福德郡议会53席中的52席。英国独立党候选人去世后，罗斯北选区的选举推迟到2019年6月6日举行。

en.s: The 2019 Barrow-in-Furness Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Barrow-in-Furness Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party held their control of the council, even though their majority decreased to 12.

zh.t: 2019年巴罗因弗内斯自治市议会选举
zh.s: 巴罗因弗内斯自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出英格兰巴罗因弗内斯自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。工党继续掌控议会，但多数席位减少至12席。

en.t: 2019 St Helens Metropolitan Borough Council election
en.s: The 2019 St Helens Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of St Helens Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. With one third of the seats on the council up for election Labour lost control of four seats although Labour retained overall control of the council.

zh.t: 2019年圣海伦斯都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 圣海伦斯都市自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出英格兰圣海伦斯都市自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一席位改选。工党失去4席，但仍继续掌控议会。

en.s: The 2019 Test Valley Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Test Valley Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The whole council was up for election on new boundaries, with the number of seats reduced from 48 across 24 wards to 43 across 20.

zh.t: 2019年泰斯特谷自治市议会选举
zh.s: 泰斯特谷自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出英格兰泰斯特谷自治市议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。议会全部席位按新的选区边界改选，席位从24个选区的48席减至20个选区的43席。

en.s: The 2019 Mid Devon District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of the Mid Devon District Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. At the elections the Conservatives lost control of the council, with no party winning an overall majority.

zh.s: 中德文区议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出英格兰中德文区议会议员，与其他地方选举同日进行。保守党失去议会控制权，没有任何政党取得多数。

en.s: The 2019 Bolsover District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect all 37 members of Bolsover District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The election resulted in the Labour Party losing control of the council for the first time in 40 years after winning 18 seats, one short of a majority.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行博尔索弗区议会选举，选出英格兰博尔索弗区议会的全部37名议员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。工党赢得18席，距过半数还差1席，并因此失去对议会长达40年的控制。

en.s: The 2019 Uttlesford District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Uttlesford District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2019年阿特尔斯福德区议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行阿特尔斯福德区议会选举，选出英格兰阿特尔斯福德区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.t: 2019 Newark and Sherwood District Council election
en.s: The 2019 Newark and Sherwood District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect all 39 members of Newark and Sherwood District Council in Nottinghamshire, England. This took place as part of the 2019 local elections.

zh.t: 2019年纽瓦克和舍伍德区议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行纽瓦克和舍伍德区议会选举，选出英格兰诺丁汉郡纽瓦克和舍伍德区议会的全部39名议员。这是2019年地方选举的一部分。

en.s: The 2019 Staffordshire Moorlands District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Staffordshire Moorlands District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2019年斯塔福德郡荒原区议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行斯塔福德郡荒原区议会选举，选出英格兰斯塔福德郡荒原区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: Elections to Chesterfield Borough Council in Derbyshire, England were held on 2 May 2019.

zh.t: 2019年切斯特菲尔德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 英格兰德比郡切斯特菲尔德自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行。

en.s: The 2019 Spelthorne Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect all members of Spelthorne Borough Council in England. The Conservatives retained control of the council, but with a reduced majority of 7, down from 31.

zh.t: 2019年斯佩尔索恩自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行斯佩尔索恩自治市议会选举，选出英格兰斯佩尔索恩自治市议会的全部议员。保守党保住了议会控制权，但多数席位从31席降至7席。

en.t: 2019 Folkestone and Hythe District Council election
en.s: Elections to Folkestone & Hythe District Council were held on 2 May 2019.

zh.t: 2019年福克斯通和海斯区议会选举
zh.s: 福克斯通和海斯区议会选举于2019年5月2日举行。

en.s: Elections to Cheshire East Council took place on Thursday 2 May 2019 in all 52 wards, with each ward returning between one and three councillors to the council. The Conservative Party lost overall control of the council, losing 17 seats; the Labour Party gained 9 seats, independents gained 6 and the Liberal Democrats gained 2. The elections were held against a background of a number of controversies, with the council facing eight criminal investigations.

zh.s: 柴郡东议会选举于2019年5月2日（星期四）举行，覆盖全部52个选区，每个选区选出1至3名议员。保守党失去对议会的多数控制权，丢掉17席；工党增加9席，无党派候选人增加6席，自由民主党增加2席。选举期间争议不断，议会正面临8项刑事调查。

en.s: The 2019 Newcastle City Council election took place on 2 May 2019, on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom. One third of the seats — 26 out of the 78 — were up for election, being the seats of the councillors who finished third in each individual ward at the all-out elections in 2018, with an additional seat up in the Monument ward following the resignation of a Labour councillor.

zh.s: 2019年纽卡斯尔市议会选举于5月2日举行，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。78个席位中有三分之一（26席）改选，这些席位由2018年全体改选中在各选区排名第三的议员担任。此外，纪念碑选区的一名工党议员辞职，因此该席位也进行补选。

en.t: 2019 North East Derbyshire District Council election
en.s: The 2019 North East Derbyshire District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of North East Derbyshire District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The whole council was up for election on new boundaries. The Conservatives gained control of the council from the Labour Party for the first time ever.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行东北德比郡区议会选举，选出英格兰东北德比郡区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。由于采用新的选区边界，议会全部改选。保守党首次从工党手中夺得议会控制权。

en.s: Elections to Southend-on-Sea Borough Council took place on 2 May 2019. This was on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom. The election led to the majority Conservative administration being replaced by a "rainbow coalition" between the Independents, Labour and the Liberal Democrats, which was voted in by a vote of 27-20.

zh.t: 2019年绍森德海滨自治市议会选举
zh.s: 绍森德海滨自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同日进行。选举后，原由保守党多数控制的议会改由无党派议员、工党和自由民主党组成的“彩虹联盟”执政，并以27比20的投票结果获准组阁。

en.s: The 2019 Derbyshire Dales District Council election was held on 2 May 2019 to elect all 39 councillors for Derbyshire Dales District Council. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Conservative Party retained control of the council for the fifth consecutive election, with a significantly reduced majority of 1.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行德比郡谷区议会选举，选出该区议会全部39名议员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。保守党连续第五次选举保住议会控制权，但多数席位大幅缩小至1席。

en.t: 2019 Oadby and Wigston Borough Council election
en.s: Elections to Oadby and Wigston Borough Council took place on 2 May 2019, the same day as other United Kingdom local elections. All wards were up for election, each with 2 or 3 councillors to be elected. The Liberal Democrats retained overall control of the council.

zh.t: 2019年奥德比和威格斯顿自治市议会选举
zh.s: 奥德比和威格斯顿自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。所有选区都进行改选，每个选区选出2至3名议员。自由民主党保住了议会的总体控制权。

en.t: 2019 Bournemouth, Christchurch and Poole Council election
en.s: The 2019 Bournemouth, Christchurch and Poole Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect the inaugural members of Bournemouth, Christchurch and Poole Council in England, formed from the former unitary authorities of Bournemouth and Poole, and borough of Christchurch. At the same time an election for the new Christchurch Town Council was held.

zh.t: 2019年伯恩茅斯、基督城和普尔议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行伯恩茅斯、基督城和普尔议会选举，选出英格兰新成立的伯恩茅斯、基督城和普尔议会首届成员。该议会由原伯恩茅斯和普尔单一管理区以及基督城自治市合并组建。同日还举行了新基督城市议会选举。

en.s: The 2019 Dartford Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of the Dartford Borough Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2019年达特福德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行达特福德自治市议会选举，选出英格兰达特福德自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.t: 2019 Bath and North East Somerset Council election
en.s: The 2019 Bath and North East Somerset Council election was held on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Bath and North East Somerset Council in England. The Liberal Democrats took control of the council in 2019, winning thirty-seven seats with a working majority of seven.

zh.t: 2019年巴斯和东北萨默塞特议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行巴斯和东北萨默塞特议会选举，选出英格兰巴斯和东北萨默塞特议会成员。自由民主党赢得37席，取得议会控制权，多数席位为7席。

en.s: The 2019 New Forest District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of New Forest District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Conservatives were the only party to stand enough candidates to gain an outright majority, as they were the only party to stand a candidate in more than half the seats, with Liberal Democrats, who defended 2 seats, standing 28 candidates, and Labour, which had no incumbents, standing 30 candidates.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行新森林区议会选举，选出英格兰新森林区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。保守党是唯一派出足够候选人、可能赢得绝对多数的政党，因为只有该党在半数以上席位中提名了候选人。自由民主党有2个席位需要守住，却只提名了28名候选人；工党没有现任议员，提名了30名候选人。

en.s: The 2019 Epping Forest District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Epping Forest District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行埃平森林区议会选举，选出英格兰埃平森林区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 Havant Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Havant Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行哈文特自治市议会选举，选出英格兰哈文特自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 Cotswold District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect all members of Cotswold District Council, as part of the United Kingdom local elections. The Conservatives had controlled the council since 2003 but lost ten seats. The Liberal Democrats won overall control of the council for the first time since the council's creation in 1974.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行科茨沃尔德区议会选举，改选科茨沃尔德区议会全部席位。这是英国地方选举的一部分。保守党自2003年以来一直控制该议会，但此次失去10席。自由民主党自该议会1974年成立以来首次赢得多数，取得议会控制权。

en.s: Elections to Stafford Borough Council were held on Thursday 2 May 2019.

zh.t: 2019年斯塔福德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 斯塔福德自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日（星期四）举行。

en.s: The 2019 Hartlepool Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Hartlepool Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2019年哈特尔浦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行哈特尔浦自治市议会选举，选出英格兰哈特尔浦自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.t: 2019 Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council election
en.s: Elections to Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council took place on Thursday, 2 May 2019, alongside other local elections across the country. Elections took place in 20 of the 60 seats.

zh.t: 2019年贝辛斯托克和迪恩自治市议会选举
zh.s: 贝辛斯托克和迪恩自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日（星期四）举行，与全国其他地方选举同期进行。60个席位中有20席进行改选。

en.s: The 2019 Erewash Borough Council election was held on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Erewash Borough Council in Derbyshire, England. The whole council was up for election.

zh.t: 2019年埃里沃什自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行埃里沃什自治市议会选举，选出英格兰德比郡埃里沃什自治市议会成员。议会全部席位均进行改选。

en.s: The 2019 Dover District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of the Dover District Council in Kent, England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. It was the first election to be held after boundary changes reduced the number of seats from 45 to 32. The Conservative Party retained overall control of the council.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行多佛区议会选举，选出英格兰肯特郡多佛区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。由于选区边界调整，议席从45席减至32席，这是调整后的首次选举。保守党保住了议会的总体控制权。

en.s: The 2019 Bedford Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Bedford Borough Council in England. Bedford Borough Council has been under no overall control since 2010. The Conservatives defended fifteen seats, Labour defended fourteen, the Liberal Democrats defended nine and independent councillors defended two seats. Bedford is run by the directly elected Mayor of Bedford, who has been Liberal Democrat Dave Hodgson since 2009.

zh.t: 2019年贝德福德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行贝德福德自治市议会选举，选出英格兰贝德福德自治市议会成员。自2010年以来，该议会一直没有任何政党或团体单独控制。保守党有15席需要守住，工党有14席，自由民主党有9席，无党派议员有2席。贝德福德由直选市长管理；自2009年以来，市长一直是自由民主党人戴夫·霍奇森。

en.s: Elections to the South Hams District Council took place on 2 May 2019, the same day as other United Kingdom local elections. All 20 wards were up for election, each with either 1, 2, or 3 councillors to be elected. The Conservative Party retained overall control of the council, but with its majority reduced to just 1 seat.

zh.s: 南哈姆斯区议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。全部20个选区均进行改选，每个选区选出1至3名议员。保守党保住了议会的总体控制权，但多数席位缩小到仅1席。

en.s: The 2019 Telford and Wrekin Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of the Telford and Wrekin Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. The Labour group, led by Shaun Davies, increased their number of councillors by 9, giving them an overall majority. The Conservative group, led by Andrew Eade, lost 10 councillors.

zh.t: 2019年特尔福德和雷金议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行特尔福德和雷金议会选举，选出英格兰特尔福德和雷金议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。由肖恩·戴维斯领导的工党团体增加了9名议员，取得多数席位。由安德鲁·伊迪领导的保守党团体失去10名议员。

en.s: The 2019 Cambridge City Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Cambridge City Council in England. It took place on the same day as other nationwide local elections. There were 90,575 registered electors, and turnout was 36.6%.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行剑桥市议会选举，选出英格兰剑桥市议会成员。选举与英国各地其他地方选举在同一天举行。登记选民共90,575人，投票率为36.6%。

en.s: The 2019 South Derbyshire District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of South Derbyshire District Council in England. This was the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行南德比郡区议会选举，选出英格兰南德比郡区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 Torbay Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Torbay Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Conservatives lost the council to no overall control.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行托贝市议会选举，选出英格兰托贝市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。保守党失去对议会的控制，此后没有任何政党单独掌控议会。

en.s: Elections to Broxtowe Borough Council were held on 2 May 2019.

zh.t: 2019年布罗克斯托自治市议会选举
zh.s: 布罗克斯托自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行。

en.s: The 2019 Great Yarmouth Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Great Yarmouth Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England.

zh.t: 2019年大雅茅斯自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行大雅茅斯自治市议会选举，选出英格兰大雅茅斯自治市议会成员。选举与英格兰其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 North Somerset Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of North Somerset Council in England. North Somerset unitary council is elected every four years, with fifty councillors to be elected. Since the first election to the unitary authority in 1995, the council has either been under Conservative Party control, or no party has held a majority.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行北萨默塞特议会选举，选出英格兰北萨默塞特议会成员。北萨默塞特单一管理区议会每四年改选一次，共选出50名议员。自1995年该单一管理区首次选举以来，议会一直由保守党控制，或没有任何政党占多数。

en.s: The 2019 Rushmoor Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Rushmoor Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2019年拉什穆尔自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行拉什穆尔自治市议会选举，选出英格兰拉什穆尔自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.t: 2019 Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council election
en.s: An election was held on 2 May 2019 to elect all 54 members of Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council. Parish council elections were held on the same day. The Conservatives retained control of the council despite losing seats. The Green Party won their first seats on the council, winning 2 seats in Judd ward.

zh.t: 2019年汤布里奇和马灵自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行选举，改选汤布里奇和马灵自治市议会全部54名议员。同日还举行了教区议会选举。保守党虽然失去席位，仍保住了议会控制权。绿党首次在该议会赢得席位，在贾德选区获得2席。

en.t: 2019 Somerset West and Taunton District Council election
en.s: The 2019 Somerset West and Taunton District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Somerset West and Taunton District Council in Somerset, England. This was the first election since the West Somerset District Council and Taunton Deane merged, with the whole council being up for election.

zh.t: 2019年萨默塞特西和汤顿区议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行萨默塞特西和汤顿区议会选举，选出英格兰萨默塞特郡萨默塞特西和汤顿区议会成员。这是西萨默塞特区议会与汤顿迪恩区合并后首次选举，议会全部席位均进行改选。

en.s: The 2019 Stoke-on-Trent City Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Stoke-on-Trent City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2019年特伦特河畔斯托克市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行特伦特河畔斯托克市议会选举，选出英格兰特伦特河畔斯托克市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 Rushcliffe Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of the Rushcliffe Borough Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections, as well as parish council elections in the borough.

zh.t: 2019年拉什克利夫自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行拉什克利夫自治市议会选举，选出英格兰拉什克利夫自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举以及自治市内的教区议会选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 Teignbridge District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Teignbridge District Council in England. At the election, the Liberal Democrats won control of the council.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行蒂恩布里奇区议会选举，选出英格兰蒂恩布里奇区议会成员。自由民主党在此次选举中赢得议会控制权。

en.s: The 2019 Walsall Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019, to elect members of the Walsall Metropolitan Borough Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2019年沃尔索尔都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行沃尔索尔都会自治市议会选举，选出英格兰沃尔索尔都会自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 Breckland District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Breckland District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The boundaries for this election were the same as those used in 2015.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行布雷克兰区议会选举，选出英格兰布雷克兰区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。本次选举的选区边界与2015年相同。

en.t: 2019 Forest of Dean District Council election
en.s: The 2019 Forest of Dean District Council election was held on 2 May 2019 as part of the 2019 United Kingdom local elections. This was the first election in the Forest of Dean following a boundary review, which reduced the total number of Councillors from 48 to 38. Due to the boundary review, party seat changes in the summary box (right) are based on notional results, not the actual 2015 results.

zh.s: 迪恩森林区议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，是2019年英国地方选举的一部分。选区边界审查后举行的首次选举使议员总数从48人减至38人。由于边界有所调整，右侧摘要框中的各党席位变化依据的是推算结果，而非2015年的实际结果。

en.s: The 2019 Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Stockport Council is elected in thirds, which means that in each three member local ward, one councillor is elected every year, except every four years which is classed as a fallow year.

zh.t: 2019年斯托克波特都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行斯托克波特都会自治市议会选举，选出英格兰斯托克波特都会自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。斯托克波特议会采用三分之一改选制：每个有3名议员的地方选区每年改选1名议员，每四年有一年不举行选举。

en.s: Elections to Welwyn Hatfield Borough Council took place on 2 May 2019. This was on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom. Following the trend of the elections across the UK, the Liberal Democrats made significant gains in the popular vote at the cost of the Conservative Party and Labour.

zh.t: 2019年韦尔温哈特菲尔德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 韦尔温哈特菲尔德自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同日进行。与英国其他地方选举的整体趋势相同，自由民主党的得票显著增加，增幅主要来自保守党和工党。

en.s: The 2019 West Berkshire Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of West Berkshire Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The whole council was up for election and the Conservative Party retained overall control of the council, despite significant gains by the Liberal Democrats and the election of the first Green Party councillors in West Berkshire.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行西伯克郡议会选举，选出英格兰西伯克郡议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。议会全部席位均进行改选。尽管自由民主党取得明显进展，且西伯克郡首次有绿党议员当选，保守党仍保住了议会的总体控制权。

en.s: The 2019 Redditch Borough Council elections took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Redditch Borough Council, a district-level local authority in Worcestershire, England.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行雷迪奇自治市议会选举，选出英格兰伍斯特郡地方行政区雷迪奇自治市议会成员。

en.s: The 2019 West Suffolk District Council election was held on 2 May 2019 and was the inaugural election of the new West Suffolk District Council. It was held concurrently with other local elections across the United Kingdom. The Conservative Party won 36 of the 64 seats, giving it outright control of the new council.

zh.s: 西萨福克区议会首次选举于2019年5月2日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同期进行。保守党赢得64席中的36席，从而取得新议会的绝对控制权。

en.s: The 2019 Charnwood Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of the Charnwood Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2019年查恩伍德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行查恩伍德自治市议会选举，选出英格兰查恩伍德自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 Leeds City Council election took place on Thursday 2 May 2019 to elect members of Leeds City Council in England. It was held on the same day as other UK local elections across England and Northern Ireland. As per the election cycle, one third of the council's 99 seats were up for election. This followed the re-election of all of the 99 council seats in the 2018 all-out council election.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日（星期四）举行利兹市议会选举，选出英格兰利兹市议会成员。选举与英格兰和北爱尔兰其他地方选举在同一天举行。根据选举周期，市议会99个席位中的三分之一进行改选。此前，2018年曾举行全体改选，99个席位全部重选。

en.t: 2019 King's Lynn and West Norfolk Borough Council election
en.s: The 2019 King's Lynn & West Norfolk Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of King's Lynn & West Norfolk Borough Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2019年金斯林和西诺福克自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行金斯林和西诺福克自治市议会选举，选出英格兰诺福克郡该自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: Elections to Medway Council were held on 2 May 2019 as part of the 2019 United Kingdom local elections. The elections were for all 55 councillors across 22 wards.

zh.s: 梅德韦议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，是2019年英国地方选举的一部分。此次选举改选22个选区的全部55名议员。

en.s: The 2019 Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. One councillor was elected in each ward for a four-year term so the councillors elected in 2019 last stood for election in 2015.

zh.t: 2019年考尔德代尔都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行考尔德代尔都会自治市议会选举，选出英格兰考尔德代尔都会自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。每个选区选出1名议员，任期4年，因此2019年当选的议员上一次参加选举是在2015年。

en.s: The 2019 Worcester City Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect councillors to the Worcester City Council in England.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行伍斯特市议会选举，选出英格兰伍斯特市议会议员。

en.s: The 2019 Allerdale Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect all 49 members of Allerdale Borough Council in Cumbria, England. The number of councillors had been reduced from 56 at the previous election following a boundary review, meaning that several seats were combined. Four seats were uncontested, all of which were won by Conservative candidates.

zh.t: 2019年阿勒代尔自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行阿勒代尔自治市议会选举，改选英格兰坎布里亚郡阿勒代尔自治市议会全部49名议员。此前，选区边界审查后议员人数从上次选举的56人减至49人，因此有几个席位合并。4个席位无人竞争，均由保守党候选人当选。

en.s: Elections to Stevenage Borough Council took place on 2 May 2019. This was on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom. One third of the council was up for election; the seats that were last contested in 2015. The Labour Party retained control of the council, which it has held continuously since 1973.

zh.t: 2019年史蒂文尼奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 史蒂文尼奇自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同日进行。议会三分之一的席位进行改选，这些席位上次于2015年改选。工党保住了议会控制权；自1973年以来，该党一直控制议会。

en.s: The 2019 elections to Nottingham City Council were held on 2 May 2019 to elect all 55 members to the council across 20 wards.

zh.s: 诺丁汉市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，改选20个选区的全部55名议员。

en.s: The 2019 Chelmsford City Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Chelmsford City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行切姆斯福德市议会选举，选出英格兰切姆斯福德市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: Elections to Chichester District Council in West Sussex, United Kingdom were held on 2 May 2019. The whole council was up for election and the Conservative Party had its majority wiped out.

zh.s: 英国西萨塞克斯郡奇切斯特区议会选举于2019年5月2日举行。议会全部席位均进行改选，保守党的多数席位优势被彻底抹去。

en.s: The 2019 Trafford Metropolitan Borough Council election to elect members of Trafford Metropolitan Borough Council in England took place on 2 May 2019. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of the council stood for election, with each successful candidate serving a four-year term of office, expiring in 2023.

zh.t: 2019年特拉福德都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行特拉福德都会自治市议会选举，选出英格兰特拉福德都会自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。议会三分之一的席位进行改选，每位当选者任期4年，至2023年届满。

en.s: The 2019 Crawley Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Crawley Borough Council in West Sussex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The entire council was up for election after ward boundaries changed and the Labour Party retained control of the council.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行克劳利自治市议会选举，选出英格兰西萨塞克斯郡克劳利自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。由于选区边界调整，议会全部席位均进行改选，工党保住了议会控制权。

en.s: The 2019 Liverpool City Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Liverpool City Council in England. This was the same day as other local elections. Due to the 'in thirds' system of election, one third of the council were up for election, with comparisons to previous results made with the corresponding vote at the 2015 Liverpool City Council election.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行利物浦市议会选举，选出英格兰利物浦市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。利物浦采用每年改选三分之一议席的制度，因此本次结果与2015年利物浦市议会选举中相应的选票进行比较。

en.s: The 2019 West Devon Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019, to elect members of West Devon Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行西德文自治市议会选举，选出英格兰西德文自治市议会成员。选举与英格兰其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 Solihull Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Solihull Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Immediately before the election, the council comprised 31 Conservatives, 11 Greens, four Liberal Democrats, three independents and two Labour councillors. This included Knowle councillor Alan Rebeiro, who had left the Conservative group to sit as an independent in July 2018.

zh.t: 2019年索利赫尔都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行索利赫尔都会自治市议会选举，选出英格兰索利赫尔都会自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。选举前，议会由31名保守党议员、11名绿党议员、4名自由民主党议员、3名无党派议员和2名工党议员组成。其中，诺尔选区议员艾伦·雷贝罗于2018年7月退出保守党团，以无党派议员身份任职。

en.s: The 2019 East Suffolk District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect all 55 members of the recently formed East Suffolk District Council in England. This was held on the same day as other local council elections across England.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行东萨福克区议会选举，改选英格兰新成立的东萨福克区议会全部55名议员。选举与英格兰其他地方议会选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 Ashford Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Ashford Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

en.s: The 2019 Wigan Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on Thursday 2 May 2019 to elect members of Wigan Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 威根都会自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日（星期四）举行，选出英格兰威根都会自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 Eden District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Eden District Council in England. The council went from Conservative control to No overall control. This was on the same day as other local elections.

en.s: The 2019 Halton Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of the Halton Borough Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections.

en.s: The 2019 Melton Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of the Melton Borough Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行梅尔顿自治市议会选举，选出英格兰梅尔顿自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 Wyre Forest District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Wyre Forest District Council in Worcestershire, England. They were held on the same day as other local elections.

en.t: 2019 Windsor and Maidenhead Borough Council election
en.s: The 2019 Windsor and Maidenhead Borough Council election took place on Thursday 2 May 2019. That was the same day as other United Kingdom local elections in order to elect members of Windsor and Maidenhead Council in Berkshire, England. The whole council was up for election.

zh.t: 2019年温莎和梅登黑德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 温莎和梅登黑德自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国其他地方选举同日进行，选出英格兰伯克郡温莎和梅登黑德议会成员。议会全部席位均进行改选。

en.s: The 2019 Rother District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Rother District Council in East Sussex, England.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行罗瑟区议会选举，选出英格兰东萨塞克斯郡罗瑟区议会成员。

en.s: Local elections were held in Northern Ireland on Thursday 2 May 2019. The last elections were held in 2014. 819 candidates contested 462 seats across Northern Ireland's 11 local government districts. 1,305,384 people aged 18 and over were eligible to vote, and 52.7% of the electorate turned out.

zh.s: 北爱尔兰地方选举于2019年5月2日（星期四）举行。上一次选举在2014年举行。共有819名候选人角逐北爱尔兰11个地方政府区的462个席位。1305384名年满18岁的人有投票资格，投票率为52.7%。

en.s: The 2019 Stratford-on-Avon District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of the Stratford-on-Avon District Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2019年埃文河畔斯特拉特福区议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行埃文河畔斯特拉特福区议会选举，选出英格兰埃文河畔斯特拉特福区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 North Devon District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of North Devon District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The whole council was up for election on new boundaries.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行北德文区议会选举，选出英格兰北德文区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。由于采用了新的选区边界，议会全部席位均进行改选。

en.s: The 2019 Waverley Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Waverley Borough Council in England as one of the 2019 local elections.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行韦弗利自治市议会选举，选出英格兰韦弗利自治市议会成员，是2019年地方选举之一。

en.s: The 2019 Hart District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Hart District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行哈特区议会选举，选出英格兰哈特区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 Bassetlaw District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect all 48 members of Bassetlaw District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The election resulted in the Labour Party retaining its control of the council with an increased majority. The Conservative Party suffered its worst defeat in Bassetlaw since 1973, winning only 5 seats of the 12 seats it was defending.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行巴塞特劳区议会选举，改选英格兰巴塞特劳区议会全部48名议员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。工党增加多数席位，继续控制议会。保守党遭遇自1973年以来在巴塞特劳最惨重的失利，在其原本需要守住的12席中只赢得5席。

en.t: 2019 Hinckley and Bosworth Borough Council election
en.s: The 2019 Hinckley and Bosworth Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Hinckley and Bosworth Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The election resulted in the Liberal Democrats gaining control of the council from the Conservatives.

zh.t: 2019年欣克利和博斯沃思自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行欣克利和博斯沃思自治市议会选举，选出英格兰欣克利和博斯沃思自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。自由民主党从保守党手中赢得议会控制权。

en.s: The 2019 Harborough District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of the Harborough District Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行哈伯勒区议会选举，选出英格兰哈伯勒区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 South Oxfordshire District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of South Oxfordshire District Council in Oxfordshire, England. The whole council was up for election. The Conservatives lost control of the council.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行南牛津郡区议会选举，选出英格兰牛津郡南牛津郡区议会成员。议会全部席位均进行改选。保守党失去对议会的控制。

en.t: 2019 Vale of White Horse District Council election
en.s: The 2019 Vale of White Horse District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Vale of White Horse District Council in England. This was held on the same day as other local elections as part of the 2019 United Kingdom local elections. The election saw a landslide for the Liberal Democrats, who regained control of the council from the Conservatives after having previously lost control in 2011.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行白马谷区议会选举，选出英格兰白马谷区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行，是2019年英国地方选举的一部分。自由民主党以压倒性优势获胜，从保守党手中重新夺回议会控制权；该党曾于2011年失去控制权。

en.s: The 2019 Braintree District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Braintree District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Some minor ward boundary changes were made in February 2019. 49 members were elected from 26 wards.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行布伦特里区议会选举，选出英格兰布伦特里区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。2019年2月对部分选区边界作了小幅调整。此次选举从26个选区选出49名议员。

en.s: The 2019 Gravesham Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of the Gravesham Borough Council in Kent, England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party gained control of the council from the Conservative Party. Cllr Gurdip Bungar was elected as Mayor of Gravesham for the year 2019-2020.

zh.t: 2019年格雷夫舍姆自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行格雷夫舍姆自治市议会选举，选出英格兰肯特郡格雷夫舍姆自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。工党从保守党手中赢得议会控制权。古迪普·邦加议员当选格雷夫舍姆市长，任期为2019至2020年。

en.s: Elections to Manchester City Council were held on 2 May 2019, as part of the 2019 United Kingdom local elections. In 2018 Labour retained its majority of the council with 94 seats to the Liberal Democrats making up the opposition of 2, led by former MP John Leech.

zh.s: 曼彻斯特市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，是英国2019年地方选举的一部分。2018年，工党以94席保住议会多数席位，自由民主党仅有2席，由前议员约翰·利奇领导，成为反对党。

en.s: The 2019 Swindon Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019, to elect members of Swindon Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行斯温顿自治市议会选举，选出英格兰斯温顿自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 Bromsgrove District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of the Bromsgrove Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2019年布罗姆斯格罗夫区议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行布罗姆斯格罗夫区议会选举，选出英格兰布罗姆斯格罗夫区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 Eastbourne District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Eastbourne Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. All 27 members of the council were elected over 9 3 member wards. The Liberal Democrats maintained majority control of the Council.

zh.t: 2019年伊斯特本自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行伊斯特本区议会选举，选出英格兰伊斯特本自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。议会全部27名成员由9个三人选区选出。自由民主党继续以多数席位控制议会。

en.s: The 2019 Maldon District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Maldon District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行马尔登区议会选举，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡马尔登区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 Mid Ulster District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Mid Ulster District Council in Northern Ireland. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2019年米德阿尔斯特区议会选举
zh.s: 2019年米德阿尔斯特区议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出北爱尔兰米德阿尔斯特区议会议员。当天英国其他地区也举行了地方选举。

en.s: The 2019 Horsham District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Horsham District Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. Every seat was contested and the Conservatives retained control of the council with a majority of 8.

zh.s: 2019年霍舍姆区议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出英格兰霍舍姆区议会议员。选举与当天的其他地方选举同期举行。全部席位改选，保守党保住议会控制权，并以8席优势占多数。

en.s: The 2019 Milton Keynes Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Milton Keynes Council in England. This election was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行米尔顿凯恩斯议会选举，选出英格兰米尔顿凯恩斯议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 Mid Suffolk District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Mid Suffolk District Council in Suffolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行中萨福克区议会选举，选出英格兰萨福克郡中萨福克区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 Reading Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members in 15 wards of Reading Borough Council. There was also a casual vacancy in Thames ward. The Labour Party held control of the council. The Liberal Democrats and the Green Party succeeded in making significant increases in their vote across the borough, the Liberal Democrats gaining Tilehurst from the Conservatives and the Green Party gaining Redlands Ward from The Labour Party.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行雷丁自治市议会选举，改选雷丁自治市议会15个选区的议员。泰晤士选区另有一个席位因空缺进行补选。工党继续控制议会。自由民主党和绿党在全自治市的得票均明显增加：自由民主党从保守党手中赢得泰尔赫斯特选区，绿党则从工党手中赢得雷德兰兹选区。

en.s: The 2019 East Hertfordshire District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect all members of East Hertfordshire District Council in England. The Conservatives retained control of the council, but lost 10 seats.

zh.t: 2019年东赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行东赫特福德郡区议会选举，改选英格兰东赫特福德郡区议会全部席位。保守党保住了议会控制权，但失去10席。

en.s: The 2019 South Gloucestershire Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of South Gloucestershire Council in England as part of nationwide local elections. A 2018 boundary change meant that the total number of seats in the council was reduced from 70 to 61. The Conservatives retained their control of the council, sliding from 40 seats to 33.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行南格洛斯特郡议会选举，选出英格兰南格洛斯特郡议会成员，是全国地方选举的一部分。2018年边界调整后，议会席位总数从70席减至61席。保守党保住了议会控制权，但席位从40席降至33席。

en.s: The 2019 Canterbury City Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of the Canterbury City Council in Kent, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Conservative Party retained overall control of the council.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行坎特伯雷市议会选举，选出英格兰肯特郡坎特伯雷市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。保守党保住了议会的总体控制权。

en.s: The 2019 East Hampshire District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of the East Hampshire District Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. New ward boundaries were used, with some new wards created, with others having their boundaries amended. Wards with the same name but amended boundaries are noted.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行东汉普郡区议会选举，选出英格兰东汉普郡区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。本次使用了新的选区边界：新增了一些选区，也调整了其他选区的边界。凡是名称相同但边界经过调整的选区，均作了注明。

en.s: The 2019 Wychavon District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Wychavon District Council. This was on the same day as other local elections. The entire council (45 seats) was up for election.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行怀奇文区议会选举，选出怀奇文区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。议会全部45个席位均进行改选。

en.s: The 2019 Broadland District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of the Broadland District Council in England. They were held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行布罗德兰区议会选举，选出英格兰布罗德兰区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 Dorset Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2019 to elect councillors to the new Dorset Council in England. It took place on the same day as other district council elections in the United Kingdom. These were the first elections to the new unitary council, which has come into effect on 1 April 2019.

zh.s: 多塞特议会选举于2019年5月2日（星期四）举行，选出英格兰新成立的多塞特议会议员。选举与英国其他地区议会选举在同一天举行。这是新单一管理区议会的首次选举，该议会于2019年4月1日正式成立。

en.t: 2019 St Albans City and District Council election
en.s: The 2019 St Albans City and District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of St Albans City and District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2019年圣奥尔本斯市和区议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行圣奥尔本斯市和区议会选举，选出英格兰圣奥尔本斯市和区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 South Staffordshire District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of the South Staffordshire District Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2019年南斯塔福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行南斯塔福德郡区议会选举，选出英格兰南斯塔福德郡区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 Mendip District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Mendip District Council in England. The council was abolished when Somerset became a Unitary Authority in 2022.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行门迪普区议会选举，选出英格兰门迪普区议会成员。该议会于2022年萨默塞特成为单一管理区后撤销。

en.t: 2019 Redcar and Cleveland Borough Council election
en.s: The 2019 Redcar and Cleveland Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Redcar and Cleveland Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The council was under no overall control prior to the election, being run by a Labour minority administration.

zh.t: 2019年雷德卡和克利夫兰自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行雷德卡和克利夫兰自治市议会选举，选出英格兰雷德卡和克利夫兰自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。选举前，没有任何政党单独控制议会，议会由工党少数派政府管理。

en.s: Elections to Amber Valley Borough Council in Derbyshire, England took place on Thursday 2 May 2019. One third of the council seats were up for election. The Labour Party gained overall control of the council, taking a total of five seats from the Conservatives. In addition, the Green Party gained representation for the first time.

zh.s: 安伯谷自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日（星期四）举行，选出英格兰德比郡安伯谷自治市议会成员。议会三分之一席位进行改选。工党从保守党手中赢得5席，取得议会总体控制权。此外，绿党首次在议会中获得席位。

en.s: The 2019 North Kesteven District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of North Kesteven District Council in Lincolnshire, England. This was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行北凯斯特文区议会选举，选出英格兰林肯郡北凯斯特文区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 Tewkesbury Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members for the 20 wards of the Tewkesbury Borough Council in England. At the election, the Conservatives retained control of the council.

zh.t: 2019年图克斯伯里自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行图克斯伯里自治市议会选举，选出英格兰图克斯伯里自治市议会20个选区的议员。保守党在此次选举中保住了议会控制权。

en.s: Elections to Thanet District Council took place on Thursday 2 May 2019, alongside other local elections across the country and parish council elections across Thanet, UK. The result saw the Conservative Party return to being the largest party on the council, after UKIP formed a majority then split into groups. The Labour Party also became the second largest party on the council.

zh.s: 塞尼特区议会选举于2019年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国各地其他地方选举以及塞尼特各地的教区议会选举同期进行。英国独立党曾在议会中取得多数，之后发生分裂；此次选举后，保守党重新成为议会第一大党，工党则成为第二大党。

en.s: The 2019 Knowsley Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Knowsley Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This election was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2019年诺斯利都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行诺斯利都会自治市议会选举，选出英格兰诺斯利都会自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.t: 2019 North West Leicestershire District Council election
en.s: The 2019 North West Leicestershire District Council election was held on 2 May 2019 to elect all 38 members of North West Leicestershire District Council in Leicestershire, England, as part of that year's local elections across England. The Conservative Party retained control of the council but with a reduced majority, losing five seats to finish with 20 of the 38 seats.

zh.t: 2019年西北莱斯特郡区议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行西北莱斯特郡区议会选举，改选英格兰莱斯特郡西北莱斯特郡区议会全部38名成员，是当年英格兰地方选举的一部分。保守党保住了议会控制权，但多数席位减少，失去5席，最终在38席中占20席。

en.s: The 2019 Fenland District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 for all 39 seats of the Fenland District Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections. In these elections, twelve councillors were returned unopposed, with Fenland District Council topping the Electoral Reform Society's list of 'rotten boroughs'.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行芬兰区议会选举，改选英格兰芬兰区议会全部39个席位。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。此次有12名议员未经竞争自动当选。芬兰区议会在选举改革协会的“腐败选区”名单中排名第一。

en.s: The 2019 Exeter City Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect the members of Exeter City Council in Devon, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. 14 of the 39 seats were up for re-election: those of the candidates who had finished second in the all-out election of 2016, with a double vacancy in Priory ward.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行埃克塞特市议会选举，选出英格兰德文郡埃克塞特市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。39个席位中有14席改选，这些席位由2016年全体改选中排名第二的候选人担任。普里奥里选区另有两个席位进行补选。

en.s: The 2019 North Lincolnshire Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect all 43 members of North Lincolnshire Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The election resulted in the Conservative Party retaining control of the council.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行北林肯郡议会选举，改选英格兰北林肯郡议会全部43名议员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。保守党保住了议会控制权。

en.s: The 2019 Mid Sussex District Council election took place on Thursday 2 May 2019 to elect members of Mid Sussex District Council in West Sussex, England.

zh.s: 中萨塞克斯区议会选举于2019年5月2日（星期四）举行，选出英格兰西萨塞克斯郡中萨塞克斯区议会成员。

en.s: The 2019 Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Wirral Metropolitan Borough Council in England. This election was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2019年威勒尔都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行威勒尔都会自治市议会选举，选出英格兰威勒尔都会自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: Elections to Winchester City Council took place on Thursday 2 May 2019, alongside other local elections across the country. The Conservatives Party held a narrow majority of one at the last election, with the seats contested in this election being last contested in 2016 election. The Conservatives defended 10 seats, whilst the Liberal Democrats defended 4. Town and parish councils in the city boundary were also up for election.

zh.s: 温彻斯特市议会选举于2019年5月2日（星期四）举行，与全国其他地方选举同期进行。上次选举后，保守党以1席的微弱优势控制议会。本次改选的席位上次均于2016年改选。保守党有10席需要守住，自由民主党有4席需要守住。市界内的镇议会和教区议会也同时举行选举。

en.s: Elections to Peterborough City Council took place on 2 May 2019. 20 of the 60 seats were contested. This was on the same day as other local elections across the United Kingdom.

zh.s: 彼得伯勒市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行。60个席位中有20席进行改选。选举与英国各地其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 South Norfolk District Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2019 to elect the whole council as part of 2019 United Kingdom local elections.

zh.s: 南诺福克区议会选举于2019年5月2日（星期四）举行，改选议会全部席位，是2019年英国地方选举的一部分。

en.s: The 2019 Luton Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of the Luton Borough Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行卢顿自治市议会选举，选出英格兰卢顿自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 Colchester Borough Council election was held on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Colchester Borough Council in Essex, England. Seventeen members of the council (one-third of the whole) were up for election, one from each of the 17 wards.

zh.t: 2019年科尔切斯特自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行科尔切斯特自治市议会选举，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡科尔切斯特自治市议会成员。议会全部席位的三分之一，即17个选区各1席，进行改选。

en.s: The 2019 Mansfield District Council election took place on 2 May 2019, to elect all 36 seats to the Mansfield District Council in Nottinghamshire, England. It was prior to the election run by the Mansfield Independent Forum.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行曼斯菲尔德区议会选举，改选英格兰诺丁汉郡曼斯菲尔德区议会全部36个席位。选举前，议会由曼斯菲尔德独立论坛管理。

en.s: The 2019 South Lakeland District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of South Lakeland District Council in Cumbria, England. One third of the council was up for election.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行南莱克兰区议会选举，选出英格兰坎布里亚郡南莱克兰区议会成员。议会三分之一席位进行改选。

en.s: The 2019 Warwick District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Warwick District Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The whole council was up for election on new boundaries. The Conservative Party lost control of the council.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行沃里克区议会选举，选出英格兰沃里克区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。由于采用了新的选区边界，议会全部席位均进行改选。保守党失去对议会的控制。

en.s: The 2019 Ashfield District Council election took place on 2 May 2019, to elect all members of Ashfield District Council in England. The election resulted in the Ashfield Independents gaining control of the council with a large majority, winning 30 of the 35 seats up for election. The Labour Party suffered heavy losses, winning just 2 seats, a decrease of 20 compared with the last election in 2015.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行阿什菲尔德区议会选举，改选英格兰阿什菲尔德区议会全部席位。阿什菲尔德独立党以较大多数赢得议会控制权，在本次改选的35席中拿下30席。工党遭遇惨败，只赢得2席，比2015年上次选举减少20席。

en.s: The 2019 Chorley Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Chorley Borough Council in Chorley, Lancashire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. All locally registered electors (British, Irish, Commonwealth and European Union citizens) who are aged 18 or over on polling day are entitled to vote in the local elections.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行乔利自治市议会选举，选出英格兰兰开夏郡乔利自治市议会成员。选举与英格兰其他地方选举在同一天举行。所有在当地登记、年满18岁并符合资格的选民都可以参加地方选举，包括英国、爱尔兰、英联邦和欧盟公民。

en.s: The 2019 Sefton Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Sefton Metropolitan Borough Council in England. It was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2019年塞夫顿都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行塞夫顿都会自治市议会选举，选出英格兰塞夫顿都会自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: Elections to City of York Council were held on 2 May 2019, as part of the United Kingdom local elections. The election resulted in substantial gains for the Liberal Democrats, who became the largest party, although no party surpassed the 24-seat majority threshold. The Conservatives suffered badly in this election, and lost 12 of the 14 seats they had won at the previous election.

zh.s: 约克市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，是英国地方选举的一部分。自由民主党大幅增加席位，成为议会第一大党，但没有任何政党达到过半所需的24席。保守党在此次选举中遭受重挫，失去上次选举所得14席中的12席。

en.s: The 2019 Arun District Council election took place on Thursday 2 May 2019, electing all 54 members of Arun District Council, and taking place alongside the other local elections in England and Northern Ireland.

zh.s: 阿伦区议会选举于2019年5月2日（星期四）举行，改选阿伦区议会全部54名成员，与英格兰和北爱尔兰其他地方选举同期进行。

en.s: The 2019 Bracknell Forest Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect all 42 councillors in 18 wards for Bracknell Forest Borough Council in England. The Conservative Party has controlled the council since its establishment as a unitary authority in 1998, and ended up securing a seventh term in office.

zh.t: 2019年布拉克内尔森林自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行布拉克内尔森林自治市议会选举，改选英格兰布拉克内尔森林自治市议会18个选区的全部42名议员。自1998年该议会作为单一管理区成立以来，保守党一直控制议会，并在本次选举中赢得第七个任期。

en.s: The 2019 Ribble Valley Borough Council election was held on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Ribble Valley Borough Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2019年里布尔谷自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行里布尔谷自治市议会选举，选出英格兰里布尔谷自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 Carlisle City Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Carlisle City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Following the election, a Conservative administration was formed.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行卡莱尔市议会选举，选出英格兰卡莱尔市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。选举后组建了保守党政府。

en.s: The 2019 Sunderland City Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Sunderland City Council in England. The election took place on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行桑德兰市议会选举，选出英格兰桑德兰市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2019 Lewes District Council election was held on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Lewes District Council in England. It took place on the same day as other district council elections in the United Kingdom. Before the 2019 election, the Council was composed of 20 Conservatives, nine Liberal Democrats, three Greens and nine Independents. To take control of the council, 21 councillors out of 41 would be needed.

zh.s: 刘易斯区议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出英格兰刘易斯区议会成员。选举与英国其他区议会选举在同一天举行。2019年选举前，议会由20名保守党议员、9名自由民主党议员、3名绿党议员和9名无党派议员组成。要控制议会，需在41名议员中取得至少21席。

en.s: The 2019 Malvern Hills District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Malvern Hills District Council in England.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行莫尔文丘陵区议会选举，选出英格兰莫尔文丘陵区议会成员。

en.s: The inaugural North of Tyne mayoral election was held on 2 May 2019 to elect the first Mayor of the North of Tyne. The area was made up of Newcastle upon Tyne, North Tyneside and Northumberland. Subsequent elections have been for the Mayor of the North East, a position covering an expanded area.

zh.t: 2019年泰恩河北部地区市长选举
zh.s: 泰恩河北部地区首届市长选举于2019年5月2日举行，选出该地区首任市长。该地区由泰恩河畔纽卡斯尔、北泰恩赛德和诺森伯兰组成。此后举行的选举选出东北地区市长，辖区范围有所扩大。

en.s: The 2019 Basildon Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Basildon Borough Council in Essex. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Conservative Party lost control of the council. which fell under no overall control.

zh.t: 2019年巴西尔登自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行巴西尔登自治市议会选举，选出埃塞克斯郡巴西尔登自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。保守党失去对议会的控制，议会此后没有任何政党单独控制。

en.s: The 2019 Harlow District Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect members of Harlow District Council in Essex. This was on the same day as other local elections. The council remained under Labour Party control, with no seats changing hands.

zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行哈洛区议会选举，选出埃塞克斯郡哈洛区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。所有席位均由原党派保住，工党继续控制议会。

en.s: The 2019 King Cup final was the 44th final of the King Cup, Saudi Arabia's main football knock-out competition. It took place on 2 May 2019 at the King Fahd International Stadium in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia and was contested between Al-Ittihad and Al-Taawoun. It was Al-Taawoun's second King Cup final and Al-Ittihad's 18th. This was the first-ever meeting between these two clubs in the final.

zh.s: 2019年沙特国王杯决赛是沙特阿拉伯主要足球淘汰赛——国王杯的第44届决赛。比赛于2019年5月2日在沙特阿拉伯利雅得的法赫德国王国际体育场举行，由吉达联合对阵布赖代合作。这是布赖代合作第二次参加国王杯决赛，吉达联合第18次参加。两队此前从未在决赛中交手。

en.s: Elections to Central Bedfordshire Council were held on 2 May 2019, along with other local elections. The whole council was up for election, with each successful candidate serving a four-year term of office, expiring in 2023.

zh.t: 2019年中央贝德福德郡议会选举
zh.s: 中央贝德福德郡议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，与其他地方选举同期进行。议会全部席位均进行改选，当选议员任期4年，于2023年届满。

en.t: 2019 Ards and North Down Borough Council election
en.s: The second election to Ards and North Down Borough Council, part of the Northern Ireland local elections on 2 May 2019, returned 40 members to the council via Single Transferable Vote. The Democratic Unionist Party once again won a plurality of seats.

zh.t: 2019年阿兹和北唐自治市议会选举
zh.s: 阿兹和北唐自治市议会第二次选举于2019年5月2日举行，是北爱尔兰地方选举的一部分。选举采用单记可转移投票制，选出40名议员。民主统一党再次赢得最多席位。

en.t: 2019 Armagh City, Banbridge and Craigavon Borough Council election
en.s: Elections to Armagh City, Banbridge and Craigavon Borough Council, part of the Northern Ireland local elections on 2 May 2019, returned 41 members to the council using Single Transferable Vote. The Democratic Unionist Party were the largest party in both first-preference votes and seats.

zh.t: 2019年阿马市、班布里奇和克雷加文自治市议会选举
zh.s: 阿马市、班布里奇和克雷加文自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，是北爱尔兰地方选举的一部分。选举采用单记可转移投票制，选出41名议员。民主统一党在首轮偏好票和席位数上都是最大政党。

en.s: Elections to Portsmouth City Council took place on Thursday 2 May 2019, alongside other local elections across the country. The seats contested in this election were last contested in 2015. The Conservative Party had 8 seats they were defending, the Liberal Democrats 5 and Labour 1 seat. A by-election occurred within the vacant Cosham seat from last years election, due to the sitting Conservative standing down.

zh.s: 朴茨茅斯市议会选举于2019年5月2日（星期四）举行，与全国其他地方选举同期进行。本次改选的席位上次均于2015年改选。保守党有8席需要守住，自由民主党有5席，工党有1席。上一年选出的保守党议员辞职后，科舍姆选区出现空缺，并在本次选举中补选。

en.t: 2019 Mid and East Antrim District Council election
en.s: Elections to Mid and East Antrim District Council, part of the Northern Ireland local elections on 2 May 2019, returned 40 members to the council using Single Transferable Vote. The Democratic Unionist Party were the largest party in both first-preference votes and seats.

zh.t: 2019年中安特里姆和东安特里姆区议会选举
zh.s: 中安特里姆和东安特里姆区议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，是北爱尔兰地方选举的一部分。选举采用单记可转移投票制，选出40名议员。民主统一党在首轮偏好票和席位数上都是最大政党。

en.s: The 2019 Eastleigh Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2019 to elect one third of members of Eastleigh Borough Council. The outcome was a strengthened majority for the incumbent Liberal Democrats who gained two Conservative seats. No election was held in Botley, a two-member ward, this year.

zh.t: 2019年伊斯特利自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行伊斯特利自治市议会选举，改选议会三分之一成员。现任自由民主党以多数席位继续控制议会，并从保守党手中赢得2席。今年博特利双议员选区没有举行选举。

en.t: 2019 Causeway Coast and Glens Borough Council election
en.s: The second election to Causeway Coast and Glens Borough Council, part of the Northern Ireland local elections on 2 May 2019, returned 40 members to the council via Single Transferable Vote. The Democratic Unionist Party won a plurality of first-preference votes and seats.

zh.t: 2019年考斯韦海岸和格伦斯自治市议会选举
zh.s: 考斯韦海岸和格伦斯自治市议会第二次选举于2019年5月2日举行，是北爱尔兰地方选举的一部分。选举采用单记可转移投票制，选出40名议员。民主统一党在首轮偏好票和席位数上均领先其他政党。

en.t: 2019 Fermanagh and Omagh District Council election
en.s: Elections took place for Fermanagh and Omagh District Council on 2 May 2019, part of that year's local elections. 40 Councillors were elected via STV. Sinn Féin emerged as the largest party with Fifteen seats, six ahead of the Ulster Unionist Party and six seats away from overall control. The Alliance Party and Cross-Community Labour Alternative both gained representation onto the council for the first time.

zh.t: 2019年弗马纳和奥马区议会选举
zh.s: 弗马纳和奥马区议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，是当年地方选举的一部分。选举采用单记可转移投票制，选出40名议员。新芬党以15席成为第一大党，比阿尔斯特统一党多6席，但距离单独控制议会还差6席。联盟党和跨社群工党另类党首次在议会中获得席位。

en.t: 2019 Newry, Mourne and Down District Council election
en.s: The 2019 election to the Newry, Mourne and Down District Council, part of the Northern Ireland local elections that were held on 2 May 2019 returned 41 members to the council via Single Transferable Vote.

zh.t: 2019年纽里、莫恩和唐区议会选举
zh.s: 纽里、莫恩和唐区议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，是北爱尔兰地方选举的一部分。选举采用单记可转移投票制，选出41名议员。

en.s: Elections to Sheffield City Council were held on Thursday 2 May 2019; one of a number of local council elections taking place across England and Northern Ireland on the same day. One of each ward's three seats was up for election, having last been contested in the 2016 elections.

zh.s: 谢菲尔德市议会选举于2019年5月2日（星期四）举行，是英格兰和北爱尔兰同日举行的多场地方议会选举之一。每个三人选区有1席进行改选，这些席位上次于2016年改选。

en.t: 2019 Lisburn and Castlereagh City Council election
en.s: The 2019 Lisburn and Castlereagh City Council election was the second election to Lisburn and Castlereagh city Council, part of the Northern Ireland local elections on 2 May 2019, which returned 40 members to the Lisburn and Castlereagh city Council via Single Transferable Vote.

zh.t: 2019年利斯本和卡斯尔雷市议会选举
zh.s: 利斯本和卡斯尔雷市议会第二次选举于2019年5月2日举行，是北爱尔兰地方选举的一部分。选举采用单记可转移投票制，选出40名市议会议员。

en.s: Elections to Norwich City Council were held on 2 May 2019. Following boundary changes, all 39 seats were put up for election, with three councillors being elected per ward using the block vote system. The election saw the Green Party reclaim five seats from the Labour Party, while losing one to Labour in Town Close. The Labour Party retained its majority on the council.

zh.s: 诺里奇市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行。选区边界调整后，全部39个席位均进行改选，每个选区采用全额区块投票制选出3名议员。绿党从工党手中重新赢得5席，但在汤克洛斯选区向工党丢掉1席。工党保住了议会多数席位。

en.s: The 2019 North Hertfordshire Council election was held on 2 May 2019, at the same time as other local elections across England and Northern Ireland. Of the 49 seats on North Hertfordshire District Council, 16 were up for election. The Conservatives had a majority on the council prior to the election, but lost a net total of six seats, leaving the council under no overall control.

zh.t: 2019年北赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 北赫特福德郡议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，与英格兰和北爱尔兰其他地方选举同期进行。北赫特福德郡区议会49席中有16席改选。保守党在选举前占多数，但净失6席，议会因此没有任何政党单独控制。

en.t: 2019 Derry City and Strabane District Council election
en.s: The 2019 election to the Derry City and Strabane District Council, part of the Northern Ireland local elections on 2 May 2019, returned 40 members to the council via Single Transferable Vote.

zh.t: 2019年德里和斯特拉班区议会选举
zh.s: 德里和斯特拉班区议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，是北爱尔兰地方选举的一部分。选举采用单记可转移投票制，选出40名议员。

en.s: On 2 May 2019, an election took place to elect members of the North Warwickshire Borough Council in the English Midlands. It was held on the same day as other local elections in the UK. It resulted in the Conservative Party retaining control of the council. Both the Conservative and Labour parties saw increases in their vote share, especially the former, which was likely due to UKIP losing nearly 20% of their vote share.

zh.t: 2019年北沃里克郡自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年5月2日举行选举，选出英格兰中部地区北沃里克郡自治市议会议员。选举与英国其他地方选举在同一天举行。保守党保住了议会控制权。保守党和工党的得票率都上升，尤其是保守党；这可能是因为英国独立党得票率下降近20%。

en.t: 2019 Antrim and Newtownabbey Borough Council election
en.s: Elections to Antrim and Newtownabbey Borough Council, part of the Northern Ireland local elections on 2 May 2019, returned 40 members to the council using Single Transferable Vote. The Democratic Unionist Party were the largest party in both first-preference votes and seats.

zh.t: 2019年安特里姆和纽敦阿比自治市议会选举
zh.s: 安特里姆和纽敦阿比自治市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，是北爱尔兰地方选举的一部分。选举采用单记可转移投票制，选出40名议员。民主统一党在首轮偏好票和席位数上都是最大政党。

en.s: The 2019 election to Belfast City Council, part of the Northern Ireland local elections on 2 May 2019, returned 60 members to the council via Single Transferable Vote.

zh.s: 贝尔法斯特市议会选举于2019年5月2日举行，是北爱尔兰地方选举的一部分。选举采用单记可转移投票制，选出60名议员。

en.s: The 2019 Lichfield District Council election took place on 2 May to elect members of Lichfield District Council in Staffordshire, England. The whole council - 47 members - was up for election and the Conservative Party retained overall control of the council.

zh.s: 2019年利奇菲尔德区议会选举于5月2日举行，选出英格兰斯塔福德郡利奇菲尔德区议会议员。议会全部47个席位改选，保守党继续全面控制议会。

en.s: The 2019 Ipswich Borough Council elections for the Ipswich Borough Council took place on 2 May: 16 seats were contested - one in each of the 16 wards and also on 26 September when a by-election took place where 1 seat was contested (Alexandra Ward).

zh.t: 2019年伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2019年伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举于5月2日举行，共有16个席位改选，16个选区各改选一席。9月26日，亚历山德拉选区另举行一场补选，改选一个席位。
