en.s: The 2018 Supercopa Argentina Final was the 7th edition of the Supercopa Argentina, an annual football match contested by the winners of the Argentine Primera División and Copa Argentina competitions.

zh.s: 2018年阿根廷超级杯决赛是阿根廷超级杯的第七届比赛。该赛事每年举行一场，由阿根廷甲级联赛和阿根廷杯的冠军对阵。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: A by-thirds Hyndburn Borough Council local election, was held on Thursday 2 May 2019. Approximately one third of the local council's 35 seats fell up for election on that day.

zh.s: 海恩德本区议会按三年一届、每年改选约三分之一席位的方式举行地方选举。2019年选举于5月2日（星期四）举行，35个席位中约三分之一在当天改选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2020 Kansas Democratic presidential primary took place until May 2, 2020, in the Democratic Party primaries for the 2020 presidential election, as in-person voting had been cancelled because of the COVID-19 pandemic. The Kansas primary was a closed party-run primary, undertaken completely by mail-in voting, it was the sole contest held on that date.

zh.t: 2020年堪萨斯州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 2020年堪萨斯州民主党总统初选于2020年5月2日结束，是2020年美国总统选举民主党初选的一部分。由于新冠疫情，现场投票取消。这是一场由政党管理的封闭式初选，全程采用邮寄投票，也是当天唯一举行的初选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Democratic Party held its leadership by-election on 2 May 2021 following the resignation of the incumbent Lee Nak-yon in March 2021. Lee stepped down from party leader due to party rule which bans any party contender for president from holding party position at least for a year before the presidential election.

zh.s: 共同民主党于2021年5月2日举行领导人补选。此前，现任党首李洛渊于2021年3月辞职。根据党规，准备竞选总统的党内人士至少要在总统选举前一年辞去党内职务，因此李洛渊卸任党首。

en.s: The 2021 Supercopa Uruguaya was the fourth edition of the Supercopa Uruguaya, Uruguay's football super cup. It was held on 2 May 2021 between the 2020 Primera División champions Nacional and the 2020 Torneo Intermedio runners-up Montevideo Wanderers, who qualified for the Supercopa since Nacional also won the Torneo Intermedio in the 2020 season. Nacional won the match by a 2–0 score to claim their second Supercopa Uruguaya title in four appearances.

zh.s: 2021年乌拉圭超级杯是该项赛事的第四届比赛，于2021年5月2日举行。对阵双方是2020年乌拉圭甲级联赛冠军民族队和2020年中间锦标赛亚军蒙得维的亚流浪者队。民族队也赢得了2020年中间锦标赛，因此获得参赛资格。民族队以2比0获胜，四次参赛中第二次夺冠。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The election to the Shimla Municipal Corporation was held on 2 May 2023.Votes were counted and results declared on 4 May 2023.

zh.s: 西姆拉市政公司选举于2023年5月2日举行。选票于2023年5月4日统计，结果也在当天公布。

en.s: The 2023 Lincoln, Nebraska mayoral election was held on May 2, 2023, to determine the mayor of Lincoln, Nebraska. It was preceded by a primary election on April 4 where the top two vote-getters, regardless of party affiliation, advanced to the general election. Incumbent Democratic mayor Leirion Gaylor Baird ran for reelection to a second term in office, and was re-elected. The election was officially nonpartisan.

zh.t: 2023年内布拉斯加州林肯市市长选举
zh.s: 2023年5月2日举行内布拉斯加州林肯市市长选举。此前，4月4日举行初选，无论党派归属，得票最高的两名候选人进入大选。现任民主党市长莉里昂·盖洛·贝尔德竞选连任第二届任期，并成功当选。此次选举在法律上不分党派。

en.s: The 2024 Tameside Metropolitan Borough Council elections were held on 2 May 2024 alongside other local elections in the United Kingdom. One third of the 57 seats on the Tameside Metropolitan Borough Council was contested, with each successful candidate serving a four-year term of office, expiring in 2028. Labour retained their majority on the council.

zh.t: 2024年塔姆赛德都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 塔姆赛德都会自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日举行，与英国其他地方选举同期进行。57个席位中有三分之一进行改选，当选者任期4年，于2028年届满。工党保住了议会多数席位。

en.t: 2024 St Albans City and District Council election
en.s: The 2024 St Albans City and District Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of St Albans City and District Council in Hertfordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. There were 21 members of the council up for election, being the usual approximate third of the council plus three by-elections.

zh.t: 2024年圣奥尔本斯市和区议会选举
zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行圣奥尔本斯市和区议会选举，选出英格兰赫特福德郡圣奥尔本斯市和区议会成员。选举与英格兰其他地方选举在同一天举行。共有21个席位改选，通常应为议会约三分之一席位，另包括3场补选。

en.s: The 2024 Warrington Borough Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024 to elect members of Warrington Borough Council in England. It took place on the same day as other local elections in the United Kingdom.

zh.s: 沃灵顿自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，选出英格兰沃灵顿自治市议会成员。选举与英国其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.t: 2024 Reigate and Banstead Borough Council election
en.s: The 2024 Reigate and Banstead Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Reigate and Banstead Borough Council in Surrey, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The council remained under no overall control following the election.

zh.t: 2024年赖盖特和班斯特德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行赖盖特和班斯特德自治市议会选举，选出英格兰萨里郡赖盖特和班斯特德自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。选举后，议会仍没有任何政党单独控制。

en.s: The 2024 Wakefield Metropolitan District Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Wakefield Council, alongside the other local elections across the United Kingdom being held on the same day. There were 22 of the 63 seats on Wakefield council up for election, being the usual third of the council plus a by-election in Normanton ward.

zh.t: 2024年韦克菲尔德都会区议会选举
zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行韦克菲尔德都会区议会选举，选出韦克菲尔德议会议员，与英国各地同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。韦克菲尔德议会63席中有22席改选，包括通常的三分之一席位，以及诺曼顿选区的一场补选。

en.s: The 2024 Worthing Borough Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections being held in the United Kingdom on the same day. Labour retained their majority on the council. Three days after the election, three Labour councillors resigned from the party, although the party retained its majority.

zh.s: 沃辛自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。工党保住了议会多数席位。选举三天后，3名工党议员退党，但工党仍保有多数席位。

en.s: The 2024 Colchester City Council election took place on 2 May 2024 alongside other local elections across England. Eighteen members of the council were elected, one from each of the wards, with an additional by-election in Greenstead ward. The council was under no overall control prior to the election. The Conservatives were the largest party, but the council was being run by a Liberal Democrat minority administration with informal support from Labour and the Green Party.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行科尔切斯特市议会选举，与英格兰其他地方选举同期进行。共有18名议员当选，每个选区各选出1人；格林斯特德选区另有一场补选。选举前，议会没有任何政党单独控制。保守党是最大党，但议会由自由民主党少数派政府管理，并得到工党和绿党的非正式支持。

en.s: The 2024 Hartlepool Borough Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom being held on the same day. One-third of the 36 members of Hartlepool Borough Council in County Durham were elected. Prior to the election the council was under no overall control, being run by a Conservative and independent coalition.

zh.t: 2024年哈特尔浦自治市议会选举
zh.s: 哈特尔浦自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。达勒姆郡哈特尔浦自治市议会36名议员中的三分之一参加选举。选举前，议会没有任何政党单独控制，由保守党和无党派议员组成的联盟管理。

en.s: The 2024 Exeter City Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Exeter City Council in Devon, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. There were 13 of 39 seats on the council up for election, being the usual third of the council. Labour retained its majority on the council.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行埃克塞特市议会选举，选出英格兰德文郡埃克塞特市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。39个席位中有13席改选，通常为议会三分之一席位。工党保住了议会多数席位。

en.s: The 2024 Norwich City Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Norwich City Council in Norfolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行诺里奇市议会选举，选出英格兰诺福克郡诺里奇市议会成员。选举与英格兰其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2024 Plymouth City Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Plymouth City Council in Devon, England. It was held alongside other local elections across the United Kingdom. Labour gained seats at the expense of the Conservatives, increasing Labour's overall majority on the council.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行普利茅斯市议会选举，选出英格兰德文郡普利茅斯市议会成员。选举与英国其他地方选举同期举行。工党增加席位，保守党则失去席位，工党在议会中的多数优势因此扩大。

en.s: The 2024 Three Rivers District Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Three Rivers District Council in Hertfordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行三河区议会选举，选出英格兰赫特福德郡三河区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2024 Tunbridge Wells Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Tunbridge Wells Borough Council in Kent, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The council reported borough-wide turnout of 37% and published detailed results for each ward. Following a review of ward boundaries, the election was contested with new electoral divisions and with a reduced number of seats, 39 down from 48.

zh.t: 2024年汤布里奇韦尔斯自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行汤布里奇韦尔斯自治市议会选举，选出英格兰肯特郡汤布里奇韦尔斯自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。议会公布全自治市投票率为37%，并发布了各选区的详细结果。选区边界审查后，本次选举采用了新的选区划分，席位数也从48席减至39席。

en.s: The 2024 Cheltenham Borough Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom being held on the same day. All 40 members of Cheltenham Borough Council in Gloucestershire were elected following boundary changes. The Liberal Democrats retained control of the local authority. The Conservatives were wiped out losing all their seats on the council, with the Greens replacing them as the largest opposition party.

zh.t: 2024年切尔滕纳姆自治市议会选举
zh.s: 切尔滕纳姆自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。边界调整后，格洛斯特郡切尔滕纳姆自治市议会的40个席位全部改选。自由民主党保住了地方政府的控制权。保守党失去全部席位，绿党取而代之，成为最大的反对党。

en.s: The 2024 City of Lincoln Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024 to elect 11 of the 33 members of City of Lincoln Council, being the usual third of the council. It took place on the same day as other local elections in the United Kingdom.

zh.s: 林肯市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，改选林肯市议会33名成员中的11人，通常为议会三分之一席位。选举与英国其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2024 Maidstone Borough Council election took place on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom being held on the same day. All 49 members of Maidstone Borough Council in Kent were elected following boundary changes. The council remained under no overall control.

zh.t: 2024年梅德斯通自治市议会选举
zh.s: 梅德斯通自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。选区边界调整后，肯特郡梅德斯通自治市议会全部49名议员均进行改选。选举后，议会仍没有任何政党单独控制。

en.s: The 2024 North Hertfordshire District Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024 to elect members of North Hertfordshire District Council in Hertfordshire. It was held alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom. New ward boundaries come into effect for this election, increasing the number of councillors from 49 to 51.

zh.t: 2024年北赫特福德郡区议会选举
zh.s: 北赫特福德郡区议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，选出赫特福德郡北赫特福德郡区议会成员。选举与英国其他地方选举同期举行。本次选举采用新的选区边界，议员人数从49人增至51人。

en.s: The 2024 Winchester City Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Winchester City Council in Hampshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England, and Hampshire's and the Isle of Wight's Constabulary Police and Crime Commissioner election. There were 14 of the 45 seats on the council up for election, being the usual approximate third of the council.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行温彻斯特市议会选举，选出英格兰汉普郡温彻斯特市议会成员。选举与英格兰其他地方选举以及汉普郡和怀特岛警察与犯罪专员选举在同一天举行。45个席位中有14席改选，约为议会通常改选的三分之一。

en.s: The 2024 Gloucester City Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect all 39 members of Gloucester City Council in England. This was on the same day as other local elections, including Quedgeley Town Council, and the Police and Crime Commissioner for Gloucestershire.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行格洛斯特市议会选举，改选英格兰格洛斯特市议会全部39名成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行，包括夸奇利镇议会选举和格洛斯特郡警察与犯罪专员选举。

en.s: The 2024 Broxbourne Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Broxbourne Borough Council in Hertfordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England and Hertfordshire's Police and Crime Commissioner election. The council remained under Conservative majority control.

zh.t: 2024年布罗克斯伯恩自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行布罗克斯伯恩自治市议会选举，选出英格兰赫特福德郡布罗克斯伯恩自治市议会成员。选举与英格兰其他地方选举及赫特福德郡警察与犯罪专员选举在同一天举行。保守党继续以多数席位控制议会。

en.s: The 2024 City of Wolverhampton Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom being held on the same day. One-third of the 60 members of City of Wolverhampton Council in the West Midlands were elected.

zh.t: 2024年伍尔弗汉普顿市议会选举
zh.s: 伍尔弗汉普顿市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。西米德兰兹郡伍尔弗汉普顿市议会60名成员中的三分之一参加选举。

en.s: The 2024 Runnymede Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect one-third of members of the Runnymede Borough Council in Surrey, England. This was on the same day as other local elections in England and police and crime commissioner elections. The election saw the Conservatives lose all but three of the ten seats they were defending. Notable losses include Chertsey St.

zh.t: 2024年朗尼米德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2024年朗尼米德自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日举行，改选萨里郡朗尼米德自治市议会三分之一席位。选举与英格兰其他地方选举及警察与犯罪专员选举同日举行。保守党在其守住的10个席位中只保住3席。值得关注的失利包括切特西圣安妮选区：现任议会副领袖败给工党；新霍选区则由自由民主党击败保守党，取得全自治市议会最大多数优势。

en.t: 2024 Nuneaton and Bedworth Borough Council election
en.s: The 2024 Nuneaton and Bedworth Borough Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom being held on the same day. All 38 members of Nuneaton and Bedworth Borough Council in Warwickshire were elected following boundary changes. Labour gained overall control of the council from the Conservatives, winning just enough seats to have a majority.

zh.t: 2024年纽尼顿和贝德沃思自治市议会选举
zh.s: 纽尼顿和贝德沃思自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。边界调整后，沃里克郡纽尼顿和贝德沃思自治市议会全部38名成员均进行改选。工党从保守党手中赢得议会总体控制权，获得刚好足以过半的席位。

en.s: The 2024 Hart District Council election was held on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Hart District Council. There were 12 of the 33 seats on the council up for election, being the usual third of the council plus a by-election in Fleet East ward. The election took place at the same time as other local elections across England.

zh.s: 哈特区议会选举于2024年5月2日举行，选出哈特区议会成员。33个席位中有12席改选，包括通常的三分之一席位，以及弗利特东选区的一场补选。选举与英格兰其他地方选举同期举行。

en.s: The 2024 Tandridge District Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom held on the same day. All 43 members of Tandridge District Council in Surrey were elected following boundary changes. The local residents' association (composed of independent councillors and Oxted and Limpsfield Residents Group councillors) managed to increase their seat count, but fell two seats short of gaining majority control of the council.

zh.s: 坦德里奇区议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。萨里郡坦德里奇区议会因边界调整，全部43名成员均进行改选。由无党派议员以及奥克斯特德和林普斯菲尔德居民团体议员组成的地方居民协会增加了席位，但距离取得议会多数仍差2席。

en.s: The 2024 Havant Borough Council election took place on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom being held on the same day. All 36 members of Havant Borough Council in Hampshire were elected following boundary changes. Prior to the election the Conservatives held a majority of the seats on the council.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行哈文特自治市议会选举，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。边界调整后，汉普郡哈文特自治市议会全部36名成员均进行改选。选举前，保守党在议会中占多数席位。

en.s: The 2024 Ipswich Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Ipswich Borough Council in Suffolk, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. There were 18 seats were up for election, 16 being the usual third of the council (last elected in 2021) and two being by-elections. Labour made five gains, increasing their majority on the council.

zh.t: 2024年伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行伊普斯威奇自治市议会选举，选出英格兰萨福克郡伊普斯威奇自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。共有18席改选，其中16席是通常每次改选的议会三分之一席位（上次于2021年改选），另有2场补选。工党增加5席，扩大了在议会中的多数优势。

en.s: The 2024 Peterborough City Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Peterborough City Council in Cambridgeshire, England. 23 of the 60 seats on the council were contested, including an early election in Werrington. The election took place alongside other local elections across England.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行彼得伯勒市议会选举，选出英格兰剑桥郡彼得伯勒市议会成员。议会60席中有23席进行改选，其中包括韦灵顿选区的一场提前选举。选举与英格兰其他地方选举同期举行。

en.s: The 2024 Rushmoor Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect councillors to Rushmoor Borough Council in Hampshire, England. This was on the same date as other local elections across England. A third of the council was up for election. This set of seats was last contested in 2021. The council was under Conservative majority control prior to the election.

zh.t: 2024年拉什穆尔自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行拉什穆尔自治市议会选举，选出英格兰汉普郡拉什穆尔自治市议会议员。选举与英格兰其他地方选举在同一天举行。议会三分之一席位进行改选，这些席位上次于2021年改选。选举前，保守党在议会中占多数。

en.s: The 2024 Tamworth Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect 10 of the 30 councillors on Tamworth Borough Council in Staffordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. In the previous election, the Conservatives lost control of the council losing 6 seats, whilst Labour gained 7 seats.

zh.t: 2024年塔姆沃思自治市议会选举
zh.s: 塔姆沃思自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日举行，改选英格兰斯塔福德郡塔姆沃思自治市议会30名成员中的10人。选举与英格兰其他地方选举在同一天举行。上次选举中，保守党失去议会控制权并丢掉6席，工党则增加7席。

en.s: The 2024 West Lancashire Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of West Lancashire Borough Council. 16 of the 45 seats of the council were up for election. The election took place at the same time as other local elections across England. The council remained under Labour majority control.

zh.t: 2024年西兰开夏自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行西兰开夏自治市议会选举，选出西兰开夏自治市议会成员。45个席位中有16席改选。选举与英格兰其他地方选举在同一天举行。工党继续以多数席位控制议会。

en.s: The 2024 Portsmouth City Council election took place on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom on the same day. 14 of the 42 members of Portsmouth City Council in Hampshire were elected. The council remained under no overall control, being led by a Liberal Democrat minority administration.

zh.s: 朴茨茅斯市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。汉普郡朴茨茅斯市议会42名成员中有14人参加选举。选举后，议会仍没有任何政党单独控制，由自由民主党少数派政府领导。

en.s: The 2024 Stevenage Borough Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom being held on the same day. All 39 members of Stevenage Borough Council in Hertfordshire were elected following boundary changes. The election saw the Conservatives nearly wiped out of the council entirely, with them only holding onto one seat in Woodfield.

zh.t: 2024年史蒂文尼奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 史蒂文尼奇自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。边界调整后，赫特福德郡史蒂文尼奇自治市议会全部39名成员均进行改选。保守党几乎失去全部席位，仅在伍德菲尔德保住1席。

en.s: The 2024 Sefton Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Sefton Metropolitan Borough Council in Merseyside, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England, Liverpool's City Region mayoral election and Merseyside's Police and Crime Commissioner election. As is typical for Sefton's local elections, twenty-two seats of the sixty-six total were contested.

zh.t: 2024年塞夫顿都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行塞夫顿都会自治市议会选举，选出英格兰默西赛德郡塞夫顿都会自治市议会成员。选举与英格兰其他地方选举、利物浦城市区域市长选举以及默西赛德郡警察与犯罪专员选举在同一天举行。按照塞夫顿地方选举的惯例，66个席位中有22席改选。

en.s: The 2024 Castle Point Borough Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom being held on the same day. All 39 members of Castle Point Borough Council in Essex were elected following boundary changes.

zh.t: 2024年卡斯尔波因特自治市议会选举
zh.s: 卡斯尔波因特自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。埃塞克斯郡卡斯尔波因特自治市议会因边界调整，全部39名成员均进行改选。

en.s: The 2024 Halton Borough Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom held on the same day. One-third of the 54 members of Halton Borough Council in Cheshire were elected. Labour retained its majority on the Council.

zh.s: 哈尔顿自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。柴郡哈尔顿自治市议会54名成员中的三分之一参加选举。工党保住了议会多数席位。

en.s: The 2024 Wigan Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect one third of the members of Wigan Metropolitan Borough Council in England. The election was held on the same day as other local elections.

zh.t: 2024年威根都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行威根都会自治市议会选举，改选英格兰威根都会自治市议会三分之一成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.t: 2024 England and Wales police and crime commissioner elections
en.s: Elections for police and crime commissioners in England and Wales took place on 2 May 2024, the same day as local elections in England. These elections will likely be the last elections held for the office, with the Home Office announcing in November 2025 that it intends to move the responsibilities Police and Crime Commissioners have to either an elected mayor or council leaders at the end of the current terms in 2028.

zh.t: 2024年英格兰和威尔士警察与犯罪专员选举
zh.s: 英格兰和威尔士警察与犯罪专员选举于2024年5月2日举行，与英格兰地方选举同日进行。这很可能是该职位的最后一轮选举。内政部于2025年11月宣布，计划在现任专员任期于2028年结束时，将他们的职责移交给民选市长或议会领导人。

en.s: The 2024 Basildon Borough Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom being held on the same day. All 42 members to the council were up for election.

zh.t: 2024年巴西尔登自治市议会选举
zh.s: 巴西尔登自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。议会全部42个席位均进行改选。

en.s: Local elections in the United Kingdom took place on 2 May 2024 to choose 2,658 councillors on 107 councils in England, 11 directly elected mayors in England, the 25 members of the London Assembly, and 37 police and crime commissioners in England and Wales. The 2024 Blackpool South parliamentary by-election was held on the same day.

zh.s: 英国地方选举于2024年5月2日举行。英格兰107个议会将选出2658名议员，11名民选市长将进行选举；伦敦议会25名成员以及英格兰和威尔士的37名警察与犯罪专员也将产生。同日还举行了2024年布莱克浦南部选区议会补选。

en.s: The 2024 Reading Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Reading Borough Council in Berkshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行雷丁自治市议会选举，选出英格兰伯克郡雷丁自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2024 Preston City Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Preston City Council in Lancashire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England, and Lancashire's Police and Crime Commissioner election. As is typical for Preston's council elections, sixteen seats of the forty-eight total were contested.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行普雷斯顿市议会选举，选出英格兰兰开夏郡普雷斯顿市议会成员。选举与英格兰其他地方选举以及兰开夏郡警察与犯罪专员选举同日举行。按照普雷斯顿市议会选举的惯例，48个席位中有16席改选。

en.s: The 2024 Greater Manchester mayoral election was held on 2 May 2024 to elect the mayor of Greater Manchester. The election took place alongside local elections across England and Wales, including council elections within the city region and for the mayor of Salford. Andy Burnham of the Labour and Co-operative Party was re-elected with 420,749 votes (63.40%) with a turnout of 32.05%.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行大曼彻斯特市长选举，选出大曼彻斯特市长。选举与英格兰和威尔士各地的地方选举同期举行，包括城市区域内的议会选举和索尔福德市长选举。工党与合作党候选人安迪·伯纳姆以420749票（63.40%）再次当选，投票率为32.05%。

en.s: The 2024 Sunderland City Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Sunderland City Council. 25 of the 75 seats of the council were up for election. The election took place at the same time as other local elections across England. The Labour Party remained in control of the council and the Liberal Democrats returned as the largest opposition party.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行桑德兰市议会选举，改选议会75个席位中的25席。选举与英格兰其他地方选举在同一天举行。工党继续控制议会，自由民主党重新成为最大的反对党。

en.s: The 2024 Chorley Borough Council election was held on 2 May 2024 to elect councillors to Chorley Council in Lancashire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. A third of the council was up for election. Ahead of the election the council was under Labour control. Labour won 13 of the 14 seats available, increasing their majority on the council and in the process unseated the council's Conservatives leader.

zh.s: 乔利自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日举行，选出英格兰兰开夏郡乔利议会议员。选举与英格兰其他地方选举在同一天举行。议会三分之一席位进行改选。选举前，议会由工党控制。工党赢得14个席位中的13席，扩大了多数优势，并使议会的保守党领袖落选。

en.s: The 2024 Cambridge City Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Cambridge City Council in Cambridgeshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行剑桥市议会选举，选出英格兰剑桥郡剑桥市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: A by-election for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of Blackpool South was held on 2 May 2024, the same day as local elections in England and Wales. It was triggered by the resignation of incumbent Conservative MP Scott Benton following his suspension from the House of Commons. The by-election was won by Chris Webb of the Labour Party with a 26% swing.

zh.t: 2024年布莱克浦南部选区议会补选
zh.s: 英国议会布莱克浦南部选区于2024年5月2日举行补选，与英格兰和威尔士地方选举在同一天进行。此次补选因保守党现任议员斯科特·本顿被下议院停职后辞职而触发。工党候选人克里斯·韦布赢得补选，选票摆幅为26%。

en.s: The 2024 Wokingham Borough Council election took place on Thursday 2 May 2024, to elect members of Wokingham Borough Council in Berkshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England. Due to boundary changes all seats were up for election. The main impact of the boundary changes is that all wards in the Borough are now three member wards; the number of seats remained the same at 54.

zh.t: 2024年沃金厄姆自治市议会选举
zh.s: 沃金厄姆自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，选出英格兰伯克郡沃金厄姆自治市议会成员。选举与英格兰其他地方选举在同一天举行。由于选区边界调整，所有席位均进行改选。调整后，自治市内所有选区均改为三人选区；议席总数仍为54席。

en.s: The 2024 Gosport Borough Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom on the same day. There were 15 seats up for election, being the usual half of the 28 members of Gosport Borough Council in Hampshire, plus a vacancy in Lee West ward. The council remained under Liberal Democrat majority control.

zh.t: 2024年戈斯波特自治市议会选举
zh.s: 戈斯波特自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。汉普郡戈斯波特自治市议会28名成员中，通常应有一半席位改选；加上李西选区的一个空缺，共有15席进行选举。自由民主党继续以多数席位控制议会。

en.t: 2024 North Tyneside Metropolitan Borough Council election
en.s: The 2024 North Tyneside Metropolitan Borough Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections held in the United Kingdom on the same day. All seats were up for election following boundary changes. Labour retained its majority on the council.

zh.t: 2024年北泰恩赛德都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 北泰恩赛德都会自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。边界调整后，议会全部席位均进行改选。工党保住了议会多数席位。

en.s: The 2024 Eastleigh Borough Council election was held on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Eastleigh Borough Council, taking place at the same time as other local elections across England. 12 of the 39 seats of the council were up for election. The council remained under Liberal Democrat majority control. Despite the Green Party newly fielding candidates in nearly every ward, ultimately this had little impact on the council's results.

zh.t: 2024年伊斯特利自治市议会选举
zh.s: 伊斯特利自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日举行，选出伊斯特利自治市议会成员，与英格兰其他地方选举同期进行。39个席位中有12席改选。自由民主党继续以多数席位控制议会。尽管绿党首次在几乎所有选区提名候选人，但最终对议会选举结果影响不大。

en.s: The 2024 Burnley Borough Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom on the same day. One-third of the 45 members of Burnley Borough Council in Lancashire were elected.

zh.s: 伯恩利自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。兰开夏郡伯恩利自治市议会45名成员中的三分之一参加选举。

en.s: The 2024 Oldham Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside other local elections in the United Kingdom. One third of the 60 members of Oldham Council in Greater Manchester were elected. The election resulted in Labour losing overall control of the council, with a net loss of 4 seats.

zh.t: 2024年奥尔德姆都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 奥尔德姆都会自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国其他地方选举同期进行。大曼彻斯特奥尔德姆议会60名成员中的三分之一参加选举。工党净失4席，失去议会的总体控制权。

en.s: The 2024 Calderdale Metropolitan Borough Council election was held on 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections across the United Kingdom being held on the same day. The council remained under Labour majority control.

zh.t: 2024年考尔德代尔都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 考尔德代尔都会自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。议会仍由工党以多数席位控制。

en.s: The 2024 Rochford District Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Rochford District Council in Essex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行罗奇福德区议会选举，选出英格兰埃塞克斯郡罗奇福德区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2024 Epping Forest District Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom held on the same day. All 54 members of Epping Forest District Council in Essex were elected following boundary changes. The council remained under Conservative majority control.

zh.s: 埃平森林区议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。埃塞克斯郡埃平森林区议会因边界调整，全部54名成员均进行改选。保守党继续以多数席位控制议会。

en.s: The 2024 Oxford City Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections being held in the United Kingdom on the same day. The councillors elected will serve a four-year term ending in 2028.

zh.s: 牛津市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。当选议员任期4年，于2028年届满。

en.t: 2024 South Tyneside Metropolitan Borough Council election
en.s: The 2024 South Tyneside Metropolitan Borough Council election was held on 2 May 2024 to elect members of South Tyneside Metropolitan Borough Council. 18 of the 54 seats of the council were up for election. The election took place at the same time as other local elections across England. Bucking the trend of the rest of the country, the election saw Labour's seat count drop dramatically, losing ten seats nearly entirely to independent candidates.

zh.t: 2024年南泰恩赛德都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 南泰恩赛德都会自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日举行，选出南泰恩赛德都会自治市议会成员。54个席位中有18席改选。选举与英格兰其他地方选举同期举行。与全国其他地区的趋势相反，工党席位大幅减少，失去10席，几乎全部被无党派候选人赢得。

en.s: The 2024 North East Lincolnshire Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom on the same day. 12 of the 42 members of North East Lincolnshire Council in Lincolnshire were elected. The Conservative Party lost control of the council to no overall control. They remained the largest party, and continued to run the council as a minority administration.

zh.s: 东北林肯郡议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。林肯郡东北林肯郡议会42名成员中有12人当选。保守党失去对议会的单独控制，议会此后没有任何政党占多数。保守党仍是最大党，并继续以少数派政府形式管理议会。

en.s: The 2024 Harlow District Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom being held on the same day. All 33 members of Harlow District Council in Essex were elected following boundary changes. The Conservatives retained their majority on the council, but lost four seats to Labour, reducing the Conservative majority to just one seat.

zh.s: 哈洛区议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。埃塞克斯郡哈洛区议会因边界调整，全部33名成员均进行改选。保守党保住了多数席位，但向工党丢掉4席，多数优势缩小到仅1席。

en.s: The 2024 Hyndburn Borough Council election was held on 2 May 2024, to elect 12 of the 35 members of Hyndburn Borough Council in Lancashire, England, being the usual approximate third of the council. This was on the same day as other local elections across the country, including for the Lancashire Police and Crime Commissioner. Prior to the election, the council was under no overall control, being led by a minority Conservative administration.

zh.s: 欣德本自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日举行，改选英格兰兰开夏郡欣德本自治市议会35名成员中的12人，约为议会通常改选的三分之一。选举与全国其他地方选举在同一天举行，包括兰开夏郡警察与犯罪专员选举。选举前，没有任何政党单独控制议会，议会由保守党少数派政府领导。

en.s: The 2024 Gateshead Metropolitan Borough Council election was held on 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections across the United Kingdom on the same day. Labour retained its majority on the council.

zh.t: 2024年盖茨黑德都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 盖茨黑德都会自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。工党保住了议会多数席位。

en.s: The 2024 Elmbridge Borough Council election was held on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Elmbridge Borough Council in Surrey, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England and police and crime commissioner elections. There were 16 out of 48 seats contested, being the usual third of the council.

zh.t: 2024年埃尔姆布里奇自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行埃尔姆布里奇自治市议会选举，选出英格兰萨里郡埃尔姆布里奇自治市议会成员。选举与英格兰其他地方选举以及警察与犯罪专员选举在同一天举行。48个席位中有16席改选，为议会通常进行的三分之一改选。

en.s: The 2024 Brentwood Borough Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom being held on the same day. All 39 members of Brentwood Borough Council in Essex were elected following boundary changes. The council was under no overall control prior to the election. The Conservatives were the largest party, but the council was being run by a Liberal Democrat and Labour coalition.

zh.t: 2024年布伦特伍德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 布伦特伍德自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。埃塞克斯郡布伦特伍德自治市议会因边界调整，全部39名成员均进行改选。选举前，议会没有任何政党单独控制。保守党是最大党，但议会由自由民主党和工党组成的联盟管理。

en.s: The 2024 Milton Keynes City Council elections were held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom that were held on the same day. One-third of the 57 members of Milton Keynes City Council in Buckinghamshire were up for election. Prior to the election, the council was under no overall control, being run by a Labour and Liberal Democrat coalition, led by Peter Marland of the Labour Party.

zh.t: 2024年米尔顿凯恩斯市议会选举
zh.s: 米尔顿凯恩斯市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。白金汉郡米尔顿凯恩斯市议会57名成员中的三分之一参加选举。选举前，没有任何政党单独控制议会，议会由工党和自由民主党组成的联盟管理，联盟由工党人彼得·马兰德领导。

en.s: The 2024 Hastings Borough Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom being held on the same day. Half of the 32 members of Hastings Borough Council in East Sussex were elected. The council remained under no overall control, but the Green Party made significant gains in their number of seats, becoming the largest party on the council.

zh.t: 2024年黑斯廷斯自治市议会选举
zh.s: 黑斯廷斯自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。东萨塞克斯郡黑斯廷斯自治市议会32名成员中的一半参加选举。选举后，议会仍没有任何政党单独控制；绿党大幅增加席位，成为议会第一大党。

en.s: The 2024 West Oxfordshire District Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of West Oxfordshire District Council in Oxfordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行西牛津郡区议会选举，选出英格兰牛津郡西牛津郡区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.t: 2024 Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council election
en.s: The 2024 Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council in Hampshire, England, alongside other local elections in England and Wales. A third of the council's 54 seats were up for election. Prior to the election, the council was under no overall control.

zh.t: 2024年贝辛斯托克和迪恩自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行贝辛斯托克和迪恩自治市议会选举，选出英格兰汉普郡贝辛斯托克和迪恩自治市议会成员，与英格兰和威尔士其他地方选举同期举行。议会54席中有三分之一进行改选。选举前，议会没有任何政党单独控制。

en.s: The 2024 Thurrock Council election was held on 2 May 2024 to elect a third of the members of Thurrock Council in Essex, England. It was held on the same day as other local elections across England, including the 2024 Essex police and crime commissioner election. The Labour Party led by John Kent won control of the council for the first time since 2014 from the Conservative Party, which had previously governed in a minority administration with no overall control.

zh.s: 瑟罗克议会选举于2024年5月2日举行，改选英格兰埃塞克斯郡瑟罗克议会三分之一成员。选举与英格兰其他地方选举以及2024年埃塞克斯郡警察与犯罪专员选举在同一天举行。由约翰·肯特领导的工党从保守党手中赢得议会控制权，这是自2014年以来首次。此前，保守党以少数派政府形式管理议会，但没有任何政党单独控制议会。

en.s: The 2024 Rugby Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Rugby Borough Council in Warwickshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行拉格比自治市议会选举，选出英格兰沃里克郡拉格比自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2024 Rossendale Borough Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections being held in the United Kingdom on the same day. It will elect all 30 seats to the council.

zh.t: 2024年罗森代尔自治市议会选举
zh.s: 罗森代尔自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。此次将选出议会全部30个席位。

en.s: The 2024 Pendle Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect a third of the council for the Borough of Pendle in Lancashire, England, on the same day as other local elections in England. The council was under no overall control prior to the election. It had been governed by a coalition of Labour and the Liberal Democrats until the entire Labour caucus left the party in April 2024.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行彭德尔自治市议会选举，改选英格兰兰开夏郡彭德尔自治市议会三分之一席位，与英格兰其他地方选举同日进行。选举前，议会没有任何政党单独控制。此前，议会由工党和自由民主党组成的联盟管理，直到2024年4月工党全体议员集体退党。

en.s: The 2024 Southampton City Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Southampton City Council in Hampshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. Labour retained their majority on the council. The Conservative leader of the opposition, Dan Fitzhenry, did not stand for re-election. The Conservatives chose Peter Baillie to be their new group leader after the election.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行南安普敦市议会选举，选出英格兰汉普郡南安普敦市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。工党保住了议会多数席位。保守党反对党领袖丹·菲茨亨利没有参加连任。选举后，保守党选出彼得·贝利担任新的党团领袖。

en.s: The 2024 Rotherham Metropolitan Borough Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom, which were held on the same day. It elected all 59 councillors to the Rotherham Metropolitan Borough Council for a four-year term, ending in 2028. Labour retained their majority on the council.

zh.t: 2024年罗瑟勒姆都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 罗瑟勒姆都会自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。此次选举改选罗瑟勒姆都会自治市议会全部59名议员，任期4年，于2028年届满。工党保住了议会多数席位。

en.s: The 2024 Fareham Borough Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom. All 32 members of Fareham Borough Council in Hampshire were elected following boundary changes. The council remained under Conservative majority control.

zh.s: 费勒姆自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国其他地方选举同期进行。汉普郡费勒姆自治市议会因边界调整，全部32名成员均进行改选。保守党继续以多数席位控制议会。

en.s: The 2024 Mole Valley District Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Mole Valley District Council in Surrey, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. There were 14 of the 39 seats on the council up for election, being the usual third of the council plus a by-election in the Capel, Leigh, Newdigate and Charlwood ward.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行莫尔谷区议会选举，选出英格兰萨里郡莫尔谷区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。议会39个席位中有14席改选，包括通常改选的三分之一席位，以及卡佩尔、利、纽迪盖特和查尔伍德选区的一场补选。

en.s: The 2024 Crawley Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Crawley Borough Council in West Sussex, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. The Labour Party tightened their control of the council to a comfortable working majority of 14, gaining several seats from the Conservatives. Despite multiple other parties fielding several candidates in Crawley's wards, no other party won any seats.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行克劳利自治市议会选举，选出英格兰西萨塞克斯郡克劳利自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。工党扩大了对议会的控制，取得14席的稳固多数，并从保守党手中赢得数席。尽管其他多个政党也在克劳利的各选区提名了多名候选人，但没有其他政党赢得席位。

en.s: The 2024 Stroud District Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom being held on the same day. All 51 members of Stroud District Council in Gloucestershire were elected.

zh.s: 斯特劳德区议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。格洛斯特郡斯特劳德区议会全部51名成员均进行改选。

en.s: The 2024 Sheffield City Council election took place on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom being held on the same day. There were 29 of the 84 members of Sheffield City Council in South Yorkshire up for election, being the usual third of the council plus a by-election in Firth Park ward. The council remained under no overall control.

zh.s: 谢菲尔德市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。南约克郡谢菲尔德市议会84名成员中有29席改选，包括通常改选的三分之一席位，以及菲尔斯公园选区的一场补选。选举后，仍没有任何政党单独控制议会。

en.s: The 2024 Welwyn Hatfield Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Welwyn Hatfield Borough Council in Hertfordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections across England and Hertfordshire's Police and Crime Commissioner election. As is typical for Welwyn Hatfield's local elections, sixteen seats of the forty-eight total were contested.

zh.t: 2024年韦尔温哈特菲尔德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行韦尔温哈特菲尔德自治市议会选举，选出英格兰赫特福德郡韦尔温哈特菲尔德自治市议会成员。选举与英格兰各地的其他地方选举以及赫特福德郡警察与犯罪专员选举在同一天举行。按照该自治市地方选举的惯例，48个席位中有16席改选。

en.s: The 2024 Knowsley Metropolitan Borough Council election was held on 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom on the same day. No seats changed party at the election, and so Labour retained its majority on the council.

zh.t: 2024年诺斯利都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 诺斯利都会自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。此次选举没有席位易手，因此工党保住了议会多数席位。

en.s: The 2024 Leeds City Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024. It was held on the same day as the second West Yorkshire mayoral election and other local elections across the United Kingdom. The Labour Party maintained control of the council, with their seat count holding steady.

zh.s: 利兹市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与第二届西约克郡市长选举及英国其他地方选举在同一天举行。工党继续控制议会，席位数保持不变。

en.s: The 2024 Southend-on-Sea City Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom being held on the same day. There were 17 of the 51 members of Southend-on-Sea City Council in Essex up for election, being the usual third of the council. The council remained under no overall control, but Labour overtook the Conservatives to become the largest party.

zh.s: 绍森德海滨市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。埃塞克斯郡绍森德海滨市议会51名成员中有17席改选，通常为议会三分之一席位。选举后，议会仍没有任何政党单独控制，但工党超过保守党，成为第一大党。

en.s: The 2024 Sandwell Metropolitan Borough Council elections was held on 2 May 2024 alongside other local elections in the United Kingdom and the 2024 West Midlands mayoral election. One third of seats on Sandwell Metropolitan Borough Council were up for election. The council remained under Labour majority control.

zh.t: 2024年桑德韦尔都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 桑德韦尔都会自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日举行，与英国其他地方选举和2024年西米德兰兹市长选举同期进行。桑德韦尔都会自治市议会三分之一席位进行改选。工党继续以多数席位控制议会。

en.s: The 2024 Bury Metropolitan Borough Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom on the same day. One third of councillors - 17 out of 51 members - of Bury Metropolitan Borough Council were up for election. The council remained under Labour majority control.

zh.t: 2024年伯里都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 伯里都会自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。伯里都会自治市议会51名成员中有三分之一（17人）参加选举。工党继续以多数席位控制议会。

en.s: The 2024 Watford Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Watford Borough Council in Hertfordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections. One third of the council's seats were up for election.

zh.t: 2024年沃特福德自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行沃特福德自治市议会选举，选出英格兰赫特福德郡沃特福德自治市议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。议会三分之一席位进行改选。

en.s: The 2024 Adur District Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections being held in the United Kingdom on the same day. The councillors elected will serve a 4-year term, ending in May 2028.

zh.s: 阿杜尔区议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。当选议员任期4年，于2028年5月届满。

en.s: The 2024 Cannock Chase District Council election took place on Thursday 2 May 2024 to elect councillors on Cannock Chase District Council in Staffordshire. All 36 seats on the council were elected following boundary changes. This election was held on the same day as other local elections in England and the election of Staffordshire's Police, Fire and Crime Commissioner.

zh.s: 坎诺克蔡斯区议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，选出斯塔福德郡坎诺克蔡斯区议会成员。边界调整后，议会全部36个席位均进行改选。选举与英格兰其他地方选举及斯塔福德郡警察、消防与犯罪专员选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2024 Bristol City Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom. It elected all 70 councillors to the Bristol City Council for a four-year term. Until this election the council was led by the directly-elected Mayor of Bristol; that post was abolished following a 2022 referendum which saw 59% of voters in favour of replacing the mayoral system with a committee system.

zh.s: 布里斯托尔市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。此次选举改选布里斯托尔市议会全部70名议员，任期4年。此前，市议会由直选的布里斯托尔市长领导。2022年公投中，59%的选民支持以委员会制取代市长制，市长职位随后被撤销。

en.s: The 2024 Cherwell District Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Cherwell District Council in Oxfordshire, England. This was on the same day as other local elections.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行切尔韦尔区议会选举，选出英格兰牛津郡切尔韦尔区议会成员。选举与其他地方选举在同一天举行。

en.s: The 2024 West Yorkshire mayoral election was held on 2 May 2024 to elect the mayor of West Yorkshire alongside the 2024 United Kingdom local elections. Tracy Brabin of the Labour Party was re-elected with 275,430 votes.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行西约克郡市长选举，选出西约克郡市长，与2024年英国地方选举同期进行。工党候选人特雷西·布拉宾以275430票再次当选。

en.s: The 2024 Redditch Borough Council election took place on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom, which were held on the same day. All 27 seats on Redditch Borough Council in Worcestershire were up for election, following boundary changes. The Labour Party took control of the council.

zh.s: 雷迪奇自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。伍斯特郡雷迪奇自治市议会因边界调整，全部27个席位均进行改选。工党取得议会控制权。

en.s: The 2024 Worcester City Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom being held on the same day. All 35 members of Worcester City Council in Worcestershire were elected following boundary changes. The council remained under no overall control.

zh.s: 伍斯特市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。伍斯特郡伍斯特市议会因边界调整，全部35名成员均进行改选。选举后，没有任何政党单独控制议会。

en.s: The 2024 Newcastle City Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024, to elect members of Newcastle City Council in Tyne and Wear, England. It was held alongside the North East mayoral election, the Northumbria Police and Crime Commissioner election, and other local elections in the United Kingdom held on the same day.

zh.s: 纽卡斯尔市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，选出英格兰泰恩-威尔郡纽卡斯尔市议会成员。选举与东北地区市长选举、诺森比亚警察与犯罪专员选举以及英国其他地方选举同期举行。

en.t: 2024 Blackburn with Darwen Borough Council election
en.s: The 2024 Blackburn with Darwen Borough Council election took place on Thursday 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections in the United Kingdom being held on the same day, to elect one-third of the 51 members of Blackburn with Darwen Borough Council in Lancashire. Labour retained control of the council.

zh.t: 2024年布莱克本与达文自治市议会选举
zh.s: 布莱克本与达文自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行，改选兰开夏郡布莱克本与达文自治市议会51名成员中的三分之一。工党保住了议会控制权。

en.s: The 2024 Solihull Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Solihull Metropolitan Borough Council in the West Midlands alongside other local elections on the same day. 17 of the 51 seats were up for election.

zh.t: 2024年索利赫尔都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行索利赫尔都会自治市议会选举，选出英格兰西米德兰兹郡索利赫尔都会自治市议会成员，与同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行。51个席位中有17席改选。

en.s: The 2024 Manchester City Council elections took place on 2 May 2024, alongside the 2024 Greater Manchester mayoral election and other local elections across England. There were 33 of the 96 seats on Manchester City Council up for election, being the usual third of the seats plus a by-election in Didsbury East ward. Labour retained its majority on the council.

zh.s: 2024年曼彻斯特市议会选举于5月2日举行，与2024年大曼彻斯特市长选举和英格兰其他地方选举同期进行。曼彻斯特市议会96席中有33席改选，包括通常改选的三分之一席位，以及迪兹伯里东选区的一场补选。工党保住了议会多数席位。

en.t: 2024 York and North Yorkshire mayoral election
en.s: The 2024 York and North Yorkshire mayoral election was held on 2 May 2024 to elect the first mayor of York and North Yorkshire. It took place simultaneously with local elections across England and Wales and was won by the Labour candidate David Skaith.

zh.t: 2024年约克和北约克郡市长选举
zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行约克和北约克郡市长选举，选出该地区首任市长。选举与英格兰和威尔士各地的地方选举同时举行，由工党候选人大卫·斯凯思获胜。

en.s: The 2024 Coventry City Council election was held predominately on 2 May 2024 alongside the other local elections across the United Kingdom being held on the same day, with one ward's election additionally being held a month later on 20 June 2024. The results mirrored Labour's strong showing across the country, taking three seats from the Conservatives and increasing their comfortable majority on the council.

zh.s: 考文垂市议会选举大部分于2024年5月2日举行，与英国同日举行的其他地方选举同期进行；其中一个选区的选举则于一个月后的6月20日举行。结果反映了工党在全国的强劲表现：工党从保守党手中赢得3席，并扩大了原本就稳固的多数优势。

en.s: The 2024 Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council election was held on 2 May 2024 to elect 21 out of 63 members of the Stockport Metropolitan Borough Council. The election took place at the same time as the 2024 Greater Manchester mayoral election and other local elections across England. Prior to the election the council was under no overall control, being led by a Liberal Democrat minority administration.

zh.t: 2024年斯托克波特都会自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行斯托克波特都会自治市议会选举，改选斯托克波特都会自治市议会63名成员中的21人。选举与2024年大曼彻斯特市长选举及英格兰其他地方选举同期举行。选举前，议会没有任何政党单独控制，由自由民主党少数派政府领导。

en.s: The 2024 London mayoral election was held on 2 May 2024 to elect the next mayor of London. It took place simultaneously with elections to the London Assembly, some local council by-elections in London and regular local elections elsewhere in England and Wales. Following the Elections Act 2022, voting in this election took place under the first-past-the-post system for the first time and only time, replacing the supplementary vote system.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行伦敦市长选举，选出下一任伦敦市长。选举与伦敦议会选举、伦敦部分地方议会补选以及英格兰和威尔士其他地区的定期地方选举同时举行。根据《2022年选举法》，本次选举首次采用简单多数制，也是唯一一次采用该制度，取代了补充投票制。

en.s: The 2024 West Midlands mayoral election was held on 2 May 2024 to elect the mayor of the West Midlands. The election took place on the same day as other local elections across England and Wales. Richard Parker of the Labour Party won the election, narrowly defeating incumbent Conservative mayor Andy Street, who was running for a third term.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行西米德兰兹市长选举，选出西米德兰兹市长。选举与英格兰和威尔士各地的其他地方选举在同一天举行。工党候选人理查德·帕克险胜寻求第三届任期的保守党现任市长安迪·斯特里特。

en.t: 2024 City of Bradford Metropolitan District Council election
en.s: The 2024 City of Bradford Metropolitan District Council election took place on 2 May 2024. One third of councillors (30 out of 90) were elected. The election took place alongside other local elections across England and Wales. Labour retained their majority on the council.

zh.t: 2024年布拉德福德市都会区议会选举
zh.s: 布拉德福德市都会区议会选举于2024年5月2日举行。90名议员中有三分之一（30人）参加选举。选举与英格兰和威尔士其他地方选举同期进行。工党保住了议会多数席位。

en.s: The 2024 Tees Valley mayoral election was held on 2 May 2024 to elect the mayor of the Tees Valley, part of the 2024 United Kingdom local elections. The Conservative incumbent mayor and member of the House of Lords, Ben Houchen, was re-elected with 53.6% of the vote.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日举行蒂斯谷市长选举，选出蒂斯谷市长，是2024年英国地方选举的一部分。保守党现任市长、上议院议员本·侯臣以53.6%的得票率再次当选。

en.s: A by-election was held in the provincial riding of Milton in Ontario on May 2, 2024, to elect a new member of the Legislative Assembly of Ontario following the resignation of Progressive Conservative MPP and cabinet minister Parm Gill in order to run in the 45th Canadian federal election. It was held the same day as the 2024 Lambton—Kent—Middlesex provincial by-election.

zh.s: 2024年5月2日，安大略省米尔顿省选区举行补选，选出安大略省议会的新议员。此次补选因进步保守党议员兼内阁部长帕姆·吉尔辞职而举行，他辞职是为了参加第45届加拿大联邦大选。同日还举行了兰布顿—肯特—米德尔塞克斯省选区补选。

en.s: The 2024 London Assembly election was held on 2 May 2024 to elect the members of the London Assembly. It took place on the same day as the 2024 London mayoral election, local elections across England and Wales and one parliamentary by-election.

zh.s: 2024年伦敦议会选举于2024年5月2日举行，选出伦敦议会议员。当天还举行了2024年伦敦市长选举、英格兰和威尔士地方选举，以及一场议会补选。

en.s: The 2024 Liverpool City Region mayoral election was held on 2 May 2024 to elect the mayor of the Liverpool City Region, with results declared on 4 May. The election was part of the 2024 United Kingdom local elections across England and Wales. Steve Rotheram, of the Labour Party, was re-elected for a third term.

zh.t: 2024年利物浦城市区域市长选举
zh.s: 2024年利物浦城市区域市长选举于2024年5月2日举行，选出利物浦城市区域市长，结果于5月4日公布。这次选举是2024年英国地方选举的一部分，英格兰和威尔士各地也举行了地方选举。工党候选人史蒂夫·罗瑟拉姆再次当选，开始第三个任期。

en.s: The 2024 Hull City Council election was held on Thursday 2 May 2024 to elect members of Hull City Council. It took place on the same day as other local elections in the United Kingdom. Of the 57 seats on the council, 19 were up for election, being the usual third of the council. It resulted in a Liberal Democrats hold, with a reduced majority.

zh.s: 2024年赫尔市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，选出赫尔市议会议员。选举与英国其他地方选举同日举行。议会57个席位中有19席改选，按惯例约为三分之一。自由民主党保住了这些席位，但多数优势有所缩小。

en.s: The 2024 Walsall Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Walsall Council in the West Midlands. This was on the same day as other local elections. 20 of the 60 seats were up for election.

zh.t: 2024年沃尔索尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2024年沃尔索尔都市自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日举行，选出西米德兰兹郡沃尔索尔议会的议员。选举与其他地方选举同日举行。议会60个席位中有20席改选。

en.s: The 2024 Salford City Council elections took place on 2 May 2024 alongside other local elections across the United Kingdom. Twenty-one seats on Salford City Council were up for election; one in each ward, and one additional seat in Ordsall to fill a casual vacancy. The Labour Party retained control of the council.

zh.s: 2024年索尔福德市议会选举于2024年5月2日举行，与英国各地其他地方选举同日进行。索尔福德市议会有21个席位改选，每个选区各改选一席，奥索尔德选区另有一个席位因空缺举行补选。工党继续控制议会。

en.s: The 2024 Dudley Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on Thursday 2 May 2024 to elect all 72 seats to Dudley Council, alongside the other local elections across the United Kingdom being held on the same day. Prior to the election the council had been under Conservative majority control since the 2021 election.

zh.t: 2024年达德利都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2024年达德利都市自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日（星期四）举行，选出达德利议会全部72个席位，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。选举前，保守党自2021年选举以来一直在议会占多数并执政。

en.s: The 2024 North East mayoral election was held on 2 May 2024 to elect the first mayor of the North East, a role created under the North East devolution deal announced in 2022. The election took place the same day as council elections within the region, as well as local elections across England and Wales.

zh.s: 2024年东北地区市长选举于2024年5月2日举行，选出该地区首任市长。这个职位是2022年公布的东北地区权力下放协议设立的。选举与该地区的市议会选举以及英格兰和威尔士各地的地方选举同日举行。

en.s: The 2024 South Yorkshire mayoral election was held on 2 May 2024 to elect the mayor of South Yorkshire as part of the 2024 United Kingdom local elections. The incumbent Labour and Co-operative Party mayor, Oliver Coppard, was re-elected.

zh.s: 2024年南约克郡市长选举于2024年5月2日举行，是2024年英国地方选举的一部分。现任市长、工党与合作党成员奥利弗·科普帕德再次当选。

en.s: The 2024 East Midlands mayoral election was held on 2 May 2024 to elect the first mayor of the East Midlands. It was part of the local elections across England and Wales. The election was won by the Labour Co-op candidate, Claire Ward.

zh.s: 2024年东米德兰兹市长选举于2024年5月2日举行，选出该地区首任市长。这次选举是英格兰和威尔士地方选举的一部分。工党与合作党联合候选人克莱尔·沃德胜选。

en.s: The 2024 Woking Borough Council election was held on 2 May 2024 to elect members of Woking Borough Council. There were 11 of the 30 seats of the council up for election, being the usual third of the council plus a by-election in Hoe Valley ward. The election took place at the same time as other local elections across England.

zh.s: 2024年沃金自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日举行，选出沃金自治市议会的议员。议会30个席位中有11席改选，按惯例约为三分之一，另包括霍谷选区的一场补选。选举与英格兰其他地方选举同期举行。

en.s: The 2024 Barnsley Metropolitan Borough Council election was held on 2 May 2024, alongside the other local elections across the United Kingdom being held on the same day. Labour retained its majority on the council.

zh.t: 2024年巴恩斯利都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2024年巴恩斯利都市自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日举行，与英国其他地方选举同日进行。工党保住了在议会的多数席位。

en.s: The 2024 Rochdale Metropolitan Borough Council elections took place on 2 May 2024 alongside the 2024 Greater Manchester mayoral election and other local elections across the United Kingdom. One third of seats (20) on Rochdale Metropolitan Borough Council were contested. The council remained under Labour majority control.

zh.t: 2024年罗奇代尔都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2024年罗奇代尔都市自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日举行，与2024年大曼彻斯特市长选举及英国其他地方选举同日进行。罗奇代尔都市自治市议会三分之一的席位（20席）改选。工党继续在议会占多数并执政。

en.s: A by-election was held in the provincial riding of Lambton—Kent—Middlesex in Ontario on May 2, 2024, to elect a new member of the Legislative Assembly of Ontario following the resignation of Progressive Conservative MPP and cabinet minister Monte McNaughton. Monte McNaughton resigned for a private sector position as executive vice-president of industry relations and people experience for Woodbine Entertainment Group.

zh.t: 2024年兰顿—肯特—米德尔塞克斯省议会补选
zh.s: 2024年5月2日，安大略省兰顿—肯特—米德尔塞克斯省选区举行补选，选出安大略省议会议员。此前，进步保守党省议员兼内阁部长蒙特·麦克诺顿辞职。麦克诺顿辞职是为了到伍德拜恩娱乐集团担任负责行业关系与员工体验的执行副总裁，转入私营部门。

en.s: The 2024 Bolton Metropolitan Borough Council election took place on 2 May 2024. The election took place alongside other local elections across the United Kingdom. The council remained under no overall control and continued to be run by a Labour minority administration.

zh.t: 2024年博尔顿都市自治市议会选举
zh.s: 2024年博尔顿都市自治市议会选举于2024年5月2日举行，与英国其他地方选举同期进行。议会没有任何政党单独占多数，仍由工党少数派政府执政。

en.s: CMLL vs. MLW is a professional wrestling event produced by the American promotion Major League Wrestling (MLW) and the Mexican promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL). It took place on May 2, 2025 and was streamed live on CMLL's YouTube channel.

zh.s: CMLL对阵MLW是一场职业摔角赛事，由美国摔角联盟Major League Wrestling（MLW）和墨西哥摔角联盟Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre（CMLL）联合举办。赛事于2025年5月2日举行，并在CMLL的YouTube频道直播。

en.s: The 2025 Butembo offensive was a military operation conducted by March 23 Movement rebels in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with the goal of advancing towards and capturing the city of Butembo, 130 miles north of Goma. The military campaign followed the M23 capture of Bukavu, the provincial capital of South Kivu, occurring concurrently with advances towards Uvira in the neighboring South Kivu province.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2025年，三月二十三日运动（M23）武装人员在刚果民主共和国东部发动军事行动，目标是向北推进并攻占布滕博市。该市位于戈马以北130英里。此次行动发生在M23攻占南基伍省省会布卡武之后；与此同时，M23也在邻近的南基伍省向乌维拉推进。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 2026 Tasmanian Legislative Council periodic election was held on 2 May 2026 to elect two members of the Tasmanian Legislative Council. The seats of Huon and Rosevears were up for election. In Huon, incumbent independent MLC Dean Harriss ran for his first six-year term, having initially won the seat at a by-election in 2022, however he was defeated by another independent, Clare Glade-Wright.

zh.t: 2026年塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举
zh.s: 2026年塔斯马尼亚立法委员会定期选举于2026年5月2日举行，选出两名立法委员会成员。休恩和罗斯维尔两个席位进行改选。在休恩选区，现任独立议员迪恩·哈里斯竞选首个六年任期；他最初于2022年补选中当选，但此次败给了另一名独立候选人克莱尔·格莱德-赖特。
